title: Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our 3rd year Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap designed to show you first-hand what it’s like to be part of a pharmacy team while gaining an overview of store, district, and regional operations. You will gain valuable hands-on experience through a training roadmap that includes a combination of Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), activities, and time spent with leaders in your district. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

3rd year Pharmacy Interns are responsible for completion of a comprehensive training roadmap, focusing on KLEs that build aptitude in the following areas. As tenure increases, 3rd year Pharmacy Interns take on increasing responsibility of the safety and effectiveness of operations in the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the 3rd year Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Accepted into, or actively enrolled in, an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • ; Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, pharmacy interns should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

$20.00 - $23.75


Whether in our pharmacies or through our health service offerings, we are pioneering a bold new approach to total health care. As health care innovators, we are making quality care affordable, accessible, simple and seamless. title: Golf Professional (Recreation)/Career Opportunity
description:
The Golf Professional / Pro Shop Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the golf shop and tee sheet while delivering an exceptional experience for members and guests. This role combines customer service, retail management, and golf operations, including tee time coordination, merchandising, and staff supervision.
About the Opportunity
Golf Operations
  • Collaborate with the Director of Retail Strategy on Golf Store operations, merchandising, and retail development.
  • Manage the golf shop, including retail merchandise, inventory, sales, and customer service, ensuring merchandise offerings remain current and relevant to customer needs.
  • Oversee daily golf operations, including tracking and verifying players and guests, green fees, golf cart rentals, locker fees, and other applicable charges.
  • Manage the golf reservation and tee-time system, coordinate starting operations, monitor course activity, and promote an appropriate pace of play.
  • Develop, coordinate, and manage tournaments, group outings, and leagues that meet the needs of diverse member and guest segments.
  • Monitor operating expenses, manage resources in accordance with the annual budget, and work toward achieving established financial goals.
  • Prepare and submit monthly operational and financial reports to the Director of Golf, along with additional reports as requested.
  • Maintain proficiency in the Lightspeed point-of-sale (POS) system to support accurate transactions, retail sales, and daily golf shop operations.
  • Build relationships with members and guests through active participation in golf activities and provide opportunities to enhance engagement and satisfaction.
  • Maintain active involvement in the Western New York PGA (WNYPGA) Section and participate in relevant professional development opportunities.
  • Ensure golf equipment is properly stored, maintained, and cleaned, and that established safety procedures are followed.
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements
  • This position operates in a golf course environment and involves a combination of indoor golf shop responsibilities and outdoor interaction with members and guests. The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, reaching, and lifting or moving merchandise and golf equipment weighing approximately 25–50 pounds.
  • The position requires working outdoors in varied weather conditions, including heat, humidity, rain, and cold temperatures. Outdoor duties may involve walking on uneven terrain, exposure to sunlight, and proximity to moving golf carts and errant golf balls. The employee must remain aware of surroundings and follow established safety procedures to help maintain a safe environment.
  • During peak season, weekends, and holidays, the position may involve extended shifts, a fast-paced work environment, competing priorities, and increased customer service demands. The employee must maintain the stamina and flexibility necessary to respond to operational needs while providing consistent, high-quality service to members and guests.
About You
Education & Experience
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Golf Management, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in golf operations, pro shop management, or a related hospitality/retail environment required.
  • PGA of America Membership must be in good standing in an active classification.
  • Additional training or certifications in retail management, customer service, or golf operations are a plus.
  • Prior experience managing tee time systems and coordinating daily play on a golf course is strongly preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Ability to lead and motivate staff, manage schedules, and coordinate across multiple functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of safety regulations, environmental standards, and proper equipment operation.
  • Ability to identify operational needs, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects in a dynamic setting.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to provide clear instructions and constructive feedback.
  • Good organizational, recordkeeping, and budgeting skills.
  • Ability to perform physical tasks and work in outdoor environments in various weather conditions.
  • Experience with computer interfaces such as Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and tournament software.
  • Maintain and promote a positive professional image within the community.
  • Valid driver’s license required.
About Your Department
Chautauqua Golf Club provides a high-quality golf experience that emphasizes service, recreation, and environmental stewardship. Located adjacent to Chautauqua Institution, the club features two championship 18-hole courses, including the historic Donald Ross-designed Lake Course and the scenic Hill Course. The department supports daily golf operations, member and guest services, tournaments, retail merchandise, and golf-related programming, contributing to Chautauqua Institution’s diverse recreational offerings and welcoming community experience.
About Your Work Schedule & Location
This position is at Chautauqua Institution’s main campus in Southwestern New York (Chautauqua County). The schedule is full-time and may include daytime and evening hours, weekdays, and weekends, especially in the busy summer operating season and during project go-live periods. The position will be based on the main campus in Chautauqua, New York.

Chautauqua Institution is a not-for-profit global convener of dialogue on the most significant issues of the day through engagement across four pillars of the arts, education, religion, and recreation. There are countless ways that our talent will engage with our mission, vision, and diverse communities, and you are invited to immerse yourself in our programming as a gateway to this experience. Chautauqua Institution values Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (IDEA) as a priority in our strategic plan, 150 Forward. title: Senior Insider Risk Investigator
description:
Senior Insider Risk Investigator

Macclesfield, UK (3 days on site per week)

About AstraZeneca

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies. At AstraZeneca, we are pioneering new frontiers by identifying and treating patients earlier, working towards the aim of eliminating cancer as a cause of death.

Come and join our AZ team where you will play a pivotal role in this exciting period of development!!

The Senior Insider Risk Investigator will independently lead the assessment and investigation of complex, sensitive and high-risk insider risk events within AstraZeneca’s Global Cyber Defence function, while providing quality assurance, peer review and guidance across Insider Risk Management casework. Working from alert or referral through to closure, the role will combine advanced technical analysis, business context and proportionate risk assessment to establish what occurred, assess potential impact and provide clear, defensible findings and recommended actions.

The role will lead a varied caseload that may include suspected unauthorised disclosure or transfer of information, inappropriate access, misuse of corporate systems, policy non-compliance, compromised accounts, intellectual property concerns and data handling risks associated with workforce events such as role changes and departures. Cases may originate from security monitoring, operational teams, information incidents, business referrals or other authorised channels.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Complex investigations: Lead complex, sensitive, high-profile or multi-jurisdiction insider risk investigations from initial intake and scoping through investigation, findings and closure, including cases that may subsequently support disciplinary, legal, regulatory or law enforcement processes.
  • Assessing and prioritising concerns: Assess alerts and concerns raised through security monitoring, colleagues and partner teams. Determine whether further investigation is rationalised based on available evidence, risk, proportionality and defined criteria, and document the rationale for key investigative decisions.
  • Investigation planning and analysis: Develop clear investigation scopes, hypotheses and evidence requirements. Build timelines, correlate evidence from multiple sources, identify corroborating or conflicting information, assess alternative explanations and document conclusions with an appropriate level of confidence.
  • Technical evidence: Retrieve, preserve, organise and analyse relevant security and business telemetry from sources such as DLP, Insider Risk Management, SIEM, endpoint, identity, cloud, network and collaboration platforms. Maintain appropriate evidence provenance and integrity so that material findings can be traced back to their supporting evidence.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Coordinate effectively with Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Human Resources, DLP, Cyber Security and relevant business teams. Provide objective technical evidence and investigative context to support decision-making
  • Investigation boundaries: Maintain a clear distinction between the investigator’s role in establishing technical facts and the responsibility of authorised functions such as Employee Relations, Human Resources, Legal and Compliance to resolve employment, disciplinary, legal or regulatory outcomes.
  • Quality and assurance: Establish and maintain high standards for investigation planning, evidence handling, case documentation, analytical reasoning and reporting. Review complex or high-risk investigations and challenge findings where evidence, reasoning or documentation does not adequately support the conclusion.
  • Learning and improvement: Identify recurring behaviours, control weaknesses and investigative insights, translating appropriate findings into recommendations for improved detection, prevention, controls and awareness. Share anonymised lessons and investigation techniques across the wider team
  • Process and control improvement: Find opportunities to improve insider risk investigation processes, workflows, controls and supporting guidance based on case experience, recurring issues and lessons learned.
  • Mentoring and capability: Coach and develop investigators and analysts, provide guidance on complex cases, and help build consistent investigative capability, judgement and standards across the team.
  • Measures and reporting: Monitor investigation performance and contribute to regular insider risk reporting for leadership

Requirements:

  • Education: Relevant education, professional training or equivalent practical experience, combined with hands on experience in insider risk investigations, security operations, incident response, digital forensics, intelligence, fraud or a related field, including considerable experience leading complex investigations.
  • Investigative leadership: Demonstrated track record of independently leading complex and sensitive investigations, exercising sound investigative judgement and reviewing and quality-assuring the work of others.
  • Experience in: Insider risk principles, including accidental, negligent, compromised and malicious activity, data ex-filtration, intellectual property risk, inappropriate access, policy violations and third-party or contractor risk.
  • Strong knowledge in: Structured investigation methods, including intake, scoping, hypothesis development, timeline analysis, corroboration, evidence handling, root cause assessment and defensible decision making.
  • Decision-making: Experience making defensible, proportionate decisions on case acceptance, scope, priority and critical issue under time pressure and uncertainty.
  • Technical analysis: Strong experience using security monitoring and investigative tooling to retrieve, organise and analyse technical evidence, including SIEM, DLP, endpoint, identity, cloud, collaboration or user activity monitoring data.
  • Written and verbal communication: Strong report writing and briefing skills, with the ability to explain complex technical activity, evidence, confidence, limitations and business risk clearly to technical and non-technical team members, including senior decision makers.
  • Stakeholder management: Experience coordinating complex or sensitive work across multiple business and technical functions, maintaining confidentiality and influencing timely, proportionate outcomes without direct authority.
  • Quality assurance and mentoring: Experience reviewing investigative work, challenging evidence and conclusions constructively, coaching less experienced investigators or analysts and contributing to consistent investigative standards.
  • Process and control improvement: Experience identifying and delivering improvements to investigative processes, playbooks, monitoring, detections, controls, tooling or automation, using operational and investigative insight to support practical and proportionate improvements.
  • Querying and automation: Strong experience using query languages to support investigation and analysis, such as KQL or SPL. Experience using scripting or automation technologies such as PowerShell or Python to improve analytical or investigative workflows would be advantageous.
  • Adaptability and shared capability: Willingness to maintain knowledge across adjacent Cyber Defence capabilities and contribute to cross-training, knowledge sharing and wider operational priorities where required.
  • Preferred certifications: A relevant certification such as ITPM, GCIH, GCFA or another qualification applicable to security investigations or insider risk.

In Office Requirement:

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

Competitive salary and benefits package on offer!

The successful candidate will have access to a flexible employee benefits fund, including holiday purchase and flexible time off, pension contributions, Share Save Plans, A performance recognition scheme and a competitive, generous remuneration package.

title: Guild Lead for tech profiles
description: Why this role You will act as Community of Practice Lead in the CoE Operational Excellence of the Design and Value Acceleration (DVA) Chapter. You get a real mandate, direct visibility with the DVA Chapter leadership, and the chance to define the standards of a discipline that is changing fast. Your influence comes from credibility and community. Your mission: five pillars 1. Community management: Build and guide a community people want to learn Lead a community of 20+ tech profiles, such as Integrators, front-end developers, and publishers Run the guild: demos, tech talks, peer support, mentoring and onboarding of newcomers. title: Program Specialist

Job Title: Program Specialist

Location: US, Remote

Role: Only available for current contingent workforce

About Neovance:

At Neovance, we’re transforming the patient experience by driving better outcomes through compassion, innovation, and operational excellence. With more than 30 years of experience partnering with the biopharmaceutical industry, we deliver agile, technology-enabled patient access solutions that help people start and stay on therapy.

Our expertise spans HUB services, patient assistance programs, field reimbursement, nursing, and non-commercial pharmacy – each designed to remove barriers to care and ensure patients receive the therapies they need when they need them.

Guided by our values of Agility, Integrity, Tenacity, Unity, and Quality, we work as one Neovance team to optimize access, enhance adherence, and make a meaningful impact, one patient at a time.

As a Program Specialist at Neovance, you’ll be the voice of our patient support programs, connecting with patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and partners to remove barriers to therapy access and create a seamless experience from start to finish.

In this full-time, remote U.S. contact-center role, you’ll combine empathy, communication, discipline, and problem-solving to help patients navigate their treatment journey with confidence and care. You’ll work defined schedules and shift rotations, supporting inquiries by phone, email, fax, video, and chat, and you’ll receive comprehensive training before handling live calls.

  • Process applications – Process patient applications, determine program eligibility, and follow up as needed to support timely access to therapy.

  • Educate and guide – Explain available access options to patients and guide them on next steps in their journey.
  • Document with care – Maintain clear, compliant documentation in accordance with regulatory and privacy standards.

  • High school diploma or equivalent education
  • At least 1 year of customer service experience in a call center, healthcare, pharmacy, retail, or similar environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to simplify complex information and convey empathy
  • Ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously in a technology-enabled work environment
  • Comfort working on the phone throughout the day while maintaining focus and composure
  • Secure, private workspace and reliable high-speed internet

title: Varastotyöntekijä / Kontinpurkaja
description:
Varastotyöntekijä / Kontinpurkaja

Hei, juuri sinä!

Me etsimme asiakkaallemme kontinpurkajia renkaiden kontinpurku- ja lastaustyötehtäviin.

Mistä on kyse?

Työ pitää sisällään käsin tehtävää konttien purkua sekä lavojen siirtelyä trukilla. Työ on erittäin fyysistä tiimityötä ja sitä tehdään aamu-, päivä-, ja iltavuoroissa. Tässä työssä pärjäät loistavasti hyvällä fysiikalla, sekä reippaalla ja aktiivisella asenteella. Katsomme eduksi aikaisemman trukkiosaamisen. Työturvakortti vaaditaan, mutta sopimuksen mukaan voit suorittaa sen myös Carrotin kauttta.

Työ on luonteeltaan keikkatyötä, mutta pääsääntöisesti töitä on tarjolla noin 40h/viikko. Työt alkavat 7.12.2026.

Jos rakastat fyysistä työtä ja olet reippaalla asenteella liikkeellä, hae meille, niin jutellaan lisää tilanteestasi ja työpaikasta!

Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työpaikkoihimme, työnhakuun tai palveluihimme liittyen, löydät yhteystietomme osoitteesta

Kuinka haen Carrotille?

Voit jättää hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta. Jos olet jo aiemmin jättänyt hakemuksen Carrotille, voit hakemuslomakkeen kautta myös kirjautua sisään käyttäjätunnuksillasi ja päivittää aiempaa hakemuspohjaasi hakeaksesi tähän työpaikkaan. Carrotille työhakemuksen jättäminen on helppoa ja nopeaa. Kartoitamme osaamisesi ja toiveesi työpaikan suhteen, ja tarjoamme sinulle yhdellä hakemuksella yhteydet satoihin työpaikkoihin, sekä koko elämän mittaisia urapolkuja!

Nähdään Carrotilla!

Carrot on nopea, välittävä ja vastuullinen työelämän kumppani, jonka tärkeimpänä tavoitteena on olla luomassa hyvää työelämää kaikille. Tarjoamme valtakunnallisesti henkilöstövuokraus-, rekrytointi- ja ulkoistuspalveluita sekä toimimme strategisena HR-kumppanina asiakkaillemme. Carrot on toiminut vuodesta 1998.

Meille on erityisen tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi. Yhteisenä päämääränämme on löytää Sinulle koulutustasi ja kokemustasi vastaava, toiveidesi mukainen mielekäs työ. Meillä on jatkuvasti avoinna useita erilaisia työtehtäviä lyhyempikestoisista pidempiaikaisiin, sekä vakituisiin työtehtäviin.

title: Salesforce FSC Senior Developer
description:
India T&M Special Bonus:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Developer to join our team in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Senior Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Developer

### Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Salesforce development and Financial Services Cloud capabilities.

The candidate will be responsible for independently designing and developing complex FSC solutions, contributing to technical design, building integrations, reviewing code, mentoring junior developers, and ensuring high-quality delivery across banking, insurance, wealth management, lending, or other financial-services use cases.

### Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and deploy complex Salesforce solutions using Financial Services Cloud, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce Flows, OmniStudio, and Salesforce configuration.
- Independently analyze business and functional requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
- Configure and extend FSC capabilities including:
- Person Accounts
- Households and Groups
- Financial Accounts
- Financial Holdings
- Account-Contact Relationships
- Interaction Summaries
- Action Plans
- Relationship Groups
- Develop reusable and scalable Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components, batch jobs, scheduled jobs, and asynchronous processes.
- Design and configure OmniStudio solutions, including OmniScripts, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards, where applicable.
- Develop integrations between Salesforce and external financial systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, middleware, and event-driven integration patterns.
- Support integrations with systems such as core banking, policy administration, loan origination, payment systems, customer master, document management, and other enterprise applications.
- Participate in technical design discussions and recommend appropriate implementation approaches.
- Review code and configurations developed by other team members and provide technical guidance.
- Mentor junior and intermediate Salesforce developers.
- Ensure solutions follow Salesforce and FSC best practices for security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and governor limits.
- Troubleshoot complex application, integration, data, security, and performance issues.
- Support data migration and transformation activities involving FSC data structures.
- Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive customer and financial data.
- Contribute to effort estimation, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical task breakdown.
- Support SIT, UAT, release, deployment, hypercare, and production support.
- Work closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Business Analysts, QA teams, Product Owners, and integration teams.
- Support CI/CD, source control, and Salesforce release-management activities.

### Required Skills & Experience

- Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud.
- Strong Salesforce development experience with:
- Apex
- Lightning Web Components (LWC)
- SOQL / SOSL
- Salesforce Flows
- Triggers
- Batch, Queueable, Future, and Scheduled Apex
- Strong understanding of the Financial Services Cloud data model and business capabilities.
- Hands-on experience with FSC concepts including:
- Person Accounts
- Financial Accounts and Holdings
- Household / Group structures
- Account-Contact Relationships
- Interaction Summaries
- Action Plans
- Good hands-on experience with OmniStudio, including:
- OmniScripts
- DataRaptors
- Integration Procedures
- FlexCards
- Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, security model, sharing framework, and governor limits.
- Experience developing and consuming REST and SOAP APIs.
- Experience with synchronous, asynchronous, batch, and event-driven integration patterns.
- Good understanding of Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Named Credentials, OAuth, and API security.
- Experience with Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud alongside FSC.
- Experience with Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD pipelines, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent DevOps tools.
- Strong understanding of coding standards, unit testing, code reviews, exception handling, and logging.
- Ability to independently troubleshoot complex Salesforce and FSC issues.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery teams.

### Senior-Level Expectations

The Senior FSC Developer should be able to:

- Independently own development of medium to complex FSC features.
- Translate functional requirements into appropriate technical solutions with limited supervision.
- Contribute to FSC solution and technical design discussions.
- Make appropriate use of standard FSC functionality versus custom development.
- Identify impacts to the FSC data model before introducing custom objects or relationships.
- Review Apex, LWC, Flow, OmniStudio, and integration implementations.
- Identify security, performance, scalability, and maintainability concerns.
- Mentor other Salesforce developers and resolve technical blockers.
- Develop reusable components and frameworks where appropriate.
- Identify architectural concerns and escalate them to the Tech Lead or Architect.
- Take ownership of assigned functionality from design through production stabilization.

### Good to Have

- Domain experience in banking, insurance, wealth management, lending, or financial services.
- Experience integrating FSC with:
- Core banking platforms
- Policy administration systems
- Loan origination systems
- Payment platforms
- Customer master / MDM platforms
- Experience with MuleSoft or other enterprise integration platforms.
- Experience with large data volumes and Salesforce performance optimization.
- Experience with data migration and legacy Salesforce org transformation.
- Knowledge of financial-services security, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements.
- Experience with Experience Cloud, Revenue Cloud, or other Salesforce solutions.

### Preferred Certifications

- Salesforce Financial Services Cloud certification
- Salesforce Platform Developer I
- Salesforce Platform Developer II
- Salesforce Administrator
- JavaScript Developer I
- Salesforce Industries OmniStudio Developer

### Experience

Typically 5–8+ years of Salesforce experience, including:

- 2–3+ years of hands-on Financial Services Cloud experience
- Strong development experience across Apex, LWC, integrations, and Salesforce configuration
- Experience independently delivering complex FSC functionality
- Experience mentoring developers or performing technical/code reviews

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Job Title

Senior Program Manager

Job Description

Senior Program Manager – Intelligent Systems & AI

At Philips, our purpose is to improve people's health and well-being through meaningful innovation. Across enterprise imaging, radiology, cardiology and digital pathology, our healthcare informatics solutions help clinicians and health systems turn complex data into better-informed decisions. Doing that at scale takes more than great products: it takes exceptional technology, operations and execution behind them.

That is where Intelligent Systems & AI (IS&AI), within Philips Healthcare Informatics, comes in. We connect business priorities with platforms, data, automation and AI to improve how our business sells, delivers and supports customers. From commercial and service workflows to enterprise technology transformation, we work across teams and systems to remove friction, improve outcomes and create lasting value. We are looking for someone who wants to help build that future, not simply manage a plan.


The opportunity

You will lead high-impact, cross-functional technology programs from an ambiguous business problem to an implemented solution and measurable result. You will partner closely with business leaders, product managers, engineers, architects and technology partners. Expect to move between strategic choices and operational detail, influence technical trade-offs, unblock teams and help reshape how programs run in an AI-enabled organization. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a reporting-only PMO position.


Your Role

· Translate customer and business problems into clear goals, success measures, practical scope and decisions. Work backwards from customer experience, adoption, productivity, cost or revenue impact rather than treating delivery milestones as the finish line.

· Drive complex programs from discovery and prioritization through design, build, integration, launch, adoption and value realization. Make sequencing and capacity trade-offs, resolve blockers and take accountability when plans change.

· Work closely with engineering and architecture on systems, APIs, data flows, integrations and technical dependencies across CRM, CPQ, ERP, service platforms and other enterprise applications. Understand enough to ask the hard questions and challenge choices constructively.

· Align commercial and service business leaders, product teams, engineering, operations, vendors and system integrators around one coherent roadmap. Build accountability and make decisions without relying on formal authority.

· Establish fit-for-purpose operating mechanisms that show the real risks, dependencies, owners and decisions. Communicate trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and distinguish meaningful progress from status reporting.

· Use AI, automation and modern digital tools to reduce coordination overhead, detect issues earlier and improve decision quality. Experiment, learn and scale what works, with appropriate security, privacy and human accountability.


You may be a great fit if you

· Have 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise software, digital transformation or technical programs spanning multiple teams, systems and business stakeholders.

· Bring experience from product-led technology, cloud/SaaS or enterprise-platform businesses, or from technology and digital transformation consulting where you owned delivery through implementation and adoption - not just strategy, governance or reporting.

· Hold a master's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business or a related discipline, or an MBA. Comparable exceptional experience in technical program leadership may also be considered.

· Think from first principles: you can break down an unclear problem, test assumptions, identify the real constraint and make sensible decisions with incomplete information.

· Have a track record of personally moving difficult programs forward and can explain the decisions you made, the trade-offs you navigated and the business or customer outcomes that resulted.

· Combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You are as comfortable framing a direction with executives as getting into the details with engineers or removing a delivery blocker.

· Bring practical technical fluency in enterprise systems, cloud or SaaS platforms, integrations and data; you can collaborate credibly with product and engineering without needing to be the person writing production code.

· Are an effective, concise communicator who earns trust across functions and cultures, surfaces uncomfortable facts early and makes complex decisions understandable.

· Are curious and comfortable using AI tools in your own work today, with a strong appetite to experiment and continuously improve how you and your team operate.


How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

#LI #Healthcareinformatics

About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

title: QMS Specialist
description:
Job Title

QMS Specialist

Job Description

Job title:
QMS Specialist


Your role:
The QMS Specialist is responsible for supporting the establishment of a compliant and effective Quality Management System (QMS) for the activities in scope. The role participates in developing and revising QMS process documents, such as SOPs and quality manuals, ensuring their accuracy and currency. The role works under general supervision, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues through root cause analysis and corrective actions. The role collects and reports data on QMS performance metrics and tracks non conformance reports, contributing to continuous improvement activities.


You're the right fit if: (4 x bullets max)
1. Experience: 6–10 years; mid-level professionals.

2. Skills:

  • Strong experience in document control and QMS documentation, including use of PLM and electronic document management systems such as Windchill; managing controlled documents, revisions, approvals, and change workflows; and maintaining device master record (DMR) or equivalent product documentation files.
  • Good understanding of QMS standards and regulations, including ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, and EU MDR; experience with QMS processes like training, and participation in internal and external audit.
  • Participates in the effective deployment and continuous improvement of QMS processes in the assigned area/ areas such as document control, training, and audits, by providing technical expertise and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Collects, compiles, and reports data on QMS performance metrics, such as non-conformances, critical findings, and training completion rates, to support management in decision-making.
  • Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for enhancing efficiency and compliance within existing QMS processes and providing support in implementing improvements. • Participates in the planning and organization of internal audits by preparing necessary documentation, assisting audit teams during audits, and ensuring follow-up actions are completed.
  • Ensures the proper maintenance, organization, and archiving of quality records in accordance with QMS procedures, regulatory requirements, and company policies to maintain audit readiness.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure effective communication and understanding of QMS processes, and provide basic guidance on compliance-related inquiries.
  • Participates in problem-solving sessions by providing data and insights related to quality processes, supporting the identication of root causes, and recommending potential corrective actions.
  • Works under general supervision and established processes, utilizing independent judgment to navigate and adhere to operational policies, ensuring compliance and optimal performance.
  • Engages in risk management activities, identifying potential risks to regulatory compliance, quality and QMS integrity, and proposing mitigation strategies to minimize impact.
  • Participates in training sessions to stay updated on quality standards and QMS procedures, actively engaging in learning opportunities to enhance understanding of industry regulations and best practices.
  • Develops professional expertise and applies comprehensive knowledge of company products and services to effectively address challenges and opportunities

3. Education: Bachelor of Engineering and/or MSc. (Science, Biomedical, Biotech, etc)

• Regulatory Requirements

• Quality Management Systems (QMS)

• Troubleshooting

• KPI Monitoring and Reporting

• Data Analysis & Interpretation

• Process Improvements

• Agile Methodology

• User Training & Support

• Training Content Development

title: Laboratory Technican
description:
Chemtech Environmental
Laboratory Technician
9am-17.00


Who we are
At Chemtech Environmental, we like to think of ourselves as an extension of your team — the kind that adds value without adding hassle (and yes, the sample containers are free). We keep things simple, personal and practical, offering tailored solutions and responsive support through our network of regional laboratories. With years of industry experience behind us, we help clients get the answers they need, make smart decisions and keep projects moving — all while sweating the small stuff so they don’t have to.

We're filthy and we're proud of it


Part of the Celnor Group
Celnor Group is a UK-based environmental services group operating across the Testing, Inspection, Certification and Compliance (TICC) landscape. With a growing portfolio of specialist businesses, Celnor provides essential services that protect people, property and the environment.
While each business retains its own identity, culture and technical specialism, all are supported by a central group function that invests in people, systems and long-term sustainable growth.


Job details
We are looking for two Laboratory Technicians to join our team at Chemtech Environmental.
We currently have opportunities within two areas of our laboratory:
  • 1 x Laboratory Technician – Organics Extraction
  • 1 x Laboratory Technician – Volatiles Extraction
These are hands on laboratory roles, ideal for individuals who enjoy practical work, have excellent attention to detail and are interested in developing their skills within analytical science.
Working as part of our laboratory team, you will be responsible for preparing and extracting environmental samples for analysis, ensuring all work is completed accurately, efficiently and in line with laboratory quality procedures.

The Organics Extraction role will focus on preparing samples for organic chemical analysis, while the Volatiles Extraction role will support the preparation and extraction of samples for volatile organic compound (VOC) testing.

Whether you have previous laboratory experience or are looking for an opportunity to develop your technical skills, we would be interested in hearing from you.


What you will do
  • Prepare and extract environmental samples in accordance with laboratory procedures and testing methods.
  • Carry out routine sample preparation and extraction techniques within either the Organics or Volatiles section.
  • Accurately weigh, measure, label and prepare samples for laboratory analysis.
  • Handle and prepare chemical reagents, solvents and standards safely.
  • Ensure samples are correctly identified, tracked and processed throughout the laboratory.
  • Operate laboratory equipment and undertake routine checks and basic maintenance.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records, worklists and sample documentation.
  • Follow quality control procedures to ensure accurate, consistent and reliable results.
  • Identify and report any sample preparation issues, discrepancies or non-conformances.
  • Work closely with Analysts and other laboratory colleagues to ensure samples are prepared within agreed turnaround times.
  • Maintain a clean, safe and organised laboratory environment.
  • Follow all relevant health and safety procedures, including COSHH requirements and safe chemical handling.
  • Support the wider laboratory team with additional duties when required.
Who you are
We are looking for reliable, motivated individuals who enjoy hands-on laboratory work, have excellent attention to detail and take pride in delivering accurate results.

Ideally, you will have:
  • Previous experience working within a laboratory environment would be advantageous, although full training can be provided.
  • An interest in Chemistry, Applied Science or practical laboratory work.
  • Good attention to detail and the ability to follow written instructions and procedures accurately.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage workloads effectively.
  • Confidence working with laboratory equipment and following health and safety procedures.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Excel.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn new techniques.
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Good communication skills and a reliable, flexible approach to work.
  • The ability to complete routine and repetitive tasks while maintaining high standards of accuracy
Desirable experience:
  • Previous experience within a commercial or high-throughput laboratory.
  • Knowledge of organic chemistry, sample extraction or volatile organic compound (VOC) testing.
  • Experience preparing environmental samples, including soil and water.
  • Experience handling laboratory solvents, reagents or chemical standards.
  • Familiarity with laboratory quality control procedures or UKAS-accredited environments.
  • A qualification in Chemistry, Applied Science or a related scientific subject.

Benefits
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays — and it increases the longer you stick around.
  • Performance bonus- win together, celebrate together.
  • Free on-site parking, because the only thing you should be hunting for at work is results, not a parking space.
  • Health and wellbeing programme to help keep both mind and body in good working order.
  • Life insurance (2x salary) for a little extra peace of mind.
  • Referral bonus of £1,000 if you bring great people into the team.
  • Sick pay and enhanced maternity & paternity pay to support you when life happens.
  • Christmas shutdown, giving you proper time to switch off, relax and enjoy the festive season
Important information
Celnor Group and its businesses manage recruitment directly. We do not require agency support for this role and will only engage with recruitment partners from our preferred supplier list where necessary.
We may use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support parts of the recruitment process. AI is not used for candidate screening, scoring or hiring decisions. All hiring decisions are made by people, for people. Our recruitment systems are ISO 42001 accredited, reflecting our commitment to ethical, transparent and responsible use of technology.

A Shift Supervisor is a key leader supporting the CVS Store Management team in driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. When there is no manager or Operations Supervisor onsite, the Shift Supervisor leads the store staff, ensures that store operations run smoothly, and is responsible for ensuring the completion of all opening and closing procedures.

  • Handle all customer relations issues in accordance with company policy and promote a positive shopping experience for all CVS customers
  • Maintain customer/patient confidentiality

  • Price merchandise
  • Stock shelves
  • Execute the displays, sign and inventory of weekly, promotional, and seasonal merchandise
  • Execute the display and maintenance of off-shelf merchandise
  • Reset departments following POGs


Required Qualifications

  • Deductive reasoning ability, analytical skills and computer skills.
  • Advanced communication skills and supervision skills
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise


Preferred Qualifications

High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

28

Part time

title: Assistant Manager I
description:
We’re seeking an Assistant Store Manager to join our team to help with store operations, customer service and team development. Duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Assist with store functions and day-to-day store activities

  • Help customers in a positive, approachable manner and address any questions or concerns they may have

  • Help organize, and transfer merchandise from delivery truck to stockroom to sales floor as needed and ensure the seasonal areas of the store are maintained

  • Perform opening and closing procedures as needed

  • Process all corporate directives including Pull and Hold/Destroy, Task Compliance, Key Survey information requests and any additional communications related to store activities

  • Assist in ordering merchandise, processing damaged merchandise, record keeping (including payroll, scheduling, and cash register deposits and receipts), and loss prevention

  • Maintain areas of the store, including a well-stocked sales floor and organized stockroom, to company standards

  • Protect and secure all company assets, including store cash

  • Adhere to policies and procedures including safety guidelines and ensure all store associates follow company policies and procedures

  • Help the Store Manager supervise, train, and develop Store Associates

  • Ensure a positive, safe, and respectful environment while maintaining professional and friendly interactions with customers, associates, and leaders

  • Responsible for maintaining the cleanliness throughout the store, including cleaning and restocking bathrooms, sweeping and mopping floors, taking out the trash, and ensuring all areas are neat and presentable

  • Other duties as assigned*

Skills and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent is preferred; ability to read, interpret, and explain operational directives (e.g., merchandise schematics, etc.) is required

  • Store management experience in retail, grocery, or drug store environment is preferred

  • Must be able to lift up to 55 lbs. from floor to above shoulder height and meet demands of frequent walking, standing, stooping, kneeling, climbing, pushing, pulling, and repetitive lifting

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and written skills are required

  • Ability to work in a high-energy, team environment is required

  • Exceptional customer service, organizational, and communication skills are required

  • Strong problem solving and decision-making skills are required

We offer a wide variety of rewards to support your health, wealth, and mental well-being. In addition to medical, pharmacy, dental, and vision insurance, we offer:

description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

Health is everything. At CVS Health, colleagues are committed to increasing access, lowering costs, and improving quality of care. Millions of times a day, we help people on their path to better health –from advising on prescriptions to helping manage chronic and specialty conditions. As a 3rd year pharmacy intern, you have a significant role in our company working as a part of the pharmacy team– delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients.

  • Customer Service
  • Inventory Management

A key component of the pharmacy intern role is keeping your customers and patients healthy through adoption and management of patient care programs. Additionally, you will:

  • Lead with Heart – display empathy and compassion for your patients, customers, caregivers, and colleagues on your team
  • Seek new ways to grow, collaborate with others, and deliver better outcomes

  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Complete all required training within state guidelines and required timeframe
  • Ability to:
    • Have regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Finger Dexterity: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Reach overhead; able to stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Precision control: able to adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree and requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Visual Acuity: Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Able to orally communicate information and instructions to colleagues and customers
    • Occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs; exerting up to 20 lbs. of force occasionally and/or up to 10 lbs. of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects

title: Scrum Master
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
The Scrum Master is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for guiding and coaching teams in the use of Scrum / Agile practices.

The primary responsibility of this role is to boost the effectiveness of teams by managing key projects, championing cross team alignment and delivering success and operationalizing underlying processes to make development teams hum effectively.

The Scrum Masters resolves impediments, monitors and has control over the scrum processes and meetings.

Key responsibilities:
  • Fosters a self-organizing and empowered environment that enables teams to deliver high-quality products on time and within budget.
  • Facilitates and leads Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Ensures that teams adhere to the Scrum framework, follows agile best practices, and utilizes appropriate tools and metrics to track progress, identifies bottlenecks, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Fosters effective communication and collaboration between cross-functional teams, product owners, and stakeholders.
  • Acts as a bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring a shared understanding of the project goals, priorities, and timelines.
  • Proactively addresses any conflicts or challenges that may hinder team performance and delivery.
  • Collaboratively identifies and synchronizes project interdependencies across multiple teams. Facilitates effective resource allocation across the programs.
  • Drives the continuous improvement of agile processes, methodologies, and tools across the organization. Identifies and implements process enhancements to optimize efficiency, productivity, and quality of deliverables.
  • Encourages innovation to foster a culture of continuous leading and growth.
  • Ensures the program benefits remain viable throughout the program, communicating status and date changes and actively manage dependencies.
  • Builds strong relationships with key stakeholders and manages these expectations regarding project scope, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Collaborates closely with product owners to prioritize backlog items and ensures alignment with business goals.
  • Provides regular project status updates and communicates any risks or impediments that may impact project success.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
  • Ability to recognize the importance of working through others within the team through engaging and empowering others to use as much of their own capabilities as possible, thereby fostering trust and high energy to succeed.
  • Has drive and energy to get the job done.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Assertive with the ability to come up with solutions to critical situations.
  • Ability to make timely decisions and take calculated risks.
  • Seasoned knowledge of other Agile approaches such as XP, Kanban, Scrum, extreme Programming (XP).
  • Seasoned knowledge of the technologies used by the team.
  • Ability to coordinate large teams with cross-functional dependencies.
  • Proactive and organized with the ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment providing consistent, high-quality output.
  • Ability to facilitate discussions to allow the team to consider alternative solutions or approaches and bring disagreements out into the open to help to manage them collaboratively.
  • Ability to stimulate and relish change, adapt quickly and see change as an opportunity.

Academic qualifications and certifications:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Project Management or related field.
  • Relevant certifications such as SAFe Scrum Master or SAFe Advanced Scrum Master preferred.
  • Other related certifications and/or training (for example - SAFe DeVos, Implementing SAFe etc.).

Required experience:
  • Seasoned Scrum Master experience in an ICT environment, managing software projects and working with software development teams.
  • Seasoned experience in Scrum Management.
  • Seasoned experience of Agile concepts and principles.
  • Seasoned experience as a coach and mentor in agile practices (Scrum, Kanban etc.).
  • Seasoned experience with contemporary software development methodologies.
  • Seasoned experience with widely successful Agile techniques such as User Stories, ATDD, TDD, Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Pairing, Automated Testing, Agile Games.

Workplace type:

On-site Working

About NTT DATA
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Data Professional (Engineer/Analyst/Scientist)
description:
At Amentum, we're not just solving problems; we're engineering the future. Our team is driven by an unyielding commitment to innovation, integrity, and collaboration, tackling some of the most significant challenges in science, security, and sustainability. If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive. Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all. We'll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed - today and into tomorrow.

We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities. People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent. In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships. Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a versatile Data Professional to join our growing Data capability. We recognise that data roles don't always fit neatly into a single category. You may consider yourself a Data Analyst, Data Scientist or Data Engineer, or have experience spanning several of these areas. We are therefore more interested in your underlying data skills, problem-solving ability and potential than your current job title.

What You'll Be Doing

You will work as part of a multidisciplinary team delivering data-driven solutions for complex customer problems. Depending on your experience and interests, your work could range from analysing and visualising data through to developing data pipelines, models and analytical solutions. The role provides scope to develop across the wider data lifecycle rather than being restricted to one narrow specialism. We're interested in people with strong capability in some areas and an appetite to develop in others.

Here's What You'll Need

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
  • Experience working with data to solve real-world problems.
  • Ability to interrogate, manipulate and interpret datasets.
  • Good understanding of data structures and data quality.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Strong stakeholder and team-working skills.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and techniques.
  • A Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or another relevant discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working in a data, analytical, scientific, engineering or similar technical role.
  • Experience of delivering within projects or programmes would be advantageous.
  • Defence, government or other highly regulated-sector experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain SC clearance.

You don't need to tick every box.

Our Culture

Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration. We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work. When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful.

title: Developer Pulse Programming Clinical MRI
description:
Job Title

Developer Pulse Programming Clinical MRI

Job Description

As a Pulse Programming Developer within the MR R&D department, you will contribute to Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) pulse sequence development, translating novel concepts into robust product solutions for clinical MR applications. You will work with an international team of software developers to innovate and continuously improve our MRI products.



Your role:

  • Developing, adapting and innovating MR pulse sequences to enable new clinical contrasts and improve image quality, clinical functionality and usability.
  • Bringing clinical MR features from research stage through advanced development to the market.
  • Translating clinical and technical needs into product requirements, prototyping and demonstrating feasibility. Creating software designs aligned with product requirements and software architecture. Engineering concepts into robust product solutions, including implementation, automated testing and verification.
  • Delivering product quality software and documentation in accordance with the standards for the medical device industry, including risk management, requirements and testing.
  • Taking end-to-end technical responsibility for MR features from concept through implementation, ensuring the complete solution meets image quality and clinical workflow needs.
  • Investigating root causes of customer complaints.
  • Contributing to regulatory clearance of new products.
  • Operating in a strong cross-functional setting across globally distributed business disciplines, like hardware, software, system integration and verification, marketing, and product application.
  • Maintaining and sharing knowledge on innovation of MR physics applications.
  • Contributing to invention disclosures.
  • Engaging with multiple stakeholders to drive feature development that meets technical, user, clinical and business needs.


You are part of

The Magnetic Resonance (MR) Business Unit within Philips Healthcare, contributing to the development and lifecycle management of our clinical MRI portfolio. Within the global MR R&D organization, you will join the MR Domain Software team, a diverse group of around 80 engineers, including MR physicists, biomedical engineers, reconstruction experts and software engineers.


Based in Best, the Netherlands, you will work closely with the Scanning team, bringing together deep expertise in MR imaging, spectroscopy and software engineering. Together, the team is committed to developing robust MR sequences that support reliable, high-quality imaging for every patient.


Want to learn more about the people and innovation behind our MR technology? Discover the Innovation spotlight, explore our work on multi-contrast 4D MR imaging for radiotherapy simulation and read about advances in MRI speed and precision with SmartSpeed Precise.


To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Physics, (Biomedical) Engineering, MR-related science or a related field, combined with 3+ years of experience in MRI.
  • In-depth understanding of MR physics and pulse sequences, gained through academic research and/or experience within the medical device industry.
  • Proven experience adapting pulse sequence software using programming languages such as C++, Python or other object-oriented programming languages.
  • Experience with modern software engineering practices, including automation, code reviews, CI/CD, maintainability and testing.
  • Hands-on experience developing, testing and evaluating MR techniques on MRI systems, including image-quality assessment and clinical MR applications.
  • Understanding of risk management and regulatory documentation within a highly regulated environment.
  • Experience using AI, data science, GPU computing or cloud technologies within development workflows and/or for sequence optimization.
  • Creative and innovative mindset, demonstrated through, for example, patents, scientific publications, research or product development.
  • Strong focus on delivering high-quality software, combined with a quality and customer-focused mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Ability to manage priorities and work effectively in a complex development environment.
  • Eagerness to learn, experiment and translate advanced concepts and rapid prototypes into robust product solutions.
  • Experience in the healthcare industry would be an advantage.
  • Ability to lead others as a technical expert within a project would be an advantage.


Compensation & benefits

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is EUR 50,750.00 - EUR 79,750.00. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for 3% short term incentive with your rewards linked to both individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Benefits include hybrid working, paid time-off, health and wellbeing benefits, learning and development opportunities.


How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

title: Finance Business Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The ERDM (Enterprise Reporting and Data Management) Business Analyst is responsible for ensuring that Sales & Finance AI solutions operate with the highest levels of trust, accuracy, control, and compliance.

We are seeking a detail-obsessed, data driven expert to serve as the guardian of accuracy for our Sales & Finance AI chat assistants. You will design validation frameworks, partner with data engineering teams, and ensure every metric the AI surfaces - especially Bookings and Revenue - is accurate, consistent, and trustworthy. You will lead incident response on any data accuracy or hallucination even

The role also serves as the bridge between Finance users and technical development teams. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into AI-enabled solutions and ensuring that Finance AI capabilities align with business goals and leadership needs.

Job Requirements

Requirements & Solution Definition:
- Gather and document Finance business requirements through interviews, workshops and feedback; write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria
- Ensure requirements reflect metric integrity standards and executive-readiness expectations

AI Quality Assurance:
- Develop and maintain AI testing frameworks: test scenarios, expected outputs, edge cases, pass/fail criteria
- Define quality standards for AI responses: accuracy, completeness, formatting, tone, contextual relevance
- Validate AI outputs against Snowflake data using SQL; confirm Bookings and Revenue match official Finance reporting
- Run UAT, regression and release testing for every feature, prompt update, data refresh or model change
- Coordinate business sign-off with Finance stakeholders before production release

Hallucination Prevention:
- Design validation tests for fabricated data, incorrect metric associations, misleading trends and unsupported narratives
- Catalog high-risk use cases: multi-step calculations, YoY comparisons, segment breakdowns, forecast vs. actuals
- Monitor response quality through periodic spot-checks and audits
- Escalate suspected hallucinations to the Data Accuracy Specialist (IC4) and team lead; work with IT/Engineering on fixes and guardrails

Executive Use Cases:
- Support design and testing of executive use cases and prompt frameworks for C-suite and SVP users
- Verify that curated queries, guided flows and personalized dashboards produce accurate, polished outputs
- Identify ways to make the executive experience more intuitive, actionable and insightful

Adoption & Change Management:
- Develop adoption strategies, from awareness through daily active use
- Lead user onboarding: guided walkthroughs, sandbox environments, office hours
- Deliver training (live demos, workshops, drop-in sessions) for analysts, managers and directors
- Manage communications: release notes, feature announcements, known issues, adoption progress reports
- Collect and synthesize user feedback through surveys, interviews and usage analytics

Education & Experience

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree Required
  • 7+ years in Business Analysis / Finance Analytics / FP&A Operations
  • Experience with AI-powered tools, chatbots, or conversational AI interfaces
  • Understanding of Finance metrics and rep orting (Bookings, Revenue, or related areas)
  • Working knowledge of SQL and Snowflake
  • Understanding of AI/LLM fundamentals - how large language models retrieve, process, and present information; awareness of common failure modes (hallucination, data staleness, context window limitations)
  • Prompt Engineering Certificate or related experience

title: Oracle OCI DBA
description:
