Senior Oracle DBA – Cloud Migrations, Upgrades & APEX Specialist

We are seeking an experienced Oracle DBA to architect, install and maintain Oracle Database infrastructure in on-prem and cloud infrastructgure. In this role, you will be Orchestrating the lift-and-shift of legacy databases, executing structural database upgrades (e.g., non-CDB to multitenant CDB/PDB), configuring enterprise-grade Oracle APEX environments, and tuning cloud data engines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical planning and execution of database migrations from on-premises datacenters to OCI DB Systems, and Autonomous Databases.
  • Install, configure and administer Oracle Database System in on-prem (or) Cloud infrastructure.
  • Support and Tune production and non-prod Oracle Databases.
  • Minimize business impact during massive cutovers by implementing Oracle Zero Downtime Migration (ZDM), Oracle GoldenGate (logical replication), and optimized Oracle Data Pump architectures.
  • Execute major database upgrades (e.g., upgrading legacy 12c or 11g environments to Oracle 19c, 23c, or 26ai). Drive the transformation from traditional architectures into Container Databases (CDB) and Pluggable Databases (PDB).
  • APEX Environment Provisioning: Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle APEX instances across development, test, and production environments within CDB/PDB architectures.
  • Partner with the cloud infrastructure engineer to instantiate, patch, configure, and scale cloud database services natively launched via OCI or directly mapped through the Oracle Database Service for Azure (ODSA).
  • Set up cross-cloud or cross-region Disaster Recovery environments utilizing Oracle Data Guard and Active Data Guard.
  • Setup and verify backup/recovery integrating RMAN with OCI Object Storage for both database files and APEX application metadata.
  • Perform deep-dive SQL tuning, AWR/ASH analysis, and memory/I/O tuning to resolve post-migration performance discrepancies.
  • Diagnose and optimize performance bottlenecks specifically impacting heavy APEX web applications and ORDS connection pools.
  • Lead, participate, build and assist Functional and Developers for designing and developing the Archival, custom OLTP and reporting schema and applications for ERP solutions.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 8+ years as an Oracle Database Administrator, featuring a proven track record of managing at least 3 major enterprise-scale database migrations to the cloud and managing production-grade APEX instances.
  • 8+ years of Deep-dive mastery of Oracle Database architectures, CDB/PDB structures, Oracle ZDM, Data Pump, Transportable Tablespaces, and Oracle Recovery Manager (RMAN).
  • 3 years of knowledge and experience of Oracle APEX (architecture and administration), ORDS configuration, Tomcat/WebLogic deployment, and RESTful web service security.
  • Production experience managing databases hosted on OCI DB Systems, Autonomous Database (ATP), and Exadata Cloud Infrastructure.
  • 3 to 5 years of Experience in working with PeopleSoft or other ERP solutions.
  • Preferred Certifications:
    • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) – Oracle Database 19c/23c
    • Oracle Cloud Database Service Specialist
    • Oracle APEX Cloud Developer Certified Professional (a strong plus for understanding the application layer)

title: Medicare Sales Technology Product Owner
description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Aetna Medicare Technology is seeking a Product Owner to translate customer, business, operational, and regulatory needs into prioritized product work that improves Medicare sales, shopping, enrollment, and agent experiences. This role owns the team backlog, defines clear and testable requirements, and guides work from discovery through release and production validation. The Product Owner partners closely with Product Management, business stakeholders, experience design, engineering, architecture, data, quality assurance, operations, and vendors to deliver measurable customer and business value.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog in alignment with product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer and agent needs, regulatory commitments, operational priorities, and technology dependencies.
  • Translate product objectives into executable work by defining and decomposing epics, features, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and measurable success criteria.
  • Lead backlog refinement and delivery readiness, ensuring work is valuable, feasible, testable, appropriately scoped, and ready for sprint commitment.
  • Partner in discovery and solution design to understand user problems, evaluate options and trade-offs, and document workflows, decision logic, data needs, and end-to-end requirements.
  • Guide Agile delivery and release execution by actively supporting sprint planning, reviews, demonstrations, testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, post-release validation, and defect prioritization.
  • Accept completed work when defined acceptance criteria, intended outcomes, and quality expectations have been met.
  • Balance competing priorities across product features, regulatory and compliance work, production support, technical debt, defects, infrastructure, and time-sensitive business needs.
  • Serve as the day-to-day product contact for assigned capabilities, providing timely decisions and maintaining alignment across business partners, delivery teams, and vendors.
  • Communicate decisions, dependencies, risks, scope changes, and delivery progress clearly, including during high-stakes releases and Annual Enrollment Period readiness.
  • Challenge assumptions and facilitate decisions using customer insights, operational knowledge, delivery data, and business value rather than simply fulfilling stakeholder requests.

REQUIRED SKILLS:

· 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or digital product delivery, including ownership across the product lifecycle.

· 3+ years of Agile product delivery experience, including backlog prioritization, feature decomposition, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release planning.

· Strong product judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and translate customer and business needs into actionable product work.

· Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing needs and make sound decisions while balancing business value, regulatory requirements, dependencies, risk, and delivery capacity.

· Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive decisions across business and technology teams without direct authority.

· Adaptable and accountable self-starter who can navigate ambiguity, changing priorities, and high-stakes delivery while maintaining focus on broader product outcomes.

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

· Ability to work core business hours aligned with Eastern Time-based teams and stakeholders.

PREFERRED SKILLS:

· Experience in health insurance or another highly regulated industry, with Medicare experience preferred.

· Experience with CRM, sales or agent enablement, digital shopping and enrollment, contact-center, or customer engagement solutions.

· Experience supporting Annual Enrollment Period readiness, release governance, operational readiness, or other time-sensitive regulated delivery cycles.

· Experience establishing or maturing Agile product practices and working with Jira.

· Experience working across interconnected enterprise and vendor platforms and understanding end-to-end customer journeys and dependencies.

· CSPO, SAFe POPM, Certified Product Manager, or comparable product or Agile certification.

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$101,970.00 - $203,940.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.


Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

title: Solutions Engineer 5 - Content Promotion & Distribution
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


You will join Content Promotion and Distribution, the team responsible for driving global content ingestion across Netflix. Our platform authenticates incoming submissions, orchestrates metadata, video, artwork, and availability across downstream services, and ensures partner deliverables are validated and conformed for seamless streaming to our members.


About the Team

Behind every title a member streams is a complex content supply chain. We focus on the front door to that supply chain. Content partners deliver metadata, artwork, and media to Netflix through it, and it validates and processes that content on its way to launch. As Netflix expands into new content types and deal structures, we make delivering to Netflix the easiest part of a partner's day.


Solutions Engineers accelerate partner integrations, help partners launch with confidence, and keep them running smoothly at scale. You'll sit between Engineering and the partner-facing Operations and Support teams. You'll work hands-on with partners, and you'll fix the friction you find so the next partner doesn't hit it.


This is one of the first Solutions Engineer roles for our team. You'll help define how the function works.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate prospective partners for technical fit, lead early deep dives, and establish clear integration roadmaps prior to onboarding.
  • Guide partners through onboarding and content delivery, untangling schema mismatches or hierarchy errors, crafting lightweight custom solutions when standard tools fall short, and shipping targeted improvements to unblock launches.
  • Develop targeted scripting, internal tools, and operational documentation to streamline remediation and enhance platform observability.
  • Educate internal stakeholders and external teams on platform capabilities, while refining integration guides and scalable workflows.
  • Act as the primary technical escalation point post-launch, tuning observability infrastructure and supporting partner-specific tools.
  • Identify recurring friction points and ship small, high-leverage improvements that reduce manual steps and issues per launch, using light scripting and automation to resolve issues at scale and build custom solutions that reduce the need for bespoke engineering work.
  • Bring well-evidenced defects and roadmap needs to core engineering with a clear ask, and represent partners' technical needs in product and engineering discussions, so new deals don't become bespoke one-offs.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience integrating or supporting external partners on REST APIs. You're fluent with curl, Postman, or similar, and comfortable debugging JSON payloads and request/response flows.
  • Strong, structured troubleshooting skills. You can reason through a workflow end-to-end, use logs, dashboards, and traces to isolate a fault, and escalate with evidence and a concrete next step.
  • Working proficiency in Python or Java, and SQL. You can write scripts and queries, and read and debug an existing codebase well enough to make small, integration-specific changes.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences. You can turn ambiguous partner requests into concrete technical plans and keep stakeholders informed during incidents.
  • Comfort doing manual, human-in-the-loop work to unblock a partner. You recognize when a workaround is needed and tell engineers what to automate.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, documentation, and support, with real examples of results.
  • Curiosity, ownership, and empathy for partners. You care more about a partner's successful launch than about which tool got them there.
  • Experience with workflow or pipeline systems, or with media or metadata ingestion, is a plus. Experience in media, entertainment, or streaming is a plus.
  • Plus: Familiarity with digital image specs, media file formats and delivery workflows.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful impact. The systems you support are foundational to how content reaches members around the world.
  • Responsibility. Netflix offers true transparency and autonomy. Our culture is unique and is key to how we innovate.
  • Stunning colleagues. You'll work with high-performing peers across engineering, product and operations who value collaboration.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $270,000.00 - $420,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

title: Co-op - Biological Safety Engineering - Murrysville, PA - January-June 2027
description:
Job Title

Co-op - Biological Safety Engineering - Murrysville, PA - January-June 2027

Job Description

Are you interested in a co-op opportunity with Philips? We welcome individuals who are currently pursuing an undergraduate (BS) and/or graduate (MS) or PhD degree to participate in 6 month paid co-op opportunities at our site in Murrysville, PA. Through this role you will gain meaningful, hands-on experience working for a HealthTech company.


Your role:

As a Co-op Biological Safety Engineer within the Biocompatibility Group, you will contribute directly to the design and development of new respiratory care products—including CPAPs, ventilators, respiratory masks, drug delivery devices, oxygen concentrators, and respiratory care accessories.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Supporting biological safety evaluations of materials, components, and finished devices used in sleep and respiratory care products, under direct supervision.
  • Assisting in reviewing material composition data, supplier documentation, and manufacturing process information to support biological risk assessments and compliance with ISO 10993, ISO 18562, and other related medical device regulatory standards.
  • Conducting verification and validation testing, analyzing material stability, and providing data to guide product development decisions.
  • Organizing, tracking, and curating biological safety data and test reports to ensure traceability and accessibility for ongoing and future evaluations.
  • Contributing to the development of Biological Evaluation Plans (BEPs) and Biological Evaluation Reports (BERs) by compiling background data, drafting sections, and ensuring adherence to applicable standards and company policies.

You're the right fit if:

  • You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s/PhD degree in Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Materials Science & Engineering, or Chemical Engineering.
  • Your skills include strong engineering principals as well as analyzing chemical and physical properties of materials to draw scientific conclusions.
  • You’ve acquired 2+ years of experience in University and/or previous internships or coops and you are comfortable using test instrumentation and equipment in and out of a lab environment.
  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and can work effectively across technical disciplines, external partners, and global teams.

title: Fitness Center Coordinator (Part-Time)
description:
JR286 is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented part-time Fitness Center Coordinator to oversee the daily operations of our state-of-the-art fitness center during evening hours. This is a part-time position of approximately 29 hours per week. The role requires strong customer service skills, a keen eye for facility maintenance, and an understanding of the sports industry. The Fitness Center Coordinator will be responsible for ensuring a seamless experience for our athletes by maintaining a clean, organized, and well-equipped facility while assisting with various operational tasks as needed.

What You’ll Do:

Facility Operations & Maintenance

  • Open and close the fitness center according to operational hours and safety protocols.
  • Conduct routine inspections and spot checks on equipment to ensure proper functionality and safety.
  • Perform light cleaning duties, including wiping down equipment, ensuring locker rooms and recovery areas are tidy, and replenishing hygiene supplies.
  • Assist in coordinating maintenance and repairs with the appropriate vendors or internal teams.

Customer Service and Athlete Support

  • Greet and assist athletes, staff, and guests, providing an exceptional customer service experience.
  • Monitor locker rooms and recovery rooms to maintain a professional and welcoming environment.
  • Support athletes with basic facility-related needs and ensure they have the necessary equipment.
  • Uphold high ethical standards and discretion when dealing with high-level athletes.

Administration and Scheduling

  • Assist in scheduling daily activities and events within the fitness center.
  • Maintain records of equipment usage, incident reports, and facility maintenance needs.
  • Help coordinate special projects or initiatives as assigned by management.

description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary


This is a full-time field-based telework position, in Ohio. This position requires the ability to travel within the assigned region of Central and Southeast Ohio to member homes and other requested member locations, up to 50% or more of the time.

Applicants may reside within the Central/SE care coordination region of Ohio. Strongly prefers candidates to reside in one of the following counties: Athens, Ashland, Coshocton, Delaware, Fairfield, Fayette, Franklin, Gallia, Guernsey, Highland, Hocking, Holmes, Knox, Jackson, Licking, Meigs, Morgan, Morrow, Muskingum, Noble, Perry, Pickaway, Pike, Ross, Richland, Vinton, Washington, Wayne

Monday-Friday 8-5pm with flexibility needed to work later to meet member needs.


Business Overview

As part of the bold vision to deliver the “Next Generation” of managed care in Ohio Medicaid, OhioRISE will help struggling children and their families by focusing on the individual with strong coordination and partnership among MCOs, vendors, and ODM to support specialization in addressing critical needs. The OhioRISE Program is designed to provide comprehensive and highly coordinated behavioral health services for children with serious/complex behavioral health needs involved in, or at risk for involvement in, multiple child-serving systems.


The Case Management Coordinator utilizes critical thinking and judgment to collaborate and inform the case management process, in order to facilitate appropriate healthcare outcomes for members by providing care coordination, support and education for members through the use of care management tools and resources. Must reside in Ohio.


Fundamental Components:

• Be clinically and culturally competent/responsive with training and experience necessary to manage complex cases in the community across child-serving systems.


• Evaluation of Members:

o Through the use of care management tools and information/data review, conducts comprehensive evaluation of referred member's needs/eligibility and recommends an approach to case resolution and/or meeting needs by evaluating member's benefit plan and available internal and external programs/services. Identifies high risk factors and service needs that may impact member outcomes and care planning components with appropriate referral to clinical case management or crisis intervention as appropriate.

o Coordinates and implements assigned care plan activities and monitors care plan progress.


• Enhancement of Medical Appropriateness and Quality of Care:

o Using holistic approach consults with case managers, supervisors, Medical Directors and/or other health/behavioral health programs to overcome barriers to meeting goals and objectives; presents cases at case conferences to obtain multidisciplinary review in order to achieve optimal outcomes.

o Works collaboratively with the members' Child and Family Teams.

o Identifies and escalates quality of care issues through established channels.

o Utilizes negotiation skills to secure appropriate options and services necessary to meet the member's benefits and/or healthcare needs.

o Utilizes influencing/ motivational interviewing skills to ensure maximum member engagement and promote lifestyle/behavior changes to achieve optimum level of health.

o Provides coaching, information, and support to empower the member to make ongoing independent medical and/or healthy lifestyle choices.

o Helps member actively and knowledgably participate with their provider in healthcare decision-making.

o Serves a single point of contact for members and assist members to remediate immediate and acute gaps in care and access.


• Monitoring, Evaluation and Documentation of Care:

o Utilizes case management and quality management processes in compliance with regulatory and accreditation guidelines and company policies and procedures.



Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or non-licensed master level clinician required

• 2+ years of experience in behavioral health, social services, or human services

• 2+ years of experience with personal computers, keyboard and multi-system navigation, and MS Office Suite applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, SharePoint).

• 2+ years of experience in children's mental health, child welfare, developmental disabilities, juvenile justice, or a public sector human services or behavioral health care field, providing community-based services to children and youth, and their family/caregivers.

• 2+ years experience in one or more of the following areas of expertise: family systems, community systems and resources, case management, child and family counseling/therapy, child protection, or child development.

• 2+ year of experience with Ohio delivery systems, including local community networks and resources.

• Willing and able to travel within the assigned region up to 50% of the time; Some travel to the New Albany office may be required for trainings/meetings:

• Reliable transportation required

• Mileage is reimbursed per our company expense reimbursement policy

• Willing and able to work beyond core business hours of Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm, as needed.


Preferred Qualifications

• Case management and discharge planning experience.

• Managed Care experience.

• Medicaid experience.



Education

Bachelor’s degree or non-licensed master level clinician required, with either degree being in behavioral health, human services, health services, or public health preferred. (i.e. psychology, social work, marriage and family therapy, counseling, juvenile justice).

40

title: Foreign Pharmacy Grad - International Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate, after successfully passing FPGEE and TOEFL, you will be eligible to complete your required US Internship hours and apply your didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a mixed modality learning plan designed to further develop your knowledge, skills, and abilities. US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates are required to successfully complete their internship within 18 months and be prepared to complete and pass all required Pharmacist licensure exams and processes within 120-days of the completion of required US Internship hours.

Through your hands-on experience, training roadmap, Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), and time spent with leaders in your district, you will deepen your understanding of and participate in pharmacy practice and patient care scenarios, build business acumen to understand how to improve pharmacy performance, and develop leadership skills to learn how to engage the pharmacy team and drive business outcomes. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

A US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Foreign Graduate from a Non-US Accredited college or school of pharmacy prior to beginning US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate Training Program at CVS
  • FPGEC certification
  • Pharmacist licensure in the state in which the position is based within 120 days of completion of US Intern hours. Failure to complete required US Intern hours within 18 months, or to obtain Pharmacist licensure as prescribed, will result in separation of employment.
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs. and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs. and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:


$30.00 - $42.00


Whether in our pharmacies or through our health service offerings, we are pioneering a bold new approach to total health care. As health care innovators, we are making quality care affordable, accessible, simple and seamless. We await your fresh ideas, new perspectives, and the unique contributions you will make to our organization.

title: Pharmacy Intern - Grad
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Graduate Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a Graduate Pharmacy Intern, you will apply your didactic learning from pharmacy school and pharmacy practice into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor and District Leader, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap within 120 days of graduation designed to further your knowledge of store, district, and regional operations. Through your hands-on experience, training roadmap, and time spent with leaders in your district you will deepen your understanding of patient safety and error prevention, quality assurance drug utilization review (DUR), pharmacy professional standards such as corresponding responsibility and red flag detection. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

As tenure and readiness increase, you will take on greater accountability for supporting the management, oversight, and operations within the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the Graduate Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about vaccines and answering questions to obtain informed consent
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • PharmD graduate of a U.S. accredited program prior to beginning the Post-Graduate Training Program at CVS Health
  • Ability to obtain required pharmacist licensure within the required timeframe, per state guidelines. Failure to obtain required Pharmacist licensure within 120 days of graduation will result in separation of employment.
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, pharmacy interns should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:


$24.25 - $42.00


Whether in our pharmacies or through our health service offerings, we are pioneering a bold new approach to total health care. As health care innovators, we are making quality care affordable, accessible, simple and seamless. We await your fresh ideas, new perspectives, and the unique contributions you will make to our organization.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.


Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

title: Managing Partner - PBR Vivo!
description:
From the toughest sport on dirt comes Miami's most stunning country bar. Live country and southern rock bring the PBR party to Vivo! Throw in cold beer, hard drinks, and a little bull ridin' and its every cowboy and cowgirl's nighttime oasis.

Managing Partner Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Control the day-to-day operations of the venue within the policies and guidelines set forth by the company.
  • Maintain a professional company image, including restaurant and bar cleanliness, proper uniforms and appearance standards.
  • Manage service contracts with outside vendors, including consulting agreements, including all third-party entertainment vendors, as well as Entertainment Director if applicable.
  • Preparation of Ops Statements and other financial disclosures and taking appropriate actions.
  • Control Profit & Loss by following cash control/security procedures, maintaining inventory, managing labor, reviewing financial reports and taking appropriate actions to include maintaining appropriate stock of liquor, beer and other bar or restaurant products.
  • Ensure the daily deposits have been deposited, safe counts conducted and venue's cash is secured at all times.
  • Maintain cost of goods sold, nightly comps, nightly recap reports and safe audits by overseeing inventory counts.
  • Respond to customer service needs to provide the highest standards of service.
  • Complete financial and personnel/payroll related administrative duties accurately, on time and in accordance with company policies.
  • Recruit, interview and hire team management members; train, supervise and motivate; take disciplinary action and terminate team management members when necessary.
  • Ensure all staff is properly trained and have the tools and equipment needed to effectively carry out their job functions.
  • Ensure a safe working and guest environment to reduce the risk of injury and accidents.
  • Representing the venue in a professional manner to the community-at-large, including local businesses, civic organizations, and media.

Managing Partner Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required; 4 year college degree or equivalent with course work in restaurant management, preferred.
  • At least 5 years' experience in restaurant/nightclub management, multi-unit management a plus, and have proven ability to thrive in such environment.
  • Must speak fluent English, other languages preferred.
  • Good people management skills, communication and listening skills.
  • Proven ability to lead a team and communicate efficiently, both verbally and in writing.
  • Must be flexible and adaptable to change.
  • Demonstrated time management and organizational skills.
  • Must be internally motivated and detail oriented and have a passion for teaching others.
  • Exceptional time management and organization skills.
  • Ability to work a flexible work schedule to include evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.

The Managing Partner position requires the ability to perform the following:

  • Carrying or lifting items weighing up to 75 pounds.
  • Moving about the venue safely and efficiently.
  • Handling food, objects, products and utensils.
  • Bending, stooping and kneeling.

Compensation: The compensation range for this position is $75,000 - $85,000 + bonus. Eligible employees are entitled to a comprehensive benefits package following the required eligibility period, which includes:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Personal and vacation time
  • 401(k) plan with employer match

title: Senior Business Consultant
description:
Transportbedrijven staan voor grote veranderingen. Digitalisering, SaaS, data, integraties, automatisering en AI bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden. Maar technologie alleen lost niets op. Het begint met begrijpen hoe een klant werkt, waar processen vastlopen, welke verandering nodig is en waar werkelijk waarde kan worden toegevoegd.

Daarom zoeken wij een Senior Business Consultant Transport voor onze locatie in Hoogeveen. Iemand die niet begint met onze software, maar met de business van de klant.

Wat ga je doen?

Jij doorgrondt logistieke processen, ziet kansen en krijgt organisaties in beweging.

Hoe kunnen transportorganisaties slimmer, efficiënter en toekomstbestendiger werken? Als Senior Business Consultant Transport help jij onze klanten om die stap te zetten. Je bent een strategische gesprekspartner voor planners, key-users, IT, operations en management. Je begrijpt hun processen en uitdagingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen en slimme oplossingen.

Je kijkt verder dan de technologie alleen. Je onderzoekt wat een organisatie écht nodig heeft en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen niet alleen worden bedacht en geïmplementeerd, maar ook daadwerkelijk worden omarmd en toegepast.

Welke werkzaamheden kan je verder verwachten?

  • Analyseren en optimaliseren van transport- en logistieke processen.

  • Leiden van workshops en adviseren van klanten over procesverbetering en digitalisering.

  • Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete requirements en oplossingsrichtingen.

  • Adviseren over SaaS, integraties, data, automatisering en AI.

  • Begeleiden van verandertrajecten, van analyse en advies tot implementatie en adoptie.

  • Creëren van draagvlak en meenemen van stakeholders op alle niveaus.

  • Signaleren en ontwikkelen van commerciële kansen en bijdragen aan demo's, offertes en businesscases.

  • Vertalen van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar nieuwe toepassingen, samen met Product Owners en de business.

  • Delen van kennis en coachen van collega-consultants.

Meer dan alleen consultancy

We zoeken geen consultant die zich uitsluitend richt op software of configuraties. We zoeken iemand die de vraag achter de vraag ontdekt, processen durft uit te dagen en klanten helpt écht stappen vooruit te zetten.

Je combineert inhoudelijke expertise met commercieel inzicht. Doordat je dicht bij de klant staat, herken je kansen voor aanvullende oplossingen en dienstverlening. Je weet deze te vertalen naar concrete meerwaarde voor de klant en onze organisatie.

Technologie én mensen in beweging brengen

Je hebt affiniteit met technologie en volgt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van SaaS, API's, data, automatisering en AI. Je hoeft geen developer te zijn, maar weet technologische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar praktische toepassingen.

Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat succesvolle verandering begint bij mensen. Je herkent verschillende belangen, maakt weerstand bespreekbaar en weet organisaties mee te nemen in een nieuwe manier van werken. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan de go-live: het gaat om daadwerkelijk gebruik en blijvend resultaat.

Jij adviseert niet alleen hoe het beter kan, maar zorgt ervoor dat het ook écht beter wordt.

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als senior business consultant rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de €4.200,- en €5.000,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag en een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,25 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

  • hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau;

  • ruime ervaring als business consultant, businessanalist, solution consultant of in een vergelijkbare rol;

  • aantoonbare affiniteit met of ervaring in transport en logistiek;

  • ervaring met verandermanagement, stakeholdermanagement en gebruikersadoptie;

  • het vermogen om zelfstandig bedrijfsprocessen te analyseren en te verbeteren;

  • de senioriteit om gemakkelijk te schakelen tussen operatie, IT, management en directie;

  • ervaring met workshops, interviews, analyses en presentaties;

  • het vermogen om weerstand te herkennen en om te zetten in betrokkenheid;

  • commerciële nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om kansen om te zetten naar een concreet vervolg;

  • interesse in technologische ontwikkelingen en hun praktische toepassing;

  • het vermogen om complexe onderwerpen eenvoudig en overtuigend uit te leggen;

  • de drive om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en collega’s inhoudelijk sterker te maken.

Kennis van onze producten is mooi meegenomen, maar niet doorslaggevend. Productkennis kunnen we je leren. Analytisch vermogen, nieuwsgierigheid, veranderkracht en het vermogen om een klant echt verder te helpen vinden we belangrijker.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter Kimberley Vermeulen via +31 6 1072 4584 of via kimberley.vermeulen@centric.eu.


Hier starten jouw kansen
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 300 collega’s van Centric Retail & Logistiek. Als partner van bedrijven binnen Retail, Logistiek, Transport, Bouw en Financiële instellingen zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat magazijnen goed gevuld blijven, supermarkten en winkels bevoorraad worden en honderdduizenden klanten hun dagelijkse boodschappen en andere aankopen naadloos kunnen afrekenen. Maar ook dat vrachtwagens zo optimaal mogelijk beladen en geoptimaliseerde routes rijden, bouwbedrijven inzicht hebben in hun projectplanning en resources en dat financiële instellingen snel kredietrisico’s kunnen inschatten met onze risk solutions. Kortom, een rol binnen Centric Retail & Logistiek geeft je de mogelijkheid om een concrete bijdrage te leveren aan sectoren die impact hebben en maken op de maatschappij!

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

title: Global Systems Engineering Leader, SRC
description:
Job Title

Global Systems Engineering Leader, SRC

Job Description

Job Responsibilities:


The Global Systems Engineering Leader formulates a long-term vision for the Systems Engineering group within the Sleep and Respiratory Care business, and manages capabilities of the department to ensure that business objectives can be met as it pertains to Systems engineering, technology and product development.

The Global Systems Engineering Leader role is a people leader with direct responsibility for development and growth of their teams, is a champion of the Philips Culture and is expected to drive change across the organization. This role drives continuous improvement of systems engineering processes in the team and strives for efficiency and the highest standards of quality in everything the team does. This role has responsibility for a global team of Systems Engineers of approximately 100–200 employees, led through a small number of Directors and other people leaders. The organization is expected to be globally distributed, with significant teams in the United States and India. The role reports directly to the Head of R&D of the Sleep and Respiratory Care business.

Key Areas of Responsibility


As a member of the R&D Leadership Team, determines in consultation with the Leadership Team, the Global Systems team’s objectives, policies, processes and budgets on short and long term, makes sure that the organization can meet the objectives and ensures that the roles and responsibilities are put in place.


  • Formulates and implements long-term vision/direction/strategy steering the group to add maximum value to the business in the future.
  • Manages the department’s capabilities by maintaining a long-term view of the competencies, knowledge, resources and tools required to introduce new technology. Provides functional ownership of Systems Engineering standards, methods and architecture, and builds and maintains the department’s technical depth and expertise.
  • Ensures effective people management, including recruitment, staffing, performance reviews, education, training and leadership development, while fostering an engaged, innovative and inspiring environment through coaching, entrepreneurship and employee growth.
  • Is co-responsible for achieving operational plans, guides Project Managers/Leaders and ensures the optimal allocation of personnel to the projects and effective project management.
  • Builds strong cross-functional and external relationships with department heads, programs, the business and scientific partners to shape strategies and project proposals, monitor technological developments, and identify trends and opportunities.
  • Knows the customers well and uses that knowledge in the role.

What you would need to be successful for the role:


  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Biomedical Engineering or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • 15+ years of relevant experience in a regulated environment; medical or biotechnology experience preferred.
  • Prior experience leading systems engineering organizations of comparable scale (100+FTE).
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners beyond R&D, including Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Marketing, Operations and Service.
  • Strong demonstrated ability to coach and motivate a team and build strong cultures in line with Philips Behaviors.
  • Expert knowledge of product development for consumer propositions, preferably medical consumer propositions
  • Proven experience in defining an innovation strategy with deep insights to engineering, architecture and research.

title: Work Broker
description:
Req ID: 391648

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Work Broker to join our team in Pearl Harbor, Hawaii (US-HI), United States (US).

Job Summary:

Directs, coordinates, and schedules the repair and maintenance for assigned home ported and deployed submarine units during in port maintenance and voyage repairs. Provide technical expertise in submarine mechanical, electrical, electronic repair including SUBSAFE requirements, seawater systems, steam system, atmosphere control, Radio, Radar, Navigation, Sonar, Fire Control, and electric plant equipment. Confers with management and other department heads to plan preventive maintenance programs and to schedule inspections in coordination with other operating activities. Monitor, review and process all work requests from assigned units, and work with assigned units and repair facility to develop and create the availability critical path work schedule. Track all critical path work during availabilities. Prepare and present presentations to the maintenance team for availability and voyage repair planning.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
    • High School Diploma + 4 additional years of experience = Associate's Degree
    • Associate's Degree + 4 additional years of experience = Bachelor's Degree
  • Minimum 8 years of experience with FMP management practices and a thorough knowledge of automated modernization information systems applicable to K, KP and D SHIPALTS and SHIPALT contractor and installation activities.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience with submarine maintenance, IMA, or submarine repair.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience interpreting and implementing a broad range of management policies in automated modernization management systems.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with Submarine Material Office (N4 Squadron, FMA, NSSC, Shipyard or higher) experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience using the Submarine Modernization and Readiness Tool (SMART) imbedded in the Navy Tool for Interoperability and Risk Assessment (NITRA) as required to support modernization.
  • Active Secret Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Preferably, prior Submarine Material office (N4 Squadron, FMA, or NSSC) experience.
  • Experience in developing submarine work procedures and test equipment certification requirements.
  • Knowledgeable in the operation of submarine systems and equipment. Knowledgeable of JFMM, SUBSAFE/SOC requirements, and submarine repair instructions.
  • Proficient with computer skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, and Project).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving ability.

title: MR Systems Engineer/Architect
description:
Job Title

MR Systems Engineer/Architect

Job Description

Job Description

As a MR Systems Architect/Engineer, you will play a key role in driving system definition, design integration, risk management, and technical problem solving for Philips MR products. You will work across global and local R&D teams to translate system-level requirements into subsystem and component requirements, ensuring product quality, reliability, regulatory compliance, and successful product delivery.

You will serve as a critical technical interface between Global System Engineering, System Architects, and component development teams, contributing to the development of next-generation MR systems.

Key Responsibilities

System Engineering & Architecture

  • Analyze, define, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Drive requirement decomposition from system level to subsystem and component level.

  • Support system architecture design and overall system integration activities.

  • Ensure component designs comply with system requirements and product objectives.

  • Evaluate system performance and reliability through data analysis and engineering methodologies.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead technical reviews, design reviews, and feasibility studies.

  • Provide technical guidance throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Make design recommendations that improve product reliability, performance, and user experience.

  • Support concept exploration, system definition, design verification, issue investigation, and continuous improvement activities.

Risk & Quality Management

  • Lead FMEA and risk management activities.

  • Drive defect management and root cause analysis.

  • Investigate technical issues and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and quality standards.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Global System Engineering teams, System Architects, PMO, subsystem teams, and component development teams.

  • Influence stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple functions and locations.

  • Facilitate effective communication and decision making throughout development programs.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in:

    • Electrical Engineering

    • Electronic Engineering

    • Mechanical Engineering

    • Computer Science

    • Biomedical Engineering

    • Or related engineering disciplines.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in MR Systems Engineering or related medical imaging product development.

  • Solid experience in system design, system integration, and product development.

  • Hands-on experience in risk management, technical problem solving, and reliability engineering.

  • Experience working in a global matrix organization is highly desirable.

Required Skills

  • Systems Engineering Methodology

  • System Design & Integration

  • Requirements Engineering

  • FMEA & Risk Management

  • Root Cause Analysis

  • Technical Leadership

  • Stakeholder Management

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Strong Analytical & Problem-solving Skills

  • Ability to Influence and Drive Decisions Across Teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of MR product architecture and technologies.

  • Experience conducting feasibility studies and system-level trade-off analysis.

  • DFSS (Design for Six Sigma) certification.

  • INCOSE CSEP certification or equivalent Systems Engineering qualification.

  • Knowledge of medical device regulations and quality processes.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate demonstrates:

  • Deep understanding of MR systems and system design methodology.

  • Strong capability in driving technical issues to resolution.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Ability to balance technical depth with system-level thinking.

  • Passion for product quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.


About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.
