We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.


Position Summary

A Shift Supervisor is a key leader supporting the CVS Store Management team in driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. When there is no manager or Operations Supervisor onsite, the Shift Supervisor leads the store staff, ensures that store operations run smoothly, and is responsible for ensuring the completion of all opening and closing procedures.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

  • Work effectively with store management and store crews
  • Supervise the store’s crew through assigning, directing and following up of all activities
  • Effectively communicate information both to and from store management and crews

2. Customer Service

  • Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints
  • Promote CVS customer service culture. (Greet, offer help, and thank)
  • Handle all customer relations issues in accordance with company policy and promote a positive shopping experience for all CVS customers
  • Maintain customer/patient confidentiality

3. Merchandise/Presentation

  • Price merchandise
  • Stock shelves
  • Execute the displays, sign and inventory of weekly, promotional, and seasonal merchandise
  • Execute the display and maintenance of off-shelf merchandise
  • Reset departments following POGs


Required Qualifications

  • Deductive reasoning ability, analytical skills and computer skills.
  • Advanced communication skills and supervision skills
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a retail supervisor


Education

High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

Anticipated Weekly Hours

20

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$16.50 - $24.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.


Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/28/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

title: AI Technical Expert
description:
Job Title

AI Technical Expert

Job Description

Role Summary:

We are looking for a senior technology professional with 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and enterprise technology, with strong experience across data engineering, machine learning, and AI/Generative AI.

The candidate will be responsible for applying AI to solve meaningful enterprise problems and realize measurable business and engineering value, while architecting and delivering scalable AI-enabled solutions and reusable AI capabilities.

The role requires strong software and data engineering foundations, AI/ML expertise, system architecture, hands-on development, and technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and realize high-value enterprise opportunities through AI, with measurable business and engineering impact.
  • Architect and develop AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
  • Build reliable data pipelines, data platforms and data processing capabilities that support AI/ML solutions.
  • Apply ML techniques to develop, train, evaluate and deploy machine learning solutions.
  • Design and develop LLM-based applications, including RAG, agents, tool use, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise platforms, APIs, data sources, and engineering tools.
  • Establish practices for AI architecture, evaluation, security, observability, and governance.
  • Lead POCs from hypothesis through productionisation, with measurable outcomes.
  • Mentor engineers and establish engineering best practices.

Experience & Skills

  • 15+ years of software engineering / architecture / technology experience.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly Python, and solid software architecture fundamentals.
  • Experience designing data pipelines, data processing workflows, data platforms, and data quality practices.
  • Practical experience with ML model development lifecycle including data processing, ML model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML techniques and modern GenAI approaches, including but not limited to LLMs, prompting, context engineering and inference.
  • Practical experience with LLMs, RAG, AI agents, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Experience with modern AI application frameworks and orchestration technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
  • Experience taking AI/ML solutions from PoC to production in enterprise environments.
  • Understanding of AI security, evaluation, observability, and governance.

Experience applying AI across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps and developer productivity is highly desirable.

title: Production Operative
description:
Our Witton site, also known as Vetchberry Steels, is home to our specialist coil processing operation and features a state-of-the-art slitting and traverse line. We are looking for a Traverse Line Operator to join the team and play a key role in transforming large coils of stainless steel and aluminium into products that meet our customers' exact requirements.

In this hands-on production role, you will be responsible for operating and setting up the traverse line, loading and unloading coils using overhead cranes and forklift trucks, and ensuring products are processed safely, accurately, and efficiently. You'll also carry out quality checks using measuring equipment, record production data, and operate the line's integrated welding system following full training.

Safety is at the heart of everything we do, so you'll be expected to work in line with our Health & Safety standards and 6S principles, helping to maintain a safe, organised, and efficient working environment.

This role would suit someone with experience in a manufacturing, production, or industrial environment who enjoys working with machinery, takes pride in quality, and is keen to develop their skills within a supportive team.

Working Hours

38.5 hours per week
  • Monday to Thursday: 7:30am to 4:15pm
  • Friday: 7:30am to 1:00pm

Enjoy an early finish every Friday and a great work-life balance while working with industry-leading equipment and processes.

Your Main Duties Will Include:

  • Learning to operate our state-of-the-art Traverse Line through a structured training programme.
  • Assisting with the movement and handling of steel coils and sheet metal products using specialist equipment (full training provided).
  • Supporting the loading and unloading of materials and finished products within the production area.
  • Preparing and packaging processed steel products ready for storage or customer dispatch.
  • Carrying out quality checks and accurately recording production information.
  • Ensuring products are processed to the correct specification and customer requirements.
  • Maintaining high standards of health, safety, and housekeeping in line with our 6S approach.
  • Working collaboratively with colleagues to ensure production targets and customer deadlines are achieved.
  • Keeping work areas clean, organised, and safe at all times.


We're looking for someone with a positive attitude, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn. Previous experience operating traverse lines, overhead cranes, or forklift trucks is not required, as full training will be provided.

Essential skills and experience:
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing, production, warehouse, or industrial environment
  • Comfortable working in a physically demanding role and handling materials safely
  • A strong commitment to health, safety, and quality standards
  • Good attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions accurately
  • Basic numeracy and literacy skills
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work effectively as part of a team
  • A proactive attitude with a willingness to learn new skills and processes
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to accurately complete production records and paperwork

Desirable skills and experience:
  • Experience operating machinery within a manufacturing or production environment
  • Experience working with steel, metal products, or other industrial materials
  • Knowledge of quality inspection processes and measuring equipment
  • Overhead crane or forklift truck experience (training can be provided)

What we're really looking for:

We're interested in candidates who are reliable, safety-conscious, and eager to develop their skills. If you have experience in production, warehousing, manufacturing, assembly, machine operation, or other hands-on environments, we'd love to hear from you.


Your benefits with us

  • Annual Leave: 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays
  • Health Cash Plan
  • Company bonus scheme
  • Advantageous pension scheme
  • Learning & Development opportunities
  • Advanced Family Friendly Policies
  • Discounts portal
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Length of Service Awards
  • Christmas savings scheme
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Company events
  • Christmas Closedown

Our Company Values

Our company values are the fundamental principles that guide our organization’s actions, culture, and decision-making processes. Our values were created by our employees across all departments in the business and with people at all levels, creating authentic values that make sense to us and demonstrate how we like to work with each other. They serve as the foundation for our company’s identity, shaping how our employees interact with one another, customers, and the broader community.

Let's take a look at each of our four company values and what they mean to us.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description:
India T&M Special Bonus:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

Senior Business Analyst – Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud Advanced Migration
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with deep Salesforce CPQ expertise to lead discovery and requirements work for a migration from Salesforce CPQ to Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA). You will bridge business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring the migration preserves existing business logic while unlocking RCA's native capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end discovery sessions with sales ops, finance, and IT stakeholders to document current-state CPQ configuration, workflows, and customizations
• Produce detailed as-is process maps covering product catalog, pricing rules, discount schedules, quote templates, approval workflows, and contract lifecycle
• Identify gaps between CPQ functionality and RCA's data model (Products, Attributes, Price Books, Transaction Line Items) and document migration impact
• Define to-be business processes aligned to RCA's native features — including Product Catalog, Dynamic Revenue Orchestration, and Subscription Management
• Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the implementation team
• Collaborate with architects to assess custom Apex, triggers, and integrations in the current CPQ org and recommend migration or re-build strategies
• Facilitate UAT planning, write test scripts, and coordinate sign-off with business owners
• Maintain a traceability matrix linking CPQ configurations to RCA equivalents throughout the project lifecycle
• Manage stakeholder expectations around feature parity, timeline, and data migration scope
Required Skills & Experience
• 5+ years as a Business Analyst on Salesforce platform projects
• 3+ years hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (product rules, pricing rules, quote templates, approval chains, amendments, renewals)
• Working knowledge of Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (formerly Industries CPQ / Vlocity) or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on RCA's object model
• Strong understanding of Quote-to-Cash (QTC) and Order-to-Revenue (OTR) processes
• Experience documenting complex business rules in decision tables, process flows (BPMN or similar), and functional specs
• Proficiency with tools like Confluence, JIRA, Lucidchart, or equivalent
• Ability to read and interpret Salesforce configuration (flows, validation rules, field mappings) without writing code
Nice to Have
• Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification
• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or Industries CPQ certification
• Experience with data migration projects (CPQ quote/contract data to RCA)
• Familiarity with Salesforce DX and metadata-driven deployments
• Prior involvement in a CPQ-to-RCA or CPQ-to-Vlocity migration
Soft Skills
• Strong facilitation skills — comfortable running workshops with mixed technical and non-technical audiences
• Able to push back constructively when requirements conflict with platform constraints
• Detail-oriented with a track record of keeping documentation current through project changes

title: Senior DevOps/Automation Engineer - IBM Z & hybrid platform
description:
Req ID: 394009

Competitive salary | UK: hybrid: London OR Sheffield + remote

At NTT DATA, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. The quality, integrity, and commitment of our employees are key factors in our company’s growth, market presence and our ability to help our clients stay a step ahead of the competition. By hiring the best people and helping them grow both professionally and personally, we ensure a bright future for NTT DATA and for the people who work here.

NTT DATA is currently looking for a Senior DevOps/Automation Engineer - IBM Z & hybrid platform on a hybrid work model (London OR Sheffield + remote) for our growing team in the UK.

Role Purpose

We are delivering a strategic automation and DevOps modernisation programme across IBM Z and distributed platforms. This role will design and engineer production grade automation, CI/CD integration, compliance verification, observability pipelines, and secure orchestration capabilities across a global estate. You will work across Python, PostgreSQL, Git based workflows, Jenkins pipelines, Ansible orchestration, secrets management, artefact management, and observability tooling to build resilient, auditable and scalable automation services.

Key Responsibilities

1. Automation Engineering & Orchestration

  • Design and build robust automation using Python and YAML.
  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks in Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) for production orchestration.
  • Ensure idempotent, restartable and state-aware automation patterns.
  • Integrate automation across distributed and IBM Z platforms (including z/OS job execution patterns where relevant).
  • Implement failure handling, retry logic and operational guardrails.

2. CI/CD & DevOps Toolchain Integration

  • Build and maintain pipelines in GitHub and Jenkins (including Groovy-based pipeline development).
  • Embed automated compliance checks and quality gates.
  • Integrate artefact management via Nexus Repository.
  • Support Git based workflow design (branching strategy, pull requests, code reviews, tagging and release patterns).

3. Observability & Monitoring

  • Design dashboards and telemetry pipelines using Grafana.
  • Integrate logging/metrics with enterprise observability platforms (e.g. Splunk).
  • Build automated compliance and drift dashboards.
  • Create structured reporting for audit and operational governance.

4. Data & Persistence

  • Design schemas and automation state handling in PostgreSQL.
  • Implement run state tracking, job history retention, and audit evidence capture.
  • Optimise queries and data handling for operational reliability.

5. Security & Secrets Management

  • Implement secure secret handling using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Integrate Vault with CI/CD and AAP workflows.
  • Apply least privilege principles and secure credential lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to enterprise standards for secrets, tokens and service accounts.

6. Governance, Standards & Compliance

  • Embed compliance verification into pipelines (automated controls, evidence capture).
  • Contribute to standards for GitHub, Jenkins, AAP and workflow governance.
  • Support configuration drift detection and remediation automation.
  • Ensure documentation suitable for internal risk, audit and regulatory stakeholders.

Required Technical Skills

Must haves

  • DevOps Experience: minimum 10+ years of demonstrable experience including solution design, governance, compliance and the implementation of DevOps best practice
  • IBM Z Platform: At least 2 years’ experience of working within an IBM Z environment. Experience with zOSMF and zOAU would be a distinct advantage.
  • Experience with enterprise scale Ansible via AAP.
  • Strong Python development knowledge (production quality code, modular design, error handling, logging, testing).
  • PostgreSQL (schema design, performance tuning, operational usage).
  • YAML (clean, structured automation definitions).
  • Git and Git based CI/CD practices.
  • Jenkins pipeline development (Groovy).
  • Grafana dashboard development and metrics interpretation.
  • Nexus or equivalent artefact repository management.
  • HashiCorp Vault integration and secrets automation
  • Technical leadership: Proven ability to mentor other engineers, provide technical guidance and embed engineering best practices across the team
  • Technical expertise: Strong hands on experience with Github, Jenkins, Ansible Automation Platform, Nexus, Python, Hashicorp Vault and API integration

Desirable

  • z/OS workflow tooling such as IBM z/OSMF and/or Zowe CLI.
  • Experience with enterprise schedulers (e.g., IWS patterns).
  • Configuration drift management frameworks.
  • API integration design.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code governance models.
  • Observability exporters and metrics pipelines.
  • Experience in regulated financial environments.

Engineering expectations

  • The successful candidate will:
  • Design automation as resilient systems, not scripts.
  • Build restartable and observable workflows.
  • Engineer for failure scenarios (network issues, partial job completion, region specific failure cases).
  • Balance simplicity with production robustness.
  • Document patterns reusable across global regions.
  • Think in terms of architecture, not just tooling.

Behavioural and leadership attributes

  • Structured, systems level thinker.
  • Comfortable operating in a complex enterprise estate.
  • Able to collaborate across distributed, mainframe and infrastructure teams.
  • Pragmatic but disciplined in standards enforcement.
  • Comfortable engaging with risk, audit and governance functions.
  • Drives automation by design rather than manual workarounds.

Benefits

Our people are the most critical component of our long-term success and their health and wellbeing are our priority. You will enjoy a comprehensive, locally competitive benefits package.

title: Intern Data Scientist
description:
Job Title

Intern Data Scientist

Job Description

Job Responsibilities:
• Collaborates extensively on AI DevOps activities, leveraging multiple tool sets at the solution level to streamline development, testing, inference, deployment, and monitoring processes with moderate complexity.
• Participates in discussions related to technical requirements, designs, and quality standards, providing inputs to ensure the robustness, scalability, and maintainability of AI solutions, working under direct supervision.
• Integrates deployable versions of machine learning models developed by data scientists into end products, ensuring compatibility, performance, and reliability of all system components.
• Handles data processing activities, including data cleansing, validation, and verification, to ensure the integrity and quality of data used for analysis and model training, with a focus on continuous improvement.
• Trains and retrains AI systems as necessary to adapt to changing data distributions, business requirements, and performance objectives, optimizing model performance through iterative refinement.
• Performs statistical analysis and fine-tuning of AI models using test results, hypothesis testing, and validation techniques to validate model assumptions, identify areas for improvement, and optimize model parameters.
• Contributes to activities within the on-site engineer team, providing the whole deployment plan and pipelines.
• Participates in the AI development process, working in pairing mode with equal team members, and actively contributing to requirements gathering, design discussions, code reviews, and quality assurance activities.
• Interacts with business, market, and IT stakeholders to formulate clear and actionable requirements for AI solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals, user needs, and technical capabilities.
• Ensures the quality of data and AI solutions developed, conducting thorough testing, validation, and verification activities to identify and address defects, errors, and performance issues before deployment.


Minimum required Education:
Master or PHD candidate in Biomedical Engineer, Computer Science, Information Management, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent.


Minimum required Experience:
Experience with Data processing, Data Analytics, AI Modeling or equivalent.


Preferred Experience:
Experience in using programming languages such as Python, R, JAVA, C/C++

title: Lead Finance Business Partner R&I and V&I (m/f/d)
description:
Lead Finance Business Partner R&I and V&I (m/f/d)


German Version below/Deutsche Version unten.


Innovative, dynamic, and sustainable: As one of the world’s leading companies in the research-based pharmaceutical industry, we at AstraZeneca offer the best opportunities for your personal and professional development. Because one thing is certain for us: we believe in the potential of our employees, and our goal is to help you grow beyond your limits. We maximize your potential and passion by actively supporting you so that you can achieve anything with us—no matter where you start. We don’t limit your capabilities to what you can do now; instead, we expand what you’ll be capable of in the future.

The Finance department drives AstraZeneca’s ambitions forward by setting the right strategic priorities. Providing valuable data, analyses, and insights will not only support growth but also enable the scientific community to make effective decisions and identify market opportunities. The mission is ambitious, and it takes the collective skills of a team to truly realize the full potential of science and always put patients first.

We are looking for you as a Lead Finance Business Partner R&I and V&I (m/f/d) with a direct reporting line to the Country CFO for AstraZeneca Germany.

Your responsibilities:

  • Leading and managing the R&I and V&I budgeting and planning process including the RBU, MTP and Budget in collaboration with the FP&A Lead Germany.
  • Act as a trusted finance advisor to BuD R&I and V&I as well as Country CFO
  • Managing/Owning the monthly close for R&I and V&I business, ensuring a high quality month end close and forecast accuracy.
  • Responsible for preparing in depth financial analysis of budgets, forecasts and actual results for monthly review by senior management (BuD, CFO, CP). Triangulate the data: financials, market insights and market share to understand the key business drivers.
  • Lead preparation of presentations (country visit) and associated analysis for senior management
  • Owns the local financial planning for R&I and V&I
  • Continuous coordination and strong collaboration with cross-functional areas: Pricing & Market Access (discounts) and AIMs especially around financial planning process (RBU2 and MTP).
  • Strategic overview of the Therapeutic Areas (TAs) and development of proposals for resource reallocation for brands within R&I and V&I
  • Identification of growth opportunities and performance improvements, development of
    action-oriented proposals to achieve the goals in collaboration with the business (BuD).
  • Shared responsibility for the business strategy and the performance cycle of the respective TAs in the cross-functional team
  • Responsibility for sharing best practices within the German and regional/global teams
  • Active participation in S&OP meetings with a focus on ensuring growth and forecast accuracy for R&I and V&I brands.
  • Continuously driving efficiency of process, leveraging AI and promote a growth mindset

Your Qualifications:

  • Completion of a relevant university degree
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in the finance/controlling area - preferably in marketing/sales organizations and another area (e.g., regional/global role, corporate finance, or leadership responsibility as a finance manager for a mid size market), pharma / biotech / medical devices preferred
  • Desirable: Understanding of the (German) pharmaceutical / biotech / medical devices market
  • Leadership: Demonstrated (direct/indirect) leadership experience in the finance area for more than 5 years
  • Analytical Thinking: Very good analytical thinking and numerical understanding
  • Problem Solving & Solution Orientation: confident handling of complex tasks, pronounced analytical and strategic skills; critical and quick thinking; decision-making ability as well as goal orientation
  • Influencing Skills: Ability to influence cross-functional decisions, motivation of employees without direct reporting line
  • Communication: Very good communication and presentation skills, ability to present complex relationships simply, experience with senior management presentations
  • Accountability: Ability to work independently and take responsibility as well as teamwork
  • Entrepreneurship: Willingness to take risks, action-oriented behavior, high flexibility in a dynamic work environment, willingness to further develop oneself and the status quo
  • Team Player: Demonstrated excellent skills in dealing with teams and social competence
  • Fluent in English
  • Good handling of SAP, Excel, Business Intelligence Software, and other analytical tools
  • International mobility for further development is highly desired

GERMAN


Innovativ, dynamisch und nachhaltig: Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen der forschenden Arzneimittelindustrie bieten wir bei AstraZeneca die besten Möglichkeiten für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Denn für uns steht fest: wir glauben an das Potenzial unserer Mitarbeitenden und haben das Ziel, Sie über Ihre Grenzen hinaus zu entwickeln. Wir maximieren Ihr Potenzial und Ihre Passion, indem wir Sie aktiv dabei unterstützen, damit Sie bei uns alles erreichen können – egal wo Sie anfangen. Denn wir limitieren Ihre Kompetenzen nicht auf das, was Sie jetzt können, sondern erweitern, wozu Sie zukünftig in der Lage sein werden.

Die Abteilung Finance treibt AstraZenecas Ambitionen voran, indem sie die strategischen Prioritäten richtig setzen. Die Bereitstellung wertvoller Daten, Analysen und Erkenntnisse werden nicht nur das Wachstum unterstützen, sondern es der Wissenschaft ermöglichen, wirksame Entscheidungen zu treffen und Marktchancen zu erkennen. Die Mission ist ehrgeizig und es bedarf der Fähigkeiten eines Teams, um wirklich das zu erreichen, was die Wissenschaft leisten kann und PatientInnen immer an erster Stelle zu setzen.

Wir suchen Sie als Lead Finance Business Partner (m/w/d)​ R&I und V&I mit direkter Berichtslinie an den Country CFO von AstraZeneca Deutschland.

Einfluss nehmen:

  • Leitung und Steuerung des Budgetierungs- und Planungsprozesses für R&I und V&I, einschließlich RBU, MTP und Budget, in Zusammenarbeit mit dem FP&A-Leiter Deutschland.
  • Funktion als vertrauenswürdiger Finanzberater für BuD R&I und V&I sowie für den Country CFO
  • Leitung und Verantwortung für den Monatsabschluss der Geschäftsbereiche R&I und V&I, um einen qualitativ hochwertigen Monatsabschluss und die Genauigkeit der Prognosen sicherzustellen.
  • Erstellung fundierter Finanzanalysen von Budgets, Prognosen und Ist-Ergebnissen für die monatliche Überprüfung durch die Geschäftsleitung (BuD, CFO, CP). Abgleich der Daten: Finanzkennzahlen, Markteinblicke und Marktanteile, um die wichtigsten Geschäftsfaktoren zu verstehen.

  • umsetzungsorientierten Vorschlägen zur Erreichung der Ziele in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Geschäft (BuD).

Stärken beweisen:

  • Abschluss eines einschlägigen Hochschulstudiums
  • Mindestens 10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Finanzen/Controlling – vorzugsweise in Marketing-/Vertriebsorganisationen und einem weiteren Bereich (z. B. regionale/globale Funktion, Unternehmensfinanzierung
  • oder Führungsaufgaben als Finanzmanager für einen mittelgroßen Markt)

  • Überzeugungskraft: Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Entscheidungen zu beeinflussen, sowie Mitarbeiter ohne direkte Berichtslinie zu motivieren
  • Kommunikation: Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, Fähigkeit,
  • komplexe Zusammenhänge einfach darzustellen, Erfahrung mit Präsentationen vor der Geschäftsleitung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit SAP, Excel, Business-Intelligence-Software und anderen Analysewerkzeugen
  • Internationale Mobilität zur weiteren Entwicklung ist sehr erwünscht

Freuen Sie sich auf:

title: Data Engineer Sr. Consultant
description:
Job Description: Senior Data / Business Analyst (P&C or General Insurance Domain Experience Required)

Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst with strong Business Analysis capabilities to play a pivotal role in our large-scale enterprise data modernization program. In this role, your primary focus will be navigating complex data structures, performing deep data analysis, and leading the migration of legacy insurance data to our next-generation cloud platform. Secondarily, you will utilize your business analysis skillset to act as a bridge, translating complex technical data into business-friendly canonical formats and facilitating alignment across multi-functional insurance teams.

Primary Responsibilities (Data Analysis):

• Data Mapping & Design: Produce robust source-to-target mappings (STTM), complex business rules, report logic, KPI definitions, and comprehensive data dictionaries for the enterprise data platform.

• Legacy-to-Cloud Translation: Analyze, profile, and translate Guidewire CDA feeds and legacy AS400/DB2 structures into clean, business-friendly canonical requirements optimized for medallion architecture.

• Data Quality & Validation: Drive data profiling initiatives, lead data issue triage, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and report validation.

• Technical End-to-End Governance: Ensure strict data traceability across the lifecycle, mapping every element from initial requirement through to technical test evidence and final sign-off.

Secondary Responsibilities (Business Analysis):

• Requirement Elicitation: Leverage 8+ years of experience to elicit, analyze, and document complex data, reporting, and reconciliation requirements across core insurance operations.

• Domain Alignment: Collaborate deeply across key business units, including Policy, Claims, Billing, Finance, and Agency operations.

• Stakeholder Facilitation: Act as the key interface and facilitate workshops with business SMEs, Product Owners, Actuaries, Underwriting, and Regulatory/Reporting teams to align data engineering with business goals.

Experience & Qualifications:

• 8+ years of professional experience in data analysis, data migration, or data-heavy business analysis roles within the Property & Casualty (P&C) / General Insurance domain.

• Expert-level SQL skills with a proven track record of querying, profiling, and analyzing large, complex relational databases and modern cloud data warehouses.

• Hands-on experience working on large enterprise modernization and cloud migration programs.

• Exceptional analytical ability to dissect legacy code or feeds (like AS400 or Guidewire) and structure them into modern data lake environments (Silver layer design).

Preferred Certifications :

• SQL / Data Analytics certification (e.g., Azure Data Analyst, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or equivalent).

• CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or PMI-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis).

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (React/TypeScript)
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer React Typescript

Applied Labs is seeking a highly skilled and driven Senior Full Stack Software Engineer for a dedicated, full-time engagement on one of our key client projects. This is an exciting opportunity to directly contribute to the success of a prominent IT service provider, building new features from the ground up. We are looking for an individual with an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of engaging with product stakeholders, refining requirements, and making sound decisions to prioritize functionality while minimizing technical debt. You’ll thrive in both independent and collaborative environments, ensuring efficient and impactful feature releases.   • React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js
  • tRPC & REST APIs, Python
  • PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Elastic Pool, Redis
  • Azure Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus

  • Knowledge and experience with Python is welcomed.
  • Proven experience in a DevOps-centric environment, with a strong emphasis on continuous delivery and GitOps.
  • Strong proficiency in relational databases and SQL, preferably PostgreSQL, including database design and query optimization.

  • Experience with low-code workflow building tools or robotic process automation tools (Azure Logic Apps).
  • .NET/C# development experience, particularly with Azure Functions extensions.
  • Experience with Figma for concept design.

Benefits

  • Remote-first team, async-friendly work culture
  • Competitive pay ($2,000/mo-$4,000/mo, depending on experience)
  • Work with the US-team on a daily basis
  • Zero micromanagement, zero fluff - just real work with real impact
  • Growth opportunities if you’re driven and reliable

Salem Five believes deeply in supporting the communities in which we reside. Donations through our Charitable Foundation or events at the branch or location-level are an important part of our DNA. title: Network & Data Centre Engineer
description:
As part of an exciting digital transformation, the University of Surrey is seeking a Network & Data Centre Engineer on a fixed-term basis.
Operating as part of the Network Services team within IT Services the post holder will provide day-to-day operational support for the University's network, voice and data centre services.
We value, empower and support every member of staff to get the best out of your unique talents, so you'll be rewarded with a generous salary, 32 days holiday PLUS Bank Holidays, pension contribution of 14.5%, and a unique and vibrant working environment.

Role & Responsibilities:

Working within established procedures and under the general direction of more senior colleagues, you will monitor services, respond to alerts and support requests, undertake approved maintenance and standard changes, and keep operational records accurate and up to date.
The role uses detailed practical knowledge of established network and data centre technologies to diagnose and resolve routine and moderately complex issues, escalating unusual, high-risk or unresolved matters appropriately.

Responsibilities include:

  • Monitor network, voice and data centre services, respond to system alerts and recorded requests, and take appropriate action so that service availability and performance are maintained
  • Install, configure and maintain network and data centre equipment, including switches, routers, wireless access points, structured cabling, racks and associated infrastructure, in accordance with approved designs, procedures and change controls
  • Diagnose and resolve routine and moderately complex incidents and service requests using documented procedures, technical knowledge and established precedents, escalating unusual, high-risk or unresolved issues to senior colleagues.
  • Carry out approved standard changes, maintenance and testing, coordinating activities with colleagues, customers and suppliers so that work is completed safely and with minimal disruption.
  • Maintain accurate technical and operational records, including network diagrams, equipment inventories, configurations, support notes and standard operating procedures.

The IT team at Surrey are plugged in to the whole University, and our digital transformation work underpins the University's strategy. IT is growing our digital transformation capability, improving student experience, and helping increase our research impact.
It's a vibrant and exciting time to join a great and well-respected team at the heart of the University's strategic plans.

What's in it for you?

We think Surrey is an amazing place to work, and we are carefully crafting a dynamic, flexible, and fun place to work and thrive.
Our campus is a beautiful, leafy environment with carefully designed gardens, vibrant green playing fields, and a picturesque lake. With the buzz of student life and superb working facilities, the University is a global community of ideas and people, dedicated to life-changing education and research in an inspiring, innovative and diverse environment.
Alongside our gorgeous campus setting, collegiate on-site atmosphere and plentiful development opportunities, we also offer:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Market leading Pension
  • Up to 40 DAYS Holiday: 25 Days annual leave + 7 University Days + Bank Holidays
  • Travel & Family benefits including subsidised rail fare, cycle to work scheme and on-site childcare
  • Access to on site leisure facilities at discounted rates

The University is committed to providing an inclusive environment that offers equal opportunities for all. We place great value on diversity and are seeking to increase the diversity within our community. Therefore, we particularly encourage applications from under-represented groups, such as people from Black, Asian and minority ethnic groups and people with disabilities.

title: Senior Design Quality Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior Design Quality Engineer

Job Description

In this role you

Will be part of a team that is excited by the unique professional challenges that our Quality Transformation presents, has strong technical competencies, and demonstrates resilience challenging, often demanding situations. We are looking for a perfectionist- a fixer who continuously strives for excellence as a way of life; not just as a job. We’re looking for someone who can inspire others to adopt this mentality of prioritizing quality above all else in a relentless pursuit to improve the quality-of-life billions for the billions of people Philips brand touches each year.


Your role:

  • Accountable for oversight of system and hardware quality and safety risk management throughout the product life cycle.
  • A Quality Engineer provides independent oversight of the design input process, design V&V activities, design transfer and product realization, and performance in the field to ensure that all design requirements are effectively met.
  • Act as a single point of contact (person assigned to project team) responsible to ensure that hardware design meets quality and compliance standards for every milestone
  • Performs independent technical assessment on product quality performance and post‐market product quality analysis



You're the right fit if:

  • Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Science or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in product design as demonstrated by a role in quality, engineering, service, or manufacturing in a regulated environment with Medical Device experience. 5+ years of experience preferred.
  • Experience with FMEAs and Product Safety Risk Management preferred.
  • Expertise in Application of Risk Management to Medical Devices (IEC 14971), Medical Device Software Life Cycle Processes (IEC 62304), and Application of Usability Engineering to Medical Devices (IEC 62366), 21CFR820 are pluses.
  • You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this Office/Remote position.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is an office role.


About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.

  • Learn more about our business.
  • Discover our rich and exciting history.
  • Learn more about our purpose.
  • Learn more about our culture.

Philips Transparency Details

The pay range for this position in Bothell WA is $103,000 to $145,000 Annually.

The pay range for this position in Cambridge MA is $103,000 to $145,000 Annually

In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive bonus, sales commission or long-term incentives may be offered. Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more. Details about our benefits can be found here.

At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case.


Additional Information

US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa, now or in the future.

Company relocation benefits will not be provided for this position. For this position, you must reside in or within commuting distance to Bothell WA, Cambridge MA, Reedsville PA.

description:

title: Foundation Executive Director
description:
Location: Louisville, KY

Job Type: Full-time

Job Classification: This is an exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.


Our Mission:

Our mission is to drive financial wellness in healthcare organizations so more patients can receive the care they need.


Our Vision:

Our vision is a future where we help healthcare organizations thrive in a complex ecosystem by clearing a path to financial health.


Our Culture:

We are committed to creating a workplace where every member feels valued, empowered, and inspired to contribute their best. Together we will foster a culture that promotes work-life balance and celebrates community engagement, personal achievements, milestones, and special occasions.


Values:

  • Integrity – We do what’s right, no matter what.
  • Innovation – We use a harmonious blend of data, tech, and a human-centric approach.
  • Compassion – We understand the stress of healthcare organizations and their patients.
  • Determination – Our mission is our guiding force.
  • Partnership – We build enduring relationships through listening, communication and accountability.
  • Dignity– We have significant pride in each other and our work.


Job Summary:

The Executive Director leads the Foundation’s overall management and performance, overseeing strategic planning, fundraising and resource development, grantmaking, financial stewardship, program development, board relations, community partnerships, and organizational effectiveness. The position ensures that the Foundation’s activities align with its mission, governance requirements, community priorities, and long-term strategic objectives.


As the primary ambassador and spokesperson for the Foundation, the Executive Director cultivates strong relationships with donors, grant makers, community leaders, healthcare partners, and civic organizations to expand the Foundation's visibility, influence, and philanthropic resources. Through visionary leadership, responsible stewardship, and innovative partnership development, the Executive Director ensures the Foundation remains a trusted community partner and a catalyst for measurable health and community impact.


This position reports directly to the Chief of Government Affairs & External Relations Officer.


Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.


Duties and Responsibilities:


Strategic Leadership and Organizational Management

  • Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for the Foundation in partnership with the Board of Directors.
  • Work closely with the Board of Directors to advance the Foundation's mission and strategic priorities
  • Develop and implement the Foundation's strategic plan, annual goals, and long-term objectives.
  • Ensure alignment of Foundation activities with its mission, vision, values, and community health priorities.
  • Lead all aspects of Foundation operations, including programs, finances, fundraising, grantmaking, communications, and community engagement.
  • Advise the Board regarding strategic opportunities, organizational risks, community trends, and emerging philanthropic priorities.
  • Establish organizational policies, procedures, performance metrics, and accountability measures that support operational excellence and sound governance.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, diversity, integrity, and continuous improvement.
  • Represent the Foundation as its chief spokesperson and senior executive leader.
  • Ensures all Foundation activities comply with applicable laws, reporting requirements, and regulations.

Board Governance and Relations

  • Support Board governance responsibilities through effective communication, planning, reporting, and policy implementation.
  • Prepare and present regular reports regarding Foundation operations, finances, fundraising performance, grantmaking activities, and community impact outcomes.
  • Assist the Board in strategic planning, committee development, governance initiatives, and board member engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with Foundation bylaws, policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Develop systems to collect, analyze, and communicate data demonstrating the Foundation's contribution to community health and well-being.

Resource Development and Fundraising

  • Lead the development and execution of comprehensive fundraising and resource development strategies, including annual fundraising plans and revenue goals aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Cultivate, solicit, and steward relationships with major donors, corporate partners, foundations, government agencies, and other funding sources.
  • Identify and pursue grants, sponsorships, planned giving opportunities, major gifts, and collaborative funding initiatives.
  • Serve as the lead relationship manager for key philanthropic partners and strategic donors.
  • Develop compelling cases for support, donor communications, grant proposals, and fundraising campaigns.
  • Ensure effective donor stewardship practices that foster long-term engagement and investment in the Foundation's mission.

Community Engagement and Strategic Partnerships

  • Build and maintain relationships with healthcare organizations, community-based organizations, civic leaders, educational institutions, government agencies, and philanthropic partners.
  • Serve as a visible community leader and advocate for issues aligned with the Foundation’s mission.
  • Identify and facilitate cross-sector partnerships that leverage resources, expertise, and investment to advance collective impact and improve community health outcomes.
  • Represent the Foundation at community events, conferences, public meetings, and stakeholder engagements.

Grantmaking and Program Oversight

  • Oversee the Foundation’s grantmaking, community investment, and charitable giving programs.
  • Establish funding priorities, evaluation criteria, and grantmaking policies aligned with strategic objectives.
  • Ensure grant review and funding processes are equitable, transparent, and effective.
  • Monitor funded programs and initiatives for accountability and measurable outcomes.
  • Promote the use of data and impact measurement in funding and program decisions.

Financial Management and Stewardship

  • Provide financial leadership and stewardship of the Foundation’s assets and resources.
  • Develop and manage annual operating and program budgets.
  • Monitor financial performance and ensure responsible fiscal management.
  • Oversee financial reporting, audits, investments, and compliance activities in coordination with Board leadership and financial advisors.
  • Maintain appropriate internal controls, risk management practices, and resource allocation strategies.
  • Support the Foundation’s long-term financial sustainability through prudent planning and resource diversification.

Impact Measurement and Organizational Effectiveness

  • Establish performance measures for organizational effectiveness, community impact, fundraising success, and grantmaking outcomes.
  • Prepare impact reports and outcome assessments for donors, stakeholders, corporate leadership, and the Board.
  • Assess program effectiveness and recommend improvements to strengthen community outcomes and maximize philanthropic impact.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Senior Analyst- Publication Writer
description:
Job Title: Senior Analyst-Publication Writer

Career Level:D1


About AstraZeneca

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.


Introduction to role:

Are you ready to lead sophisticated, high-stakes scientific publications that shape clinical understanding and guide decision the role of Lead Publication Writer at Manyata Tech Park, Bengaluru, you will create clear and compliant narratives from robust evidence. These narratives will support advancing patient outcomes and advise the scientific community.unity.

You will own the path from first outline to acceptance for priority scientific papers and presentation content, aligning contributors and navigating disclosure nuances with confidence. Collaborating alongside biostatistics, drug development, medical, and external author teams, you will drive publication delivery end-to-end, strengthening the visibility and impact of our therapies. We collaborate in person on average three days per week to connect, move at pace, and challenge perspectives—do you thrive on bringing diverse experts together to deliver publication excellence?


Accountabilities:

Publication leadership: Independently manage sophisticated articles and conference materials within assigned publication plans, from initial prioritisation and planning through submission and resubmission. Coordinate contributors, manage timelines and dependencies, and call out significant scientific, quality, or delivery risks appropriately.

Scientific writing, editing, and review: Author and critically review sophisticated manuscripts, structured abstracts, posters, and presentations, including publications based on clinical trials, subgroup analyses, real-world evidence, and health economics and outcomes research. Develop clear scientific narratives and ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with specifications for written and oral scientific forums.

Sophisticated disclosure management: Develop document outlines, figure and table shells, and evidence flow for sophisticated assigned deliverables. Manage publication systems, document versions, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs while maintaining alignment with the agreed publication strategy.

Data interpretation: Work with biostatistics, clinical, safety, and medical colleagues to interpret datasets and analytical outputs for assigned publications. Identify and reconcile inconsistencies across source documents and ensure that conclusions accurately reflect the available evidence.

Literature review and evidence synthesis: Plan and conduct literature searches and evidence reviews supporting assigned publications. Maintain methodological rigour, transparent search documentation, accurate reference libraries, and citation integrity.

Publication and conference presentation submissions: Prepare and coordinate complete submission packages, cover letters, and responses to reviewer comments. Manage author approvals, disclosures, and compliance checks, and resolve routine journal or congress queries.

Translate scientific data into detailed, clear, and suitably tailored figures and tables. Work with design partners to develop publication-ready visual assets that meet journal, congress, accessibility, and brand requirements.

Compliance and publication ethics: Apply Good Publication Practice, ICMJE recommendations, AstraZeneca policies, and relevant transparency requirements across assigned deliverables. Identify potential concerns and escalate sophisticated ethical or compliance questions to the appropriate experts.

Content strategy and stakeholder management: Contribute to asset publication strategies and lead author meetings and cross-functional reviews for assigned deliverables. Clarify expectations, consolidate feedback, and maintain alignment on scope, scientific narrative, and timelines.

Project delivery and documentation: Plan and manage schedules, dependencies, and documentation for multiple concurrent deliverables. Maintain accurate, audit-ready records in publication management systems and recommend practical improvements to quality, consistency, and efficiency.

Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with clinical development, medical affairs, biostatistics, HEOR, safety, regulatory, external authors, and other publication stakeholders. Represent Publication Delivery in forums directly related to assigned deliverables and support congress planning activities as required.

Digital innovation: Use approved artificial intelligence, automation, and digital tools responsibly to improve publication quality and efficiency. Contribute user insight and participate in pilots, adoption activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Quality and consistency: Apply established quality-control requirements, conduct peer reviews, and provide clear, actionable feedback. Ensure consistency across related deliverables and alignment with source materials, product information, and previous disclosures.

Capability building: Develop strong subject-matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas. Provide day-to-day coaching, peer review, and practical guidance to Publication Writers, and contribute to onboarding, training materials, and team learning activities.


Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Master’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.
  • Four to six years of experience in medical or scientific writing, including demonstrated leadership of complex manuscripts and congress disclosures; or, where industry experience is more limited, significant and credible academic research and publication experience, including authorship of complex original research published in highly reputed peer-reviewed journals.
  • Advanced understanding of clinical research methods, biostatistics, scientific communication, and publication ethics, including Good Publication Practice and ICMJE recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and translate scientific evidence into accurate, clear, and audience-appropriate publications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and organisational skills, with the ability to lead multiple high-priority projects.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, reference management tools, and publication management platforms, together with familiarity with data visualisation standards.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Advanced degree such as PharmD, PhD, MD, or MPH, or a recognised qualification in medical writing or communications.
  • Experience leading integrated disclosures involving pooled analyses, meta-analyses, HEOR, or epidemiology, and coordinating multi-author manuscripts through acceptance.
  • Experience in one or more of the following therapeutic areas: Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism; Respiratory and Immunology; Vaccines and Immune Therapies.
  • Experience collaborating with investigators, external experts, and cross-functional teams, including engagement with journal editors and congress secretariats.
  • Strong working knowledge of authorship criteria, data transparency, data-sharing expectations, and journal and congress submission systems.

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Senior Commercial Architect
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
The Senior Commercial Architect is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for taking the commercial lead for client engagements.

This role is responsible for positioning the commercial capabilities of the organization to clients, leading a commercial pursuit team and ensuring that client solutions are commercially optimized, innovative and profitable.

This role ensures the balance of risk and reward is reached through detailed financial analysis, considered risk management and clearly aligned interaction with the legal team.

Key responsibilities:
  • Provides recommendations and reviews the pricing and costing of deals to ensure maximum benefit and minimum risk to the organization and prepares the commercial parts of sales proposals for submission to clients.
  • Builds and compiles pricing models for specific proposals and provides input into the development of standardized pricing models.
  • Presents key pricing assumptions and risks for sign-off at relevant levels, in line with the authority matrix.
  • Engages with and leverages off relationships between the organization and vendors and/or subcontractors and strategic alliances, including the Legal Team during the conception, construction, and review of client proposals, soliciting information, and escalating queries.
  • Ensures that deal profitability is not eroded over time by calculating the long-term profit of deals, evaluating and concluding on foreign currency issues and the impacts of these both financially and contractually.
  • Ensures deal profitability by investigating taxation, inflationary movements cost of living issues, etc.
  • Provides support to relevant team by assisting with the maintenance of vendor warranties to ensure inclusion in the construction of deals.

title: Data Modeler
description: About the team you are joining The Technology Standards and Data Modeling team, within IATA’s Information and Data (I D) division, is responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise data models and data modelling practices that enable consistent, integrated and high-quality data across the organisation. The team is currently seeking a Data Modeler with experience in data analysis, data modelling and modern data platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with business, architecture, data engineering and application teams to understand source systems and their data, analyse data structures and relationships, and develop data models supporting analytical, operational and integration requirements. The role will contribute to the evolution of IATA’s enterprise data model and help ensure that data is consistently defined, structured and integrated across applications, domains and data platforms. What your day would be like Analyse source systems, databases and datasets to understand data structures, relationships, semantics and usage, and translate findings into appropriate data models. Design, develop and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models supporting operational, analytical and integration requirements. Translate business and functional requirements into normalised (OLTP), dimensional (OLAP) and integration-oriented data models, ensuring alignment with enterprise data modelling standards and architecture principles. Collaborate with business, architecture, data engineering and application teams to understand data flows, integration requirements and data dependencies, and contribute to the design of appropriate data solutions. Support data engineering and application teams by analysing data-model-related issues, improving schema designs and reverse-engineering data models from existing source systems and data platforms. Develop and maintain modelling artefacts and documentation, contribute to the continuous improvement of data modelling practices, and share knowledge and best practices across the organisation.

title: Senior Penetration Tester/Red Team Operator
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

As our Technology Consulting Services department continues to expand, we are seeking a Senior Penetration Tester/Red Team Operator to join our team.

This is a hybrid role (PT/RT) for someone who thinks like an adversary, learns and follows real-world threat actors, and cares about the quality and relevance of every engagement they touch.

You will lead and execute technical security assessments across a broad range of environments and dedicate a meaningful portion of your time to Research & Development (R&D), developing new tooling, novel attack techniques, and advancing your own areas of deep expertise.
This is not a checkbox testing role. Our clients engage us because they want to understand how a real attacker would operate against them. Your job is to make that simulation credible, contextual, and genuinely useful to defenders.

Job Description

After an initial onboarding into NTT Data methodologies and client environments, you will be expected to:

Lead and execute technical engagements, including scoping, technical security testing, analysis, reporting, and client presentations, across:

  • Web, Mobile, and Desktop Applications Penetration Tests

  • IT Infrastructure and Network environments Penetration Tests

  • Active Directory and hybrid identity (AD / Entra ID) Penetration Tests

  • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, M365) Penetration Tests

  • Full-spectrum Red Team and Adversary Simulation operations

Design and deliver adversary simulation, including:

  • Developing realistic, intelligence-led attack scenarios grounded in actual threat actor TTPs

  • Crafting phishing and social engineering campaigns

  • Bypassing modern defensive controls (EDR/XDR, MFA) using low-noise techniques

  • Developing or adapting custom tooling for delivery, evasion, and C2

  • Supporting Purple Team exercises to directly improve client detection and response capabilities

Drive Research & Development, including:

  • Becoming a recognised expert in one or more domains of your choosing (Active Directory, cloud-native environments, web browsers, OT/ICS, containers, hardware, etc.)

  • Researching and responsibly disclosing previously undiscovered vulnerabilities (0-days)

  • Publishing research through blog posts, whitepapers, CVEs, or conference talks

  • Developing novel attack techniques applicable to real-world Red Team engagements

Contribute to the business and the team, including:

  • Supporting pre-sales by capturing client needs and translating them into commercial proposals

  • Mentoring and guiding junior consultants through projects and skill development

  • Maintaining a broad, up-to-date knowledge base across core information security domains

  • Communicating complex attacker behaviour clearly and accurately to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Here’s what we are looking for in candidates

Must have:

  • 4-5 years of proven experience in Penetration Testing/Red Team Operations.

  • Proven experience leading or delivering Red Team and/or adversary simulation engagements in complex enterprise environments

  • Deep understanding of Active Directory, hybrid identity, and cloud attack surfaces

  • Hands-on experience developing or adapting TTPs beyond what standard frameworks provide out of the box

  • Demonstrated ability to research abuse paths, misconfigurations, or novel vulnerabilities

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, this means you can write a compelling attack narrative and present findings to a CISO without losing either audience (technical or non-technical)

  • Comfortable acting as a trusted technical advisor to clients and stakeholders

  • Strong teamwork abilities

  • Native proficiency in French or Dutch, with excellent verbal and written knowledge of English

Job Purpose and Summary:

Health is everything. At CVS Health, colleagues are committed to increasing access, lowering costs, and improving quality of care. Millions of times a day, we help people on their path to better health – from advising on prescriptions to helping manage chronic and specialty conditions.

As a Non-US Accredited Foreign Graduate, you will be on the forefront of delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients. After successfully passing FPGEE and TOEFL, you will be eligible to apply into this role to complete your required US Internship hours that build upon your Pharmacist education to develop your knowledge, skills, and abilities. You will complete a mixed modality learning plan including a curated learning experience that will utilize your pharmacy knowledge and skills. Non-US Accredited Foreign Graduates are required to successfully complete their internship within 18 months and will be skilled in diverse patient care, practice management, leadership, and education, and will be prepared to complete and pass all required Pharmacist licensure exams and processes within 120-days of the completion of required US Internship hours.

While working as a Non-US Accredited Foreign Graduate, under the direct supervision of a licensed Pharmacist, you play a critical role in ensuring a safe and effective Retail Pharmacy work environment that delivers exceptional care to each patient. This includes but is not limited to:

  • Patient Safety
  • Pharmacy Professional Practice
  • Regulatory Requirements
  • Quality Assurance
  • Customer Service
  • Inventory Management

  • Lead with Heart – display empathy and compassion for your patients, customers, caregivers, and colleagues on your team
  • Support your Pharmacy manager in motivating, inspiring, and developing their Pharmacy Support Staff by balancing assignments that maximize colleagues’ strengths, address development opportunities, and decrease knowledge gaps
  • Identify critical business opportunities and meaningful solutions to drive growth and improve performance in your pharmacy and work toward successfully implementing those solutions by leading your team to achieve specified goals
  • Adapt to change and adjust plans to thrive in a dynamic community healthcare setting
  • Seek new ways to grow, collaborate with others, and deliver better outcomes
  • Align others around our purpose to bring your heart to every moment of your health and gain support and commitment
  • Facilitate a ‘team’ culture that promotes caring, energy, enthusiasm, and pride
  • Apply acquired knowledge to help drive healthy outcomes and differentiate CVS from competitors

  • Answer telephone with a warm and friendly greeting

  • Perform approved register transactions including cash, check and charge, bagging merchandise upon completion of sale

Regulatory

  • Communicate with customer/patient while protecting their confidential drug information
  • Comply with all federal and state laws, rules, and regulations
  • Comply with all CVS policy and standard operations procedures (SOPs) at all times
  • Meet requirements for state and federal licensure within an appropriate timeframe

Pharmacy Operations

  • Adhere to CVS workflow and ensure standards are maintained at all times
  • Process prescriptions including translation of SIG codes, product selection, counting and measuring drugs, capping, and uncapping vials and bottles; labeling all prescriptions
  • Resolve third party rejections and complete any manual claim forms
  • Perform all prescription pick-up procedures, in adherence of CVS policy and procedures

Failure to complete required US Intern hours within 18 months or obtain Pharmacist licensure as prescribed will result in the colleague being removed from role and separation of employment.

Skill In:

title: Reconstruction Algorithm Devleloper
description:
Job Title

Reconstruction Algorithm Devleloper

Job Description

Reconstruction Algorithm Developer

In this role, you are part of

The MR Recon Software team, a key part of the MR Domain SW department in MR R&D within Philips. MR R&D focuses on developing and enhancing MR products and solutions. We have defined aspirational goals and a “North Star” in line with customers’ most pressing needs. We work on improving (a) Speed, to ensure predictable and reduced cost per exam; (b) Comfort, to improve patient and staff satisfaction; and (c) Confidence, to support first-time-right diagnosis.

The MR Recon team works on new AI technologies and GPU implementations and is exploring cloud technology to meet future clinical needs. Team members have opportunities to grow as domain specialists or technical specialists.

Your Role:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain MR reconstruction software.
  • Translate state-of-the-art academic research into robust, production-grade C++ and Python code.
  • Architect and implement advanced MR reconstruction algorithms.
  • Analyze reconstruction algorithms and implementations to identify performance improvements through algorithmic complexity reduction.
  • Optimize AI/ML components integrated into the Recon pipeline, including PyTorch-based models, ONNX, TensorRT, and CUDA/cuDNN.
  • Work with reconstruction algorithm developers and AI/ML, software, and systems teams to translate computationally intensive algorithms into efficient, scalable implementations.
  • Investigate and resolve customer complaints.
  • Own and deliver assigned modules as part of the team.
  • Support project estimation, planning, and risk management activities.

You're the Right Fit If:

  • MTech or PhD in biomedical engineering, signal processing, computer engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience developing reconstruction or image-processing algorithms: 5+ years with an MTech, or 2+ years with a PhD.
  • Strong C++ skills and the ability to develop robust, production-grade code in C++ and Python.
  • Experience analyzing and optimizing computationally intensive reconstruction algorithms and software implementations.
  • Experience applying profiling and performance-analysis techniques to identify bottlenecks and deliver measurable improvements.
  • Good to have: experience with AI/ML components and tools such as PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, and CUDA/cuDNN.
  • Ability to improve end-to-end performance while maintaining numerical accuracy and image quality.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across algorithm, AI/ML, software, and systems teams.
  • Experience in medical devices or healthcare is preferred; prior experience in the healthcare domain is a bonus.
  • Knowledge of Waterfall and Agile development methodologies.
  • Clear and coherent written communication skills, including the ability to present data visually.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills.

Minimum required Education and Experience

MTech with 5+ years of relevant experience, or PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience.

description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).

Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.

You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.

As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.

You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
  • Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
  • At least one technical certification in the above-mentioned technologies.
  • Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
  • Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.

As our Verification & Validation Technician, you will be responsible for supporting complex laboratory projects, and delivering them on time while prioritizing competing demands and executing system-level/performance testing, while working closely with engineers who develop the test procedures.

  • Contributes to strategic planning and priority setting within their area of expertise, providing insights and recommendations based on data analysis and technical understanding to inform overall project direction and resource allocation.

You're the right fit if:

  • You’ve acquired 2+ years of experience in Research and Development (R&D) environment, Engineering Laboratory or equivalent.
