title: Hardware Engineer- Sustainability
description:
Job Summary

From the newest ideas in cluster computing to the latest web framework, NetApp products embrace innovation to deliver compelling solutions to our business.
As a member of the hardware sustaining team, the engineer will participate in the support of hardware platforms throughout the product's life. This includes both root cause analysis of field issues as well as the qualification of 2nd source and EOL parts/components. Opportunities to participate in development and validation of new products are also available.
This position requires an individual to be creative, a quick learner, driven to produce results, and able to demonstrate the ability to lead small teams or projects.

Job Requirements

  • Must have 5+ years' experience or equivalent in a Hardware sustaining role.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Experience in digital design, system debug, and verification.
  • Responsibilities include: design, development, validation, and debug of HW modules and systems.
  • Provides technical support to marketing, sales, operations, and design partners throughout the life of the product.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment of engineers to meet aggressive goals and high-quality standards.
  • Comfortable with change and the dynamic nature of a high-tech development environment.
  • Ability to evaluate product designs for technical feasibility and follow standard engineering principles to meet rigorous design standards.
  • Ability to diagnose issues within x86 design schematics to discover root cause of hardware issues.
  • Experienced with PCIe Gen3 and newer design.
  • Experience using lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, protocol analyzers, and power meters, with component-level troubleshooting skills.
  • A strong digital design background and debugging experience in high-speed interfaces, processor and chipsets, memory, PCIe, and networking interfaces is a plus.
  • This individual must work effectively with staff to senior manager level employees within the function and the technical team on assigned projects. There may be communication with employees in other functions within the Business Units as required.
  • Limited management direction is provided to the employee on new projects or assignments, as well as review of activities and priorities.
  • The ideal candidate will be a proactive contributor and subject matter expert on team projects.
  • To be successful, this individual must demonstrate favorable results through coaching and influencing others.
  • This individual is able to successfully convey information to stakeholders at many levels related to the position.
  • Required to work independently.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Hardware Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.

description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Configuration Senior Analyst to join our team in Bengaluru, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced SCCM/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex SCCM/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Leadership & Architecture
• Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise SCCM/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
• Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
• Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
• Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
• Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
• Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
• Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
• Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with SCCM/Intune patch deployment cycles.
• Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
• Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment & Provisioning
• Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
• Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
• Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
• Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
• Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation & Integration
• Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for SCCM and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
• Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy enforcement, and reporting.
• Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
• Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement & Delivery Governance
• Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
• Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
• Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
• Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
• Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

REQUIRED SKILLS
• Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
• Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
• Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
• Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
• PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
• SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
• Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
• Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) — required
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect or Security Engineer certifications
• Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
• Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)
• Familiarity with ISO 27001, India IT Act compliance, and global data residency considerations in EPM

MINIMUM EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent enterprise experience and advanced Microsoft certifications will be considered.

title: Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our 3rd year Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap designed to show you first-hand what it’s like to be part of a pharmacy team while gaining an overview of store, district, and regional operations. You will gain valuable hands-on experience through a training roadmap that includes a combination of Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), activities, and time spent with leaders in your district. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

3rd year Pharmacy Interns are responsible for completion of a comprehensive training roadmap, focusing on KLEs that build aptitude in the following areas. As tenure increases, 3rd year Pharmacy Interns take on increasing responsibility of the safety and effectiveness of operations in the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the 3rd year Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Accepted into, or actively enrolled in, an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • ; Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Program Associate
description:
Job Title: Program Associate

Location: Remote, US

Role: Only available for current Neovance contingent workforce.

About Neovance:

At Neovance, we’re transforming the patient experience by driving better outcomes through compassion, innovation, and operational excellence. With more than 30 years of experience partnering with the biopharmaceutical industry, we deliver agile, technology-enabled patient access solutions that help people start and stay on therapy.

Our expertise spans HUB services, patient assistance programs, field reimbursement, nursing, and non-commercial pharmacy – each designed to remove barriers to care and ensure patients receive the therapies they need when they need them.

Guided by our values of Agility, Integrity, Tenacity, Unity, and Quality, we work as one Neovance team to optimize access, enhance adherence, and make a meaningful impact, one patient at a time.

The Opportunity:

As a Program Associate at Neovance, you’ll be the subject-matter expert for specialized healthcare programs, training and coaching agents, monitoring quality, analyzing program reporting, and delivering exceptional customer service. You’ll identify service trends, manage escalations, take part in client meetings, and mentor team members, all while finding ways to continuously improve program outcomes.

This is a full-time, remote U.S. role in a fast-paced contact-center environment. You’ll typically work an eight-hour shift, Monday – Friday, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM ET based on your assigned program, with a 30- or 60-minute unpaid lunch and occasional overtime as needed.

What You'll Do:

Agent Training & Coaching

  • Lead training sessions – Deliver training on program service offerings, standard operating procedures, and software systems for staff within your assigned program.
  • Keep training current and compliant – Stay up to date on program procedures, keep training materials, reference guides, and quality and audit requirements in compliance, and recommend improvements based on training effectiveness.
  • Coach and mentor – Monitor new agents’ performance and serve as an ongoing coach and mentor once training is complete.
  • Assess call quality – Listen to agent calls to evaluate customer service levels and provide feedback to Supervisors and the Program Manager, Service Delivery.
  • Partner across teams – Collaborate with other functional teams to identify training needs, update training programs, and maintain consistent call quality expectations.
  • Protect patient information – Follow all organizational and regulatory standards for handling patient information, including patient safety reporting, and complete all required privacy and data-handling training.

Client & Program Communication

  • Respond to stakeholders – Answer questions from client contacts, the Program Manager, Service Delivery, Account Director, and program customers with clear, concise communication.
  • Manage escalations – Handle program call escalations by listening to customers, identifying solutions, and following through on next steps.
  • Spot trends – Identify and escalate program trends based on common questions and contribute recommendations to address issues.
  • Support client meetings – Attend client meetings to support the program and Supervisor as needed.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Report on performance – Prepare and interpret standard monthly and ad hoc program reports, communicating trends and issues to your Supervisor.
  • Drive improvement – Proactively identify process and performance improvement opportunities and partner with your Supervisor and the Program Manager, Service Delivery to assess and implement changes.
  • Solve problems – Apply analytical problem-solving skills to address program issues and challenges.

Program Expertise

  • Be the go-to expert – Serve as team lead and subject matter expert on program processes, lending technical expertise when needed.
  • Close knowledge gaps – Identify program-specific knowledge gaps from agent calls, escalate to your Supervisor, and help develop recommendations to improve.
  • Help build the team – Participate in interview panels for Program Specialists and Program Representatives as needed.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public health, clinical science, health services research, health economics, or a related field (or evidence of continual progress toward a degree); OR a high school diploma/GED plus 6+ years of equivalent experience in a relevant field
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare, reimbursement, a healthcare contact center, healthcare program management, or a closely related field
  • Experience leading, organizing, and establishing program training and providing guidance to staff
  • Experience working with data

description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
We are currently recruiting Security Architects to join our growing client advisory & delivery business.
NTT DATA is one of the world’s largest Global Security services providers with over 7500 Security SMEs and Integration partner to many of the worlds most recognized Security Technology providers. We believe that by bringing everyone together, we can solve problems using innovative technology that can create a world that is sustainable and secure.

The Security Architect will Contribute to the design, implementation and ongoing development of the security architecture of the client's IT systems.
The Security Architect will draw upon Enterprise Security Architecture or Security Solutions Architecture to Contribute to:
- Identify business objectives, user needs, risk appetite and cyber security obligations
- Identify vulnerabilities, perform threat modelling, undertake risk assessment, evaluate the effectiveness of security controls
- Verify and evidence alignment to 'Secure by Design' principles, corporate security policy/standards as well as industry recognized frameworks and best practice
Looking ahead to future opportunities. As our business continues to grow, we are building a pipeline of exceptional talent for upcoming positions across the UK. This advertisement is intended to identify and engage candidates in advance of specific vacancies becoming available. We encourage you to apply if you would like to be considered for future opportunities that match your expertise.

What you’ll be doing;
• Contribute to deliver and continually enhance a coherent approach to the design of secure client end-to-end solutions
• Contribute to secure conceptual, logical and high-level designs by identifying appropriate security controls to be embedded in solutions that meet business requirements whilst evidencing alignment to the target risk appetite.
• Contribute to the design and be able to articulate and justify design recommendations at security architecture assurance gates
• Contribute to design documentation, options papers, risk assessments, stakeholder presentations and be able to effectively communicate these to both senior technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Contribute to reference architecture of established patterns, principles and guidelines
• Contribute to the development of the Security Practice skills and capabilities to ensure consistent high quality of service delivery and expertise. Active coaching and mentoring of junior members of the team
• Contribute to the development of collateral to support Security Consulting ‘go to market’s propositions and service offerings.
• Contribute to the development and presentation of compelling client proposals collaborating with teams across our business.
• Contribute to documented Information Security Management Plans which incorporate Regulatory, Legal and Compliance in relation to applicable security policies. Standards and guidelines
• Contribute to the identification of identified risks and emerging cyber security vulnerabilities and threats. The subsequent analysis to quantify and lead risk mitigation plans
• Work with Service Management to ensure that partners and suppliers adhere to agreed standards, policies and verify/evidence appropriate compliance and security KPIs
• Work closely with 1st, 2nd and 3rd lines of defense on all matters relating to cyber security, information assurance, cyber risk, data privacy including regulatory and compliance considerations
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of governance, risk and compliance aligned to policy, standards an industry good practice
• Ensure that continuous assessment, identification, analysis and reporting of useful metrics to enable informed risk-based decisions to be taken
• Constructively challenge established processes and controls to identify, recommend and facilitate continuous improvement, ensuring that all personnel (including senior stakeholders) understand their responsibilities in relation to security risk mitigation and remediation
• Review and verify that documentation relating to process and technical security controls are maintained

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
  • • Awareness and understanding of industry security frameworks and guidance such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, NCSC CAF and other NCSC guidelines
    • Good knowledge of networking (switching, routing, firewalls)
    • Awareness or limited experience with the design concepts associated with adoption of Cloud platforms (AWS and/or Microsoft Azure)
    • An understanding of the native security capabilities and some practice within Cloud platforms (AWS and/or Microsoft Azure)
    • Understanding of modern security concepts, common attack vectors, malware, security analytics and threat intelligence.
    • A understanding of security testing and vulnerability management is important (including pen testing/ITHC, CVSS/CVE)
    • Some experience working with security standards such as ISO 27001, 27002, 27017, 27108 etc
    DESIRABLE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Cyber Security
    • Any One of the certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC) or equivalent experience
    • Good knowledge covering at least 2 of the following examples (this list is not exhaustive): AD, Cryptography, End User Computing, IAM, PKI, Server hardening, SIEM, SOAR, virtualization (VMware)
    ROLE DUTIES
    • Thrive as a consultant seeking the variety and challenge of engaging with different clients and variety of technologies and solution types.
    • Developing security vulnerabilities and techniques for applying effective controls.
    • Contribute to the development of secure system without close supervision.
    • Contribute to security requirements for new systems or changes to existing systems without close supervision.
    • Execute technical management tasks in respect to ongoing client projects.

CHARACTERISTICS
• Strong teamwork skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Self-motivation and able to take responsibility.
• Persuasive communicator, using logic to win support and change views.


SECURITY CLEARANCE
Please note that candidates must hold or be able to gain UK SC level Security Clearance or higher. Therefore, we can only accept applications from British Nationals who meet these criteria. Candidates with dual Nationality must flag this during the recruitment process.

IGTS Usability Design Intern

Job Description

Your responsibilities

  • Support usability design, user research, and design research for healthcare and IGT-S projects
  • Conduct desk research and hospital visits to understand user experience, interface trends, market context, and design opportunities.
  • Join qualitative research activities, including interviews, usability sessions, expert reviews, workshops, and clinical workflow observations.
  • Support quantitative research, including questionnaire preparation, fieldwork tracking, data interpretation, and reporting.
  • Synthesize findings into user needs, workflow pain points, usability insights, and design opportunities.
  • Provide design-related support to projects led by team members without a design background.
  • Communicate usability ideas through sketches, storyboards, user flows, mockups, prototypes, or presentation materials.
  • Collaborate with designers, usability specialists, clinical specialists, engineers, and project stakeholders.

We are looking for

1. Education: Actively enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Product Design, Industrial Design, Interaction Design, Service Design, Human Factors, Psychology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field. Experience or interest in healthcare design/Psychology is preferred.

2. Work experience

  • Has interned for well-known design, research, or consulting firms.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical devices, usability research, interaction design, or service design is preferred.

3. Capabilities and skills

  • Be familiar with user research and usability methods, such as personas, scenarios, journey maps, user flows, service blueprints, usability testing, concept testing, workflow analysis, and insight synthesis.
  • Good skills in communication, logic and systematic thinking, and innovative thinking.
  • Good skills in design-related fields, such as sketching, CAD, and prototyping.
  • Be familiar with design trends, materials, engineering, and manufacturing.
  • Be proficient in Microsoft Office tools, especially PowerPoint, Word, and Excel; experience with design or prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Axure, or similar tools is preferred.

4. Others

  • Passionate about innovation, user research, and strategy.
  • Able to work under pressure.
  • Result-oriented and professional.
  • Willing to communicate and collaborate with others.
  • Warm, open-minded, and proactive.

We prefer candidates who are fluent in Chinese and have proficient English communication skills.

title: Systems Architect- Medical Ultrasound Hardware (Cambridge, MA or Bothell, WA)
description:
Job Title

Systems Architect- Medical Ultrasound Hardware (Cambridge, MA or Bothell, WA)

Job Description

In this role you will help shape the future of Philips Ultrasound imaging platforms. As a Systems Architect, you will integrate hardware, software, imaging, transducers, and clinical needs to create safe, reliable, and scalable solutions that advance clinical performance and care.

Your role:

  • Create and evolve imaging platform architectures for diagnostic ultrasound products, defining clear boundaries, interfaces, assumptions, and design rationale. Translate clinical, user, business, service, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory needs into architecture drivers and measurable system requirements.
  • Lead system-level trade studies that balance image quality and performance with thermal and power constraints, reliability, cybersecurity, cost, supply continuity, serviceability, sustainability, and platform reuse. Use modeling, prototyping, and focused experiments to reduce uncertainty and make evidence-based recommendations.
  • Evaluate emerging compute, GPU, acquisition, signal-path, display, control, power, connectivity, and transducer-interface technologies against real product and clinical needs. Contribute to reusable platform enablers and technology roadmaps that accelerate innovation across the ultrasound portfolio.
  • Define integration and verification strategies that uncover interface issues and retire the most important technical and patient-safety risks early. Maintain design and requirement integrity while guiding decisions across hardware, software, imaging, transducers, clinical science, design quality, manufacturing, and service.
  • Communicate architecture intent, alternatives, evidence, risks, and decisions clearly to technical teams and business leaders. Mentor engineers and strengthen systems thinking, architecture quality, and engineering rigor across your program teams.

You're the right fit if:

  • You have a Master’s Degree in a related discipline; PhD preferred.
  • You’ve acquired 5+ years of industry and/or academic experience in Ultrasound System Architecture, System Design, Hardware Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Your skills include Product Development Lifecycle Management, Verification and Validation Testing, Technical Documentation, Regulatory Requirements, Requirement Analysis, Business Acumen, Strategic Planning, Systems Architecture, and Risk Management.
  • You combine curiosity and invention with engineering discipline. You are energized by new technology and equally committed to patient safety, reliability, quality, and responsible product realization.
  • You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. title: Communications and Brand Senior Manager, Korea and APAC
description:
Job Title

Communications and Brand Senior Manager, Korea and APAC

Job Description

About Philips and the opportunity

At Philips, our purpose is to improve people's health and well-being through meaningful innovation. As a global leader in health technology, we help deliver better care for more people through solutions that improve patient outcomes, enhance clinical productivity, and expand access to quality healthcare.

Communications and brand are critical enablers of this vision. They build trust, strengthen reputation, elevate thought leadership, and support business growth by positioning Philips as a leading partner in healthcare transformation.


We are seeking a strategic, entrepreneurial, and future-focused Manager, Communications & Brand to lead communications and brand activities across Korea, Thailand, and Vietnam, while serving as the Communications & Brand Business Partner for one of Philips' businesses across APAC.

The role will shape reputation, drive stakeholder engagement, enhance executive visibility, and deliver integrated communications strategies that advance business priorities. The successful candidate will combine strategic communications expertise with a strong understanding of healthcare and the evolving role of artificial intelligence, using both to strengthen Philips' leadership in health technology and innovation.

As the communications lead for Korea, you will partner closely with country leadership, business teams, and regional and global colleagues.


Job Title: Communications and Brand Senior Manager, Korea and APAC

Location: Seoul
Reports to: Head of Communications and Brand, APAC


Your Role

Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted communications and brand advisor to country leadership and APAC business leaders, providing strategic counsel on reputation, executive visibility, thought leadership, stakeholder engagement, and business transformation.
  • Partner with leadership teams to align communications strategies with business objectives, growth priorities, customer engagement, and market opportunities.
  • Identify communications opportunities and risks and recommending strategies that strengthen Philips' reputation and market leadership.
  • Represent Communications & Brand as a strategic business partner, ensuring initiatives contribute to business outcomes, stakeholder trust, and organizational success.
  • Advise leaders on communicating Philips' innovation agenda, including AI-enabled healthcare solutions, in a credible, meaningful, and stakeholder-relevant way.

Reputation, Brand & Thought Leadership

  • Develop and execute integrated communications and brand strategies that strengthen Philips' reputation and position the company as a trusted leader in healthcare innovation.
  • Drive thought leadership on critical healthcare topics, including AI, clinical innovation, workforce challenges, sustainability, and access to care.
  • Build executive visibility platforms for senior leaders across healthcare, technology, policy, and business communities.
  • Ensure consistent application of Philips' brand identity, messaging, and corporate narrative across channels and stakeholder interactions.

Strategic Storytelling & Media Relations

  • Lead strategic storytelling that translates complex healthcare technologies, customer impact, and innovation into compelling narratives.
  • Identify and develop stories showing how Philips improves patient care, supports clinicians, and transforms healthcare delivery.
  • Build strong relationships with healthcare, business, technology, and mainstream media and lead proactive engagement that strengthens visibility, influence, and trust.
  • Develop high-quality executive communications, media materials, social content, customer stories, videos, speeches, articles, and employee communications.

AI-Enabled Communications Innovation

  • Champion responsible adoption of AI-enabled communications practices to enhance audience insight, stakeholder engagement, content effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
  • Use AI-powered tools and analytics for content development, social listening, reputation monitoring, trend analysis, campaign optimization, and performance measurement.
  • Identify emerging technologies and innovative approaches that improve communications impact, scale, and effectiveness.
  • Partner with business leaders to communicate Philips' AI innovation story responsibly and effectively.
  • Foster continuous learning and experimentation while applying human judgment, quality control, and governance.

Issues, Crisis & Reputation Management

  • Monitor the external environment to identify emerging issues, reputational risks, and opportunities.
  • Advise leadership on issues and crisis communications strategies and support timely, effective response planning.
  • Collaborate with legal, regulatory, quality, and business teams to ensure aligned communications during sensitive situations.
  • Protect and strengthen Philips' reputation through proactive stakeholder engagement and effective risk communications.

Campaigns, Employee Communications & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead integrated communications campaigns across earned, owned, shared, and internal channels.
  • Drive communications for product launches, customer partnerships, innovation announcements, and strategic initiatives.
  • Develop employee communications that foster engagement, alignment, and connection to Philips' purpose, strategy, and culture.
  • Collaborate across global, regional, and local teams and manage external agencies and partners to deliver high-quality, measurable outcomes.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish meaningful KPIs and measurement frameworks demonstrating contribution to business priorities, stakeholder engagement, and reputation.
  • Use data, analytics, and AI-driven insights to evaluate effectiveness and continuously optimize performance.
  • Champion communications innovation and best practices across the region.

You're the right fit if

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in communications, corporate affairs, public relations, brand, or marketing communications, ideally within healthcare, health technology, life sciences, or a multinational organization.
  • Proven experience providing strategic communications counsel to senior leaders and business executives.
  • Strong track record in integrated communications, reputation management, media relations, thought leadership, executive communications, and issues or crisis management.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively in a complex, matrixed, multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, policy landscape, and media environment in Korea; experience across APAC markets is advantageous.
  • Experience using digital tools, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve communications effectiveness and stakeholder engagement.
  • Understanding of the opportunities and implications of AI in healthcare, with the ability to translate complex innovation into compelling and accessible narratives.
  • Exceptional storytelling, content development, stakeholder engagement, strategic thinking, and business acumen.
  • Self-starter able to operate independently, manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Fluent in Korean and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

What success looks like

  • Stronger reputation and stakeholder trust in priority markets
  • Greater executive visibility and thought leadership influence
  • High-impact customer, innovation, and healthcare transformation storytelling
  • Clear contribution to strategic business priorities and market growth
  • Stronger employee alignment and engagement
  • Responsible use of AI and data-driven insight to improve communications effectiveness
  • Enhanced Philips leadership in healthcare innovation across Korea, ASEAN, and APAC

title: Pharmacy Intern - Grad
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Graduate Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a Graduate Pharmacy Intern, you will apply your didactic learning from pharmacy school and pharmacy practice into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor and District Leader, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap within 120 days of graduation designed to further your knowledge of store, district, and regional operations. Through your hands-on experience, training roadmap, and time spent with leaders in your district you will deepen your understanding of patient safety and error prevention, quality assurance drug utilization review (DUR), pharmacy professional standards such as corresponding responsibility and red flag detection. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

As tenure and readiness increase, you will take on greater accountability for supporting the management, oversight, and operations within the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the Graduate Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about vaccines and answering questions to obtain informed consent
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • PharmD graduate of a U.S. accredited program prior to beginning the Post-Graduate Training Program at CVS Health
  • Ability to obtain required pharmacist licensure within the required timeframe, per state guidelines. Failure to obtain required Pharmacist licensure within 120 days of graduation will result in separation of employment.
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, pharmacy interns should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:


$28.00 - $42.00


Whether in our pharmacies or through our health service offerings, we are pioneering a bold new approach to total health care. As health care innovators, we are making quality care affordable, accessible, simple and seamless. We await your fresh ideas, new perspectives, and the unique contributions you will make to our organization.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Etsimme asiakkaallemme maalaria rakennustyömaalle monipuolisiin maalaustöihin Vaasaan. Jos työskentely korkealla ei tuota sinulle ongelmia ja olet tarkkaotteinen tekijä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Mistä on kyse?

Työtehtäviin kuuluu putkien maalausta rakennustyömaalla. Työssä pääset työskentelemään kuukulkijalla, sillä maalaustöitä tehdään noin 8-28 metrin korkeudessa. Työ edellyttää varmuutta korkealla työskentelyyn sekä huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta.

Edellytämme sinulta voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia sekä valmiutta ja kykyä työskennellä korkealla kuukulkijan avulla. Toivomme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta maalaustöistä sekä kuukulkijan käytöstä. Arvostamme huolellista työotetta ja hyvää asennetta työntekoon.

Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian!

Voit jättää hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta. Carrotille työhakemuksen jättäminen on helppoa ja nopeaa. Carrot on nopea, välittävä ja vastuullinen työelämän kumppani, jonka tärkeimpänä tavoitteena on olla luomassa hyvää työelämää kaikille. title: Electronics Design Engineer – Test Automation- fixed term (All genders)
description:
Job Title

Electronics Design Engineer – Test Automation- fixed term (All genders)

Job Description

Electronics Design Engineer – Test Automation


As an Electronics Design Engineer – Test Automation, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of technology that healthcare professionals rely on every day.
Working at the intersection of hardware, software, and manufacturing, you will design and develop automated test solutions that help deliver high-quality medical devices to patients around the world in close collaboration with engineers across R&D, quality and manufacturing.


This is a fixed term position till September 2028



Your role:

  • Developing automated production tests for our patient monitoring portfolio in close collaboration with R&D during the product development lifecycle.
  • Designing and implementing innovative test solutions, including test hardware, fixtures, instrumentation, and test software.
  • Creating test concepts from component and PCB level up to complete manufacturing test systems.
  • Analyzing measurement data and continuously optimize test coverage, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Validating, verifying, and documenting test systems in compliance with medical device regulations and quality standards.
  • Supporting global production sites by maintaining and improving deployed test systems.
  • Driving innovation in our test development platform through modern engineering practices, automation, digitalization, and AI-assisted development approaches.



You're the right fit if:

  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Technical Informatics, or a related engineering discipline.
  • You have experience in electronics development, hardware testing, measurement technology, or test system development.
  • You possess solid knowledge of analog and digital electronics, signal conditioning, sensor interfaces, and high-speed signals.
  • You enjoy working hands-on with measurement equipment and solving complex technical challenges.
  • You have programming experience in environments such as Python, Go, LabVIEW, TestStand, or similar technologies.
  • You are comfortable using modern AI tools and coding assistants such as GPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable technologies to increase productivity and innovation.
  • You communicate effectively in English and German and enjoy working in an international environment.
  • You are curious, open-minded, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies.
  • You take ownership, enjoy working independently, and are equally comfortable collaborating within a team.
  • Most importantly, you are passionate about engineering and motivated to make a real impact on products that help improve and save lives every day.
  • Knowledge of medical device development, FDA regulations, ISO 13485, verification, or validation processes is an advantage but not required.



Compensation & Benefits

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €93,050.83 – €124,067.77. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. An entry-level position below this range may be offered if the job requirements are not yet fully met; in this case, the employee will be placed in a lowersalary band. We ensure compliance with internal compensation structures as well as standard market conditions.


This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.


Benefits include:

  • Annual leave: 30 days
  • Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…)
  • Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare
  • Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan
  • Philips “Partnerzeit”: two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
  • Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products
  • Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.



How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities


About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

  • Learn more about our business.
  • Discover our rich and exciting history.
  • Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion here.

title: Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our 3rd year Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap designed to show you first-hand what it’s like to be part of a pharmacy team while gaining an overview of store, district, and regional operations. You will gain valuable hands-on experience through a training roadmap that includes a combination of Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), activities, and time spent with leaders in your district. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

3rd year Pharmacy Interns are responsible for completion of a comprehensive training roadmap, focusing on KLEs that build aptitude in the following areas. As tenure increases, 3rd year Pharmacy Interns take on increasing responsibility of the safety and effectiveness of operations in the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the 3rd year Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Accepted into, or actively enrolled in, an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • ; Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, pharmacy interns should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs

title: Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our 3rd year Pharmacy Interns play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a 3rd year Pharmacy Intern, you will be focused on applying didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a comprehensive training roadmap designed to show you first-hand what it’s like to be part of a pharmacy team while gaining an overview of store, district, and regional operations. You will gain valuable hands-on experience through a training roadmap that includes a combination of Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), activities, and time spent with leaders in your district. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

3rd year Pharmacy Interns are responsible for completion of a comprehensive training roadmap, focusing on KLEs that build aptitude in the following areas. As tenure increases, 3rd year Pharmacy Interns take on increasing responsibility of the safety and effectiveness of operations in the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the 3rd year Pharmacy Intern may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Accepted into, or actively enrolled in, an ACPE accredited college or school of pharmacy
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • ; Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, pharmacy interns should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:


$20.00 - $23.75


Whether in our pharmacies or through our health service offerings, we are pioneering a bold new approach to total health care. As health care innovators, we are making quality care affordable, accessible, simple and seamless. We await your fresh ideas, new perspectives, and the unique contributions you will make to our organization.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.
