title: Team Lead - 806 | Whataburger806 (Rowlett, TX)
description:
Whataburger of Mesquite, Inc. – Team Leader

The Team Leader is responsible for ensuring each customer's experience meets or exceeds expectations. Supervises the performance of entrusted Team Members and leads them to perform all tasks according to stands. Undertakes the duties and tasks assigned to the Team Members as and when required to ensure that a high level of customer service is maintained. The Team Leader serves to assist Whataburger in satisfying its primary goal, customer Satisfaction.

To continue the path for career success at Whataburger, the Team Leader will participate in a skills development program and will be required to achieve certification in specific stations associated with the position.


BENEFITS

  • Competitive WEEKLY Pay
  • Referral Bonus Program
  • Schedule Flexibility
  • Development and Career Growth Opportunities
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Discounted Meals
  • Service Awards
  • Scholarship Program
  • Whataburger Family Foundation (Hardship Grant Assistance)
  • Chaplain Service
  • Paid Vacations


RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership and Communication

  • Protects and promotes the Whataburger Brand at all times.
  • Notifies a member of the management team with sufficient lead time when unable to report to work as scheduled.
  • Attends all meetings and training sessions as required by management.
  • Communicates problems outside a Team Leader's span of control to the Manager on duty as soon as possible.
  • Strives to continually enhance personal leadership style and improve personal performance.

People

  • Demonstrate Whataburger's Family Value Proposition, "Pride, Care, and Love."
  • Continues to learn and improve job skills as directed through performance appraisals.
  • Enforces company standards consistently demonstrating fairness in all situations through the Team Member Guidelines.
  • Maintains professional relationships with other Whataburger Family Members.
  • Uses on-the-spot training to improve performance by providing positive feedback and encouraging Family Members to ask questions.
  • Informs the Manger of critical training opportunities with individual Team Members.
  • Evaluates the performance of Team Members, and identifies training opportunities prior to issuing assignments for upcoming shifts.
  • Assists, supervises, and conducts Team Members training as always directed and reinforces company policy.
  • Corrects the cause for employee performance opportunities by examining/identifying the facts before prescribing a course of action.
  • Provides positive critical performance feedback in a sportive manner.
  • Stands out as a role model for others through daily interactions and leadership example, acts as a resource for other Team Members.

System

  • Assists the restaurant management by performing critical administrative tasks such as cash reporting, inventory audits, preparing deposits, closeouts, payroll adjustments, etc.
  • Performs any operational task upon request. Sets the example by performing as a role model whenever working, whether on duty as a Team Leader or filling a shift position.
  • Ensures all products are prepared according to quality standards, as ordered and delivered to the customer within Whataburger service time standards with a "no excuses" mentality.
  • Ensures the Drive-Thru production flow keeps pace with traffic by remaining alert and following up at regular intervals.
  • Ensures the physical appearance of self, employees, property, dining area, restrooms, outer and food production areas continuously meet standards.
  • Promotes excellence in customer relations to the rest of the team.
  • Communicates directions clearly and follows up to ensure specific actions are carried out as intended.
  • Ensures all actions are carried out according to policy and procedure, treating exceptions as training opportunities.
  • Ensures all Team Members report for work, clock in and out as scheduled.
  • Ensures all safety policies and procedures are maintained to provide a safe environment for customers.
  • Ensures all Team Members perform safely, applying the necessary precautions and safety equipment in all situations, such as leaks, wet floors, equipment cleaning and maintenance etc.
  • Completes shift reports to communicate key events to the Manager and other team leaders.
  • Accurately records the food inventory prior to and at the close of each shift, as directed.
  • Ensures all equipment operates safely, at the proper temperatures and within the Company's guidelines.
  • Maintains knowledge of and follows all emergency procedures. Handles emergencies in a controlled, exact manner to avoid confusion and further crisis.
  • Assumes additional responsibilities as assigned.

Customer

  • Ensures all customers are satisfied and receive their product(s), as ordered within Whataburger service time standards.
  • Maintains the appearance of the restaurant to ensure customers have a positive image of Whataburger and its Team Members.
  • Changes out POP when necessary.
  • Answers the phone in a courteous, articulate manner, according to Whataburger procedure.
  • Handles any customer complaints and ensures satisfaction in accordance with company policy.

Finance

  • Demonstrates fiscal responsibility with all Company assets.
  • Follows company cash handling policies.
  • Monitors all cash handling and sales terminal operations to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitors cash handling and inventory controls through regular follow up and observation.
  • Prepares cash deposits and manages the change fund accurately.
  • Audits registers and records discrepancies.
  • Controls labor and food expense in relation to sales and takes appropriate action to ensure the highest possible productivity is achieved during assigned shifts.
  • Controls food costs by ensuring proper portioning.
  • Assists with preparing, reviewing and making bank deposits.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Must have the ability to stand during entire shift.
  • Ability to reach, bend, stoop, lift, shake, stir, pour, carry and push.
  • Ability to read (Orders on tickets, Menu Board, receipts, etc.)
  • Frequent contact/immersion of hands in water, cleaning and sanitation solutions, meat products, poultry products, seafood and produce items.
  • Frequent washing of hands.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

  • Effectively serves as a team player in supporting the goals of the organization.
  • Responsible for the completion of well-defined tasks or projects set by management.
  • Promotes teamwork among all team members.
  • Accepts professional, timely criticism in a mature, positive fashion as intended, for personal development.
  • Demonstrates and promotes a "can do" attitude when addressing customer requests, concerns, and complaints to assure customer satisfaction is achieved at all times.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to listen to employees, emphasizing the appropriate chain of communication in problem situations.
  • Displays a commitment to the restaurant's success and performs an appropriate share of the work.

title: Senior Manager, Ads Channel & Partnerships, APAC
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About the Role

Netflix Ads in APAC is building a programmatic-first business. Demand-side platforms (DSPs) are the primary route to scale, and Sales Solutions is the team that turns those partnerships into revenue. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the Ads Partnerships team and to personally own Greater China Export partnerships.

This is a player-coach role. As the coach, you will manage the Partner Managers in Korea, Australia, Japan and Southeast Asia, who work with DSPs, data and measurement providers, and agency holding companies in their markets, and you will set the regional partnership strategy. As the player, you will personally own the Greater China Export partner book. Today the team’s work is centred on DSPs. As APAC extends its Emerging Business model, the scope will broaden to resellers, aggregators, agencies and other demand-generation partners, and the role will become the single owner of how partners drive revenue across the region.

You will sit within a combined Sales Solutions and Measurement team, working daily with Measurement, Tech Integrations, Product, Sales and Business Operations. The team is in build mode, so you will shape the playbook as well as run it.

What You Will Do:


1. Drive Greater China Export revenue through partners (player)

  • Own the Greater China Export partner book personally, building and running the partnerships, agencies and DSP routes that bring Greater China-based advertisers to Netflix for campaigns in international markets, and be accountable for the revenue they deliver.
  • Negotiate and run Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with the DSPs and partners that serve Greater China Export demand, setting enablement, lead-list alignment, incentives and shared targets. Set the standard for the JBPs your team runs in Korea, Australia, Japan and Southeast Asia.
  • Design and execute co-sell motions with DSP commercial teams and agencies, such as agency enablement sessions, seasonal promotions and incentive programs, to activate non-direct and incremental demand.
  • Be the senior escalation point for complex partner questions and for any partner conversation that needs regional leadership.

2. Lead and grow the team (coach)

  • Manage and develop the Partner Managers in Korea, Australia, Japan and Southeast Asia. Set clear market and partner priorities, agree individual goals, give regular and candid feedback and ensure thoughtful team succession planning.
  • Allocate team capacity between core sales support, strategic DSP work and Emerging Business demand generation, and make the trade-offs explicit.
  • Hire and onboard. Help shape the team as a new headcount is approved, including future market and channel coverage.
  • Create the operating rhythm: partner tiering, KPIs, QBR cadence, pipeline reviews and shared playbooks that every Partner Manager uses.

3. Set partnership strategy and own the economics

  • Define the APAC partnership strategy across DSPs, data and clean room providers, measurement providers and, over time, resellers and aggregators, in line with the programmatic-first and revenue goals of Sales Solutions.
  • Own the financial health of partnership investments. Build ROI models, track spend against return, and make sure every deal is structured for sustainable value.
  • Build business cases for new partners and new markets, including where local DSPs and data providers are still maturing.
  • Manage the full partnership lifecycle from evaluation and due diligence through contracting and onboarding (with Business Operations and Legal) to performance optimisation and renewal.

4. Build the channel for Emerging Business

  • Extend partner coverage beyond DSPs to resellers, aggregators, agencies and other demand-generation partners that reach advertisers Netflix does not cover directly. Run the evaluation, selection and terms for these partners.
  • Make Partner Managers the named support model for every Emerging Business partner and advertiser, working with the lead-management agent and APIs based solution so that growth comes from product and partner coverage, not added headcount.
  • Keep the channel clean: conflict-free, objective lead lists, clear account ownership across DSP, reseller and direct routes, and a clear graduation path to Enterprise or NAL coverage as accounts grow.

title: Asbestos Analyst & Surveyor Apprenticeship (Level 3) - ENV Surveys Ltd
description:
﻿﻿
Location: Role is site based across London and the South East (Main office is 12 Upper Hollingdean Rd, Brighton BN1 7GA)

Expected Start Date: ASAP

Working for ENV Surveys Ltd.

Founded in 2002, ENV Asbestos Surveys delivers a comprehensive range of asbestos consultancy services. Our services include Asbestos Surveys, Asbestos Sample Testing, Air testing and monitoring for asbestos, and Four Stage Clearance procedures. All of our services strictly adhere to HSE guidelines and meet quality standards accredited by the United Kingdom Accreditation Service (UKAS).

🔗 About ENV Surveys Ltd

The Package
  • Starting salary of £19,500/year to £26,000/year (depending on age and experience)
  • Statutory holiday entitlement and an extra day off for your birthday
  • Workings hours are 37.5 hours per week
  • Company vehicle provided (UK Manual licence required)
  • Company pension scheme
  • Regular training and CPD opportunities
We are pleased to offer an opportunity for an Asbestos Analyst & Surveyor Apprentice (Level 3) to join the team, supporting asbestos surveying, air monitoring, sampling and site inspections. This varied, site-based role involves travelling to different locations, helping to identify asbestos-containing materials, monitoring airborne fibres and ensuring compliance with health and safety regulations.

This apprenticeship provides a strong foundation for a future career in asbestos analysis and surveying, offering hands-on experience and the opportunity to develop practical and technical skills alongside experienced industry professionals.
  • Assist with asbestos surveys, site inspections and the identification of asbestos-containing materials.
  • Carry out air monitoring and use microscopes to analyse airborne fibre samples.
  • Support inspections of asbestos removal projects and clearance procedures to ensure areas are safe for reoccupation.
  • Collect samples, record findings and prepare accurate technical reports.
  • Communicate professionally with clients and contractors on site.
  • Follow health and safety procedures and relevant asbestos regulations.
  • Travel to different sites, with flexibility for occasional weekend and out-of-hours work.
You’re someone who prefers being out on site rather than behind a desk, and you’re comfortable working in environments like construction, demolition, or industrial settings. Early starts, travel, and changing locations don’t put you off — in fact, you enjoy the variety and the sense of purpose that comes with hands-on work.

You take safety seriously and understand the importance of following procedures properly. Working to strict rules, method statements, and risk assessments feels natural to you, and you don’t cut corners. You’re calm, focused, and able to stay composed even in regulated environments where inspections, audits, or oversight are part of the job.

You’re practical by nature and learn best by doing. Repetition and routine don’t bother you — you see them as part of building consistency and getting things right every time. You’re comfortable using equipment, following technical processes, and working in PPE or RPE for extended periods when required.

You can work independently once trained, taking responsibility for your tasks, but you also communicate clearly with teammates and supervisors to make sure work is completed safely and correctly. You’re motivated by doing work that matters — contributing to environmental safety, compliance, and protecting public health.

You value clear expectations, stability, and progression. You’re interested in building a long-term career, developing your skills step by step, and moving forward into roles such as surveyor or analyst over time.

Please note: You must be 18+ due to the nature of the working environment
Please note: A full UK manual driving licence is required for this role

Apprenticeship Eligibility

To apply for this apprenticeship, you must:

✔️ Be 18 or over
✔️ Not be in full-time education
✔️ Have lived in the UK for at least 3 years
✔️ Have the right to work in the UK

Apprenticeships are designed to provide new knowledge, skills and behaviours, so applicants should not already hold a Level 3, degree or higher qualification in a closely related subject, or have significant experience in the same field.

If you’re unsure whether you meet the criteria, we’d still love to hear from you - get in touch and we can advise you further.
Start your career as an asbestos site technician and gain hands-on experience supporting essential surveying, air monitoring, and inspection work in real-world environments.

As part of this Level 3 Asbestos Site Technician apprenticeship, you’ll learn how to carry out asbestos surveys, air monitoring, and clearance activities, applying recognised industry methods to produce accurate, compliant, and legally defensible results.

Over 12 months, you’ll combine day-to-day experience in your role with structured training delivered by expert tutors at Tiro. Our blended learning approach includes a mix of online sessions, in-person training, and hands-on support, alongside guidance from a dedicated mentor in the workplace.

You’ll spend at least 6 hours per week on off-the-job training, including virtual learning, practical activities, and applied assignments.

What your training will look like:﻿﻿You’ll follow a structured programme combining live sessions, online learning, and hands-on workplace training to build your skills step by step.

As part of your training, you’ll also work towards the RSPH Level 3 Award in Asbestos Air Monitoring and Clearance Procedures, a recognised qualification within the asbestos industry.

What could your future look like?

This apprenticeship will help you build the skills and experience needed to start your career as an asbestos site technician and progress within the asbestos management industry.

Through hands-on training, you’ll develop the competence and confidence to carry out asbestos surveys, air monitoring, and clearance testing in line with regulatory requirements. You’ll work in safety-critical environments, following strict compliance standards and contributing to protecting people, property, and the wider environment. This programme can also lead to professional recognition, such as becoming a Registered Science Technician (RSciTech).

You’ll gain experience that’s highly valued in a regulated and essential industry, opening up opportunities to grow and specialise within asbestos surveying, air monitoring, and related technical roles.

· Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams.

· Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts.

title: Solution Architect — Interoperability (IBE / Rhapsody)
description:
Job Title

Solution Architect — Interoperability (IBE / Rhapsody)

Job Description

One sentence description of role

Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of healthcare interoperability solutions, partnering with customers to successfully integrate clinical systems and drive complex implementation projects across Latin America.

Your role:

  • Lead the technical delivery of healthcare interoperability projects, from solution architecture and technical design through implementation, go-live, stabilization, and post-production support.

  • Collaborate with healthcare providers, IT teams, biomedical engineers, clinical stakeholders, and third-party vendors to translate clinical workflows into scalable integration solutions.

  • Install, configure, troubleshoot, and optimize Philips IntelliBridge Enterprise (IBE), Rhapsody (or equivalent), HL7, DICOM, SQL-based integrations, and Windows Server environments.

  • Own technical project execution, including architecture documentation, UAT, cutover planning, hypercare, L2 support, technical governance, and customer communication throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support presales activities by providing technical expertise during solution design, proof of concepts, feasibility assessments, and customer presentations.

  • Mentor junior consultants, contribute to delivery best practices, and help standardize reusable implementation assets and documentation.

  • From career growth opportunities within Philips' global Health Systems organization to continuous learning in cutting-edge healthcare technologies, a career at Philips offers opportunities to expand both your technical expertise and leadership capabilities. Be sure to speak to your recruiter about benefits in your region.

You're the right fit if:

  • 8+ years delivering healthcare interoperability or Healthcare IT solutions with customer-facing implementation experience, including UAT, go-live, hypercare, and post-live support.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Philips IntelliBridge Enterprise (IBE) or equivalent interoperability platforms, Rhapsody (or similar interface engines), HL7, DICOM, SQL, Windows Server, cloud environments, and technical troubleshooting.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; Master's Degree is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, fluency in English, and proficiency in Spanish and Portuguese. Experience with Agile/SAFe, ITIL, cybersecurity, I2M architecture, or PDLM integrations is considered an advantage.

How we work together


We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.


About Philips


We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.


• Learn more about our business.
• Discover our rich and exciting history.
• Learn more about our purpose.
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: Systems Engineering Specialist
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Specialist to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).

We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Advanced Application Packaging
• Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
• Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
• Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
• Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
• Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
• Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.
Compatibility & Remediation
• Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
• Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
• Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures — custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
• Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
• Assess applications for MSIX packaging suitability and document conversion feasibility with recommended approach.
Deployment Integration & Automation
• Build SCCM application models with complex detection methods, global conditions, requirement rules, and multi-deployment-type configurations.
• Develop PowerShell automation scripts for batch packaging operations, package validation, and SCCM/Intune inventory reporting.
• Integrate packaging workflows with software delivery pipelines — scripted uploads to Intune via Graph API, SCCM package import automation.
• Support Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline integration for automated package build and test workflows.
• Develop and maintain packaging test scripts for regression automation on golden image environments.
Quality & Governance
• Define and enforce packaging standards, quality checklists, and peer review processes for the India packaging team.
• Conduct technical review of packages produced by junior packagers and provide structured feedback.
• Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.
• Contribute to SLA governance by tracking packaging queue metrics, turnaround times, and defect rates.
• Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.
REQUIRED SKILLS
• Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
• MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
• App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
• Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
• PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
• Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
• Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
• Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
• Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
• Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
• Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
MINIMUM EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent senior enterprise packaging experience will be considered.

title: Foreign Pharmacy Grad - International Pharmacy Intern
description:
You’ve invested a lot of time and energy in your education. Now you want the chance to make your mark. We offer challenging opportunities for you to learn and grow professionally. In our programs, you’ll be immersed in a culture of continuous improvement, with the goal of changing health care for the better.

Position Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise, while developing their own skills in preparation for increasing responsibility.

As a US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate, after successfully passing FPGEE and TOEFL, you will be eligible to complete your required US Internship hours and apply your didactic learning from pharmacy school into real-world practice to become ready for a Pharmacist role. Under the direction of your preceptor, you will complete a mixed modality learning plan designed to further develop your knowledge, skills, and abilities. US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates are required to successfully complete their internship within 18 months and be prepared to complete and pass all required Pharmacist licensure exams and processes within 120-days of the completion of required US Internship hours.

Through your hands-on experience, training roadmap, Key Learning Experiences (KLEs), and time spent with leaders in your district, you will deepen your understanding of and participate in pharmacy practice and patient care scenarios, build business acumen to understand how to improve pharmacy performance, and develop leadership skills to learn how to engage the pharmacy team and drive business outcomes. While in the pharmacy, you will assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. You will learn to operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout your shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, you will learn to demonstrate empathy and genuine care, and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

A US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

  • Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and Technicians manage and improve patient health
  • Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment
  • Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems
  • Offering to counsel, fielding medical questions, and soliciting information on a patient’s medical history to provide optimal care, when appropriate under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist
  • Taking telephonic prescriptions from the prescriber, and calling the prescriber to clarify prescriptions or facilitate medication changes, where allowed by state regulation
  • Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices
  • Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
  • Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
  • Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business
  • Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security
  • Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification

Where permissible, the US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities:

  • Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
  • Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
  • Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
  • Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

Required Qualifications:

  • Foreign Graduate from a Non-US Accredited college or school of pharmacy prior to beginning US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduate Training Program at CVS
  • FPGEC certification
  • Pharmacist licensure in the state in which the position is based within 120 days of completion of US Intern hours. Failure to complete required US Intern hours within 18 months, or to obtain Pharmacist licensure as prescribed, will result in separation of employment.
  • Must possess, or be in the process of obtaining, valid intern and/or technician licensure as required

Essential Functions:

  • Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
  • Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
  • Attention and Focus:
    • Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
    • Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
    • Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
  • Customer Service and Team Orientation:
    • Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
    • Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
  • Communication Skills:
    • Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
    • Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
  • Mathematical Reasoning:
    • Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
  • Physical Demands:
    • Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
    • Lift, scan, and bag items
    • Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
    • Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
    • Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
    • Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
    • Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
    • Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
    • Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs. and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs. and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
    • Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
    • Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
  • Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of related work experience in pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting
  • Ability to become immunization certified: Once state regulations are met, US Non-Accredited Foreign Graduates should be striving to provide patient immunizations as this is an essential pharmacist function
  • Ability to work in home store, and across the market in other locations, to meet business needs

description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a SSIS and SQL Server Support Tech Lead to join our team in Addison, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).

We are looking for an experienced SSIS & SQL Server Support Tech Lead to lead and support critical database, ETL, and data integration environments. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep SQL Server/SSIS expertise, strong production support experience, confident people leadership, and the ability to manage complex cross-functional situations.

The ideal candidate must be comfortable leading critical incidents, working hands-on to solve complex technical problems, managing stakeholder expectations, and driving teams across multiple departments and dependencies. Beyond keeping systems operational, this person will be expected to proactively identify opportunities for automation, performance improvement, modernization, process simplification, cost/effort reduction, and improved user experience.

  • Production Support & Incident Leadership: Lead troubleshooting and resolution of critical SQL Server, SSIS, ETL, database, batch, and job failures. Take command during major incidents, coordinate cross-functional teams, drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and ensure permanent corrective actions.

  • SQL Server Performance: Analyze and optimize complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexes, execution plans, blocking/deadlocks, database performance, and high-volume workloads.

  • SSIS & ETL: Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance SSIS packages for performance, resiliency, restartability, error handling, logging, monitoring, and data quality.

  • Technical & People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and guide engineers; establish technical standards and best practices; conduct code/script reviews; improve team capability and reduce dependency on individual SMEs.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work confidently across application, infrastructure, database, data engineering, business, vendor, and other teams. Understand upstream/downstream dependencies and drive issues to resolution regardless of organizational boundaries.

  • Automation & Continuous Improvement: Automate repetitive operational activities using PowerShell, Python, T-SQL, SQL Agent, or similar tools. Proactively identify solutions that reduce incidents, manual effort, processing time, and operational cost.

  • User Experience & Innovation: Identify opportunities for dashboards, monitoring, self-service capabilities, or lightweight UI solutions that simplify support processes and improve business/user experience.

  • Modernization: Recommend opportunities to modernize legacy SQL/SSIS workloads using technologies such as Databricks, Python, PySpark, cloud data platforms, and modern ETL/data engineering patterns.

Required Qualifications

  • 9+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience supporting enterprise production environments.

  • 5+ years hands-on SQL Server experience including T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, performance tuning, SQL Agent, backup/recovery, and production troubleshooting.

  • 5+ years hands-on SSIS experience including development, deployment, troubleshooting, optimization, monitoring, and production support.

  • Strong experience leading production support teams, critical incidents, RCA, and on-call/support operations.

  • Working knowledge of PowerShell and/or Python for automation.

  • Experience with Databricks, Python, PySpark, large-scale ETL/data processing, or modern cloud data platforms is a strong differentiator.

  • Strong client/stakeholder-facing skills, with the ability to communicate technical issues, business impact, risks, and recommendations clearly.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead people with confidence, make decisions under pressure, navigate cross-team dependencies, and take ownership through resolution.

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader, not just a support coordinator — someone who can stabilize today's environment while continuously finding better ways to automate, simplify, optimize, and modernize it.

title: Scientific Program Manager
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview


The Neuroimmune-PAIS Program investigates the neuroimmune mechanisms underlying Long COVID, ME/CFS, and related post-acute infection syndromes through two complementary hubs. The Discovery Science Hub is multi-institutional, while the Translational Medicine Hub is based entirely at Yale. We are seeking a PhD-level Scientific Program Manager to serve as the operational and administrative backbone of the program.


This person will work closely with the Program Director and lead investigators across both hubs and will represent the program in day-to-day dealings with Yale administration, funders, and collaborating institutions. We are looking for someone who finds genuine satisfaction in making complex science run smoothly, and who takes pride in work that is often invisible to the outside world but essential to everything the program accomplishes.


Key Responsibilities


  • Serve as the primary point of coordination across the program's two hubs — the multi-institutional Discovery Science Hub (Yale, Stanford, and Harvard) and the Yale-based Translational Medicine Hub — keeping investigators, staff, and collaborators aligned on timelines, deliverables, and decisions.
  • Lead and support the preparation of grant proposals, progress reports, and renewal applications, including drafting narrative sections, assembling budgets and budget justifications, and coordinating input from multiple PIs and institutions.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of Material Transfer Agreements (MTAs), Data Transfer/Use Agreements (DTAs/DUAs), and subcontracts, working with Yale's Office of Sponsored Projects, General Counsel, and counterpart offices at Discovery Science Hub partner institutions.
  • Coordinate IRB submissions, amendments, and continuing reviews across sites, and help ensure human-subjects protocols and reliance agreements stay current and compliant.
  • Track program budgets and subaward spending, working with departmental and grants administrators to monitor burn rate, effort reporting, and re-budgeting needs.
  • Plan and run program meetings, site visits, and scientific retreats, including agenda-setting, minutes, and follow-up on action items.
  • Serve as a liaison to Yale administration (Sponsored Projects, General Counsel, Human Research Protection Program, department finance), proactively resolving issues before they reach the PI.
  • Support donor- and funder-facing materials, including scientific summaries, slide decks, and progress updates for philanthropic and federal sponsors.
  • Maintain shared documentation: org charts, timelines, protocol trackers, and a central repository of program agreements and correspondence.
  • Anticipate bottlenecks and administrative risk before they become urgent — this role is as much about foresight as follow-through.

Required Skills and Abilities


1. Prior experience in research program coordination, project management, or research administration within an academic or biomedical setting.

2. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work diplomatically across many investigators, institutions, and administrative offices.

3. Strong written communication skills, including experience contributing to grant proposals, reports, or scientific/administrative documents.

4. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines with a high degree of independence and sound judgment.

5. Working familiarity with sponsored research administration (e.g., budgets, subawards, compliance) or a demonstrated ability to learn these systems quickly.


Preferred Skills and Abilities


1. Direct experience with MTAs, DTAs, IRB protocols, or multi-site collaboration agreements.

2. Background in immunology, virology, or neuroimmunology sufficient to engage meaningfully with the program's scientific content.

3. Proven experience at Yale or with Yale's administrative systems (Sponsored Projects, InfoEd, IRB systems).

4. Familiarity with NIH and/or philanthropic funding mechanisms for large collaborative programs (e.g., U19, P01, foundation grants).

Principal Responsibilities

Principal Responsibilities

1. Initiate and support innovative research and interdisciplinary research partnerships.
2. Cultivate an active and engaged Collaborative to connect, support, and amplify a pipeline of investigators.
3. Translate and disseminate science local, nationally and internationally
4. Serve as primary scientific architect for major submissions. This would entail leading grant writing efforts as a writer, editor, coordinator, and liaison to ensure successful submission.
5. Identify and pursue opportunities in consultation with the Director for federal, foundation, and private funding to support the growth of the center's research portfolio and infrastructure.
6. Support investigators on funding strategy, competitiveness, and portfolio development.
7. Prepare the non-scientific regulatory and shell of the grant (parts other than research strategy) such as budgets and budget justification, human subject protection plans, etc. Be able to perform any background or pertinent literature search to support development of these documents and workflows including data-driven study workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for use in the lab and with study collaborators.
8. Collaborate with other departmental staff for grant submissions, regulatory document management, financial reporting, effort reports.
9. Provide regulatory oversight for on going and new studies.
10. Lead and manage the preparation, writing, review, and publication of scientific manuscripts.
11. Coordinate with research investigators, fellows and trainees to develop manuscript drafts and integrate feedback.
12. Advise Director and research staff on up-to-date National Institutes of Health (NIH) policies, procedures, and compliance requirements related to grant applications and progress reports, ensuring institutional consistency while addressing grant-specific needs.

13. Support post-award activities including presentations, progress reports, renewals, and sponsor communications.

title: Internship: Full Stack Developer in Finance Domain
description:
Job Title

Internship: Full Stack Developer in Finance Domain

Job Description

Start Date: December 2026

Duration: minimum 6 months

Type: Internship (thesis possible, but you are responsible for the project proposal, subject to hiring team's evaluation)

Weekly Presence: 40h (minimum 32h)

Location: Eindhoven


Please only apply when you are available for the given start date & you are enrolled at the university during the whole internship period!


Internship: Full Stack Developer in Finance Domain

This team is responsible for building and developing financial models for the quotation and delivery functionality of long-term strategic partnerships. Each team member has its own expertise and by combining our brainpower we make the best products. Within the Healthcare industry there is an increasing trend towards “one stop shop”: customers want one reliable and accountable partner for longer term strategic partnerships (LSP), the partner needs to be able to take care of the integral project realization and execution.

The Harmonized Business Case Team operates with the above trend in mind, acting as a center of excellence in supporting modelling for long strategic partnerships and solutions, capability building and knowledge sharing. The intern will be integral part of the HBC Management Team and will participate hands on in the team mission

realization.


You have the opportunity to:

  • Increase the modelling capabilities in our UI, API and mainly in our microservices
  • Build, test and deploy new features that enrich the financing options/scenarios
  • Hands-on experience in Philips Healthcare LSP modelling and deal approval process
  • Actively participate in the user acceptance testing for financial models
  • You will have the opportunity to work in an Agile environment following SCRUM methodology, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Your responsibility is towards the sustainable use of the models. Your role:

  • Add modals, microservices and increase API’s to cater for subscription and PPU payment plans
  • Support Unit test with updates to Playwright and update technical documentation
  • Design, develop and connect additional functionality in our Intuitive User Interface
  • Supporting the documentation of our processes and creating work instructions for End Users

You're the right fit if:

  • Last year BSc or MSc degree in Software engineering, Information Technology or related field.
  • Strong interest in learning finance and accounting concepts is essential.
  • Experience with designing/developing UI developing user interfaces, backend services, and working with relational databases.
  • Knowledge of Java, JavaScript (REACT), and SQL for full-stack development, including front-end, back-end, and database integration.
  • You can take ownership of the project and structure your work yourself and pose the courage to seek assistance when needed
  • You are fluent in English

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

Monthly full-time allowance between €500 - €700 gross, depending on your education level. If you need to relocate to The Netherlands specifically for the internship there will be a different allowance. Part-time internships receive the allowance pro-rata.

Housing compensation, in case of relocating to the vicinity of the office, €300,- net if location is in the vicinity of Amsterdam, €255,- net for all other Philips locations. To be eligible, your usual home-work travel distance needs to be more than 50 km or 1.5 hours of travel time (one way). Afterwards, you need to provide the rental contract from your (new) landlord.

Travel compensation, if you are not eligible for a free public transport (OV chipkaart - student travel product); you can receive max. €192,- net depending on your location. Paid holidays per internship term.

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

title: Product Industrialization Manager, HPM
description:
Job Title

Product Industrialization Manager, HPM

Job Description

Product Industrialization Manager, HPM

You will be responsible for leading our Murrysville industrialization team, ensuring successful NPI transfer into local production while building site capabilities, processes, and governance aligned with global standards. You will have the opportunity to drive team development, resources, engineering performance, and cross-functional collaboration.

Your role:

  • ​Build and lead a new team of engineers and project managers responsible for product industrialization at the Murrysville site. Plan and allocate resources for industrialization and NPI activities.
  • Integrate NPI projects into the manufacturing site, ensuring smooth transfer from development and global industrialization locations into local production, in strong collaboration with international innovation hubs, equipment owners, and process experts.
  • Develop and coach employees, establishing a high‑performing, collaborative team culture. Establish local knowledge for main tasks of the team: equipment integration, prototype build management, production template development, execution of line qualification, change management and coordination.
  • Collaborate closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality Engineering, Procurement Engineering, Operational Purchasing, R&D, and other global Industrialization teams. Establish site‑specific industrialization processes, governance, and documentation aligned with global standards in context multi-site manufacturing.
  • Oversees local engineering activities including achieving results, controlling of cost, performance management and people development.

You're the right fit if:

  • You’ve acquired 5+ years of experience in production or process engineering with medical technology or another regulated industry (e.g., automotive/aerospace), problem‑solving techniques and process improvement methodologies; site capability building, organizational setup, or greenfield/brownfield industrialization environments.
  • Your skills include Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, risk assessments, process optimization, familiarity with regulatory, safety, and quality requirements in a manufacturing environment, productivity goals, Industrial traceability, QMS ISO 13485, FDA CFR 820, preferred.
  • You have a Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent.
  • You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this position.
  • You’re an excellent leader with the ability to drive success across many teams and create an environment of seamless co-operation.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is an onsite role.

description:
Uniting what’s next in traffic. Help shape the future of mobility.

Every day, millions of people rely on technology that helps keep journeys safe, efficient and sustainable.

At Yunex Traffic, we're helping create safer, smarter and more sustainable journeys through intelligent transport solutions used by millions of people every day. From traffic signals and tunnel management systems to digital mobility technologies, we're shaping the future of transport across the globe.

We’re looking for the next generation of Emerging Talent to bring fresh ideas, challenge thinking and help shape the future of mobility.

As a Degree Apprentice, you'll gain real-world experience, work towards a recognised degree qualification and develop the skills needed to build a successful career, all while earning a salary.

Life as Emerging Talent

Joining Yunex means becoming part of a nationwide Emerging Talent community, connecting apprentices, degree apprentices, interns and graduates from across the business.

Alongside your day-to-day role, you'll have opportunities to:

  • Build relationships with colleagues across the business
  • Learn from experienced professionals and senior leaders
  • Develop key professional and leadership skills
  • Collaborate on business-wide impact projects
  • Take part in volunteering and community initiatives
  • Work with stakeholders from across the business and gain exposure to different teams, functions and specialisms
  • Grow your network through events and development activities

As part of your Degree Apprenticeship, you'll combine practical workplace experience with academic study, enabling you to apply your learning directly to real projects and business challenges.

What you’ll be doing

From day one, you'll become part of the team, contributing to live projects and gaining practical experience through meaningful work and real responsibility.

  • Data Engineering & Integration – Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, transform and integrate data from business systems, APIs and other sources.

  • Data Transformation – Use SQL and Python to transform, validate and prepare data for reporting, analytics and downstream applications.

  • Data Quality – Build validation, reconciliation and data-quality controls to ensure information is accurate, complete, consistent and trustworthy.
  • Data Management & Governance – Support good data-management practices including metadata, data lineage, data definitions, ownership, classification and lifecycle management.
  • Security & Access – Apply appropriate security controls across AWS and Power BI, including IAM, least privilege, encryption and row-level security.
  • Automation & Deployment – Use Git, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform to support controlled, repeatable development and deployment.

title: Junior AI Engineer
description: Turn business questions and data into practical AI solutions. As a Junior AI Engineer, you will combine data analysis, machine learning and modern AI engineering to generate reliable business insights and build scalable applications. You will work with business and domain experts to understand their needs, explore and validate data, communicate clear recommendations, and help translate promising ideas into production-ready solutions. The role has three complementary pillars: Data Analysis Business Insights, Machine Learning Generative AI, and Software Cloud Engineering. You will receive guidance while progressively taking ownership of analytical, development, testing, deployment and documentation activities. 1. Data Analysis Business Insights Use SQL and Python to explore, combine, clean, filter and validate data and answer business questions in a reliable, repeatable way. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, correlations, anomalies and data-quality issues. Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, hypotheses and measurable outcomes. Apply statistical methods and effective visualizations to validate findings and communicate them clearly. Independently investigate unfamiliar datasets, ask the right questions and select an appropriate analytical or machine-learning approach. Explain evidence, model drivers, reliability, assumptions, limitations and potential bias to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Produce concise analytical notes that document conclusions, limitations and actionable recommendations. Work closely with domain experts to gather context, respectfully challenge assumptions, validate conclusions and document decisions. 2. Machine Learning Generative AI Build, test and explain practical machine-learning solutions, including regression, classification, clustering and similarity analysis. Use anomaly-detection and forecasting techniques to identify unusual patterns and estimate future outcomes. Contribute to Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions and basic agentic workflows. Assess the quality and suitability of AI outputs using appropriate evaluation methods and business criteria. Prototype and validate AI solutions with business stakeholders before further industrialization. 3. Software Cloud Engineering Develop maintainable Python components and contribute to reliable AI applications. Contribute to deploying, monitoring and maintaining AI solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure. Apply software-engineering, DevOps and MLOps practices, including Git, testing, CI/CD and reproducible experimentation. Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers and business experts throughout the solution lifecycle. Create clear technical documentation and contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

title: Consultant- Data Analyst
description:
About Us:

NYSTEC is a nonprofit technology consulting company, advising agencies, organizations, institutions, and businesses since 1996. We’re independent and vendor-neutral, so we have our clients’ best interests at heart. At NYSTEC, we know that we succeed when individuals and teams flourish personally and professionally, so our benefits and perks support that mindset.

About the Role:

As a consultant – data analyst in NYSTEC’s Data Services Management practice area, you will collaborate with team members to support a Social Adult Day Care (SADC) Compliance Surveillance Program and its oversight of Managed Long Term Care (MLTC) plans. Reporting to the quality improvement (QI) lead, you will support daily data operations, including data validation, performance measurement, and reporting to ensure accurate and efficient program operations.

Serving as a data analyst, your day-to-day role as a NYSTEC consultant will include applying business rules, reconciling data across sources, independently investigating data-quality issues, and identifying practical ways to improve recurring processes. This role will also support the development and maintenance of databases, dashboards, and reporting tools while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver accurate insights and improve program operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process, validate, and analyze structured data submissions using established business rules; run, troubleshoot, and improve Excel/VBA workflows and calculate performance measures and analytical outputs.
  • Independently investigate missing, inconsistent, duplicate, or inaccurate data; identify root causes, resolve processing issues, and perform quality checks to ensure reliable outputs.
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc findings reports and analytical deliverables; support automated reporting and document-generation processes using Microsoft Excel and Word and communicate key findings clearly.
  • Develop and troubleshoot SQL queries to retrieve, update, reconcile, and analyze relational data; support database maintenance, integrity, and repeatable data-processing activities.
  • Match and reconcile records across sources using identifiers, names, and addresses, including exact and fuzzy matching; analyze discrepancies, trends, outliers, and potential compliance or performance concerns.
  • Develop, maintain, test, and enhance databases, HTML-based dashboards, user interfaces, and reporting tools; identify automation and process-improvement opportunities and document business rules, data logic, and procedures.

About you:

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with large datasets, formulas, lookups, data validation, data cleansing, pivot tables, and analytical or reporting workbooks.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or troubleshooting VBA macros and Excel-based automated processes.
  • Proficiency in writing, modifying, and troubleshooting SQL queries involving multiple tables, joins, filters, aggregations, and common data operations.
  • Experience working with relational data and reconciling and validating information from multiple sources, with an understanding of relationships among records, tables, and identifiers.
  • Proficiency with data matching and reconciliation, including the use of exact and fuzzy-matching techniques, and the ability to apply established business rules or calculation logic consistently.
  • Advanced analytical, independent problem-solving, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills; ability to explain findings and collaborate effectively with program and technical teams.

Preferred/Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience querying or analyzing data from the NYS Medicaid Data Warehouse (MDW) or other NYS Medicaid data sources.
  • Experience developing more advanced SQL queries against large relational databases or enterprise data warehouses using Microsoft SQL Server, DBeaver, or comparable tools.
  • Experience analyzing Medicaid claims, encounter, service utilization, or other healthcare data, or experience supporting Medicaid managed care, MLTC, healthcare compliance, quality improvement, or regulatory surveillance activities.
  • Experience developing or enhancing dashboards, data visualizations, or web-based reporting tools using HTML, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience using Python or other scripting tools to automate data processing, validation, or reporting, or to improve data-quality controls and workflow efficiency.

Education and Experience

  • A bachelors degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, health informatics, information systems, economics, or a related discipline and two years of related experience in data analysis, data management, business intelligence, healthcare analytics, or a similar role.
  • An equivalent combination of advanced education, training, and experience will be considered.

The target base salary for this position is $73,476 - $95,518 per year. When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors, including skill set, experience, location, and job-related qualifications.

Quer aprender a transformar dados em melhorias e usar tecnologia para resolver desafios reais?

No time de Performance, você terá a oportunidade de apoiar projetos de análise de dados, melhoria contínua, automação e inteligência artificial, contribuindo para serviços com mais qualidade, eficiência e valor para nossos clientes.

Sua atuação

Com orientação do time, você irá:

  • Apoiar a criação e a melhoria de dashboards e relatórios de performance, transformando dados em informações claras para a tomada de decisão;
  • Auxiliar na análise de indicadores (KPIs), identificação de desvios e acompanhamento de planos de ação;
  • Colaborar na coleta, organização e validação de dados de diferentes fontes, contribuindo para a qualidade das informações;
  • Participar do mapeamento e da melhoria de processos, identificando oportunidades para reduzir atividades manuais, retrabalho e desperdícios;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de automações e aplicativos com ferramentas Microsoft, como Power Automate e Power Apps;
  • Explorar, com orientação, ferramentas de IA generativa, como Copilot, ChatGPT e Codex, para apoiar análises, documentação e desenvolvimento de soluções, com atenção à precisão das respostas e à proteção dos dados;
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas na compreensão de necessidades, nos testes de soluções e na elaboração de materiais de apoio aos usuários.

Você é a pessoa certa se:

  • Está cursando Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Materiais, Engenharia Elétrica/Eletrônica, Engenharia Mecatrônica, Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas afins;
  • Tem previsão de conclusão do curso a partir de janeiro de 2029;
  • Possui inglês intermediário;
  • Tem interesse em análise de dados, tecnologia e melhoria contínua;
  • Demonstra raciocínio lógico, organização, atenção aos detalhes e disposição para aprender;
  • Gosta de trabalhar em equipe, comunicar ideias e buscar soluções para problemas.

Conhecimentos que podem ajudar no seu desenvolvimento

Será um diferencial ter noções básicas, adquiridas em disciplinas, cursos, estudos pessoais ou projetos acadêmicos, em um ou mais dos temas abaixo:

  • Power BI e Power Query;
  • Automação de tarefas e criação de aplicativos com Power Automate e Power Apps;
  • Uso de IA generativa, como Copilot, ChatGPT ou Codex, incluindo a elaboração de instruções claras e a revisão crítica das respostas;
  • Lógica de programação, SQL ou Python;
  • Indicadores de desempenho e conceitos de melhoria contínua.

Não é necessário ter experiência profissional prévia nem conhecer todas essas ferramentas. Buscamos alguém com curiosidade, iniciativa e vontade de aprender e se desenvolver com o time.

title: Cloud Migration Lead Engineer
description:
Req ID: 395338

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Cloud Migration Lead Engineer to join our team in HR, Haryāna (IN-HR), India (IN).

Cloud Migration Engineer – AWS / Azure

Experience: 6+ years in IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of hands-on cloud migration or cloud infrastructure experience.

Role Summary

We are looking for hands-on Cloud Migration Engineers to execute enterprise workload migrations, primarily to AWS, with Microsoft Azure experience considered an advantage.

This is an execution-focused engineering position. The successful candidate must have practical experience migrating production servers or applications from on-premises or virtualized environments to public cloud platforms.

We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Windows/Linux infrastructure backgrounds who have participated directly in migration projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute server and workload migrations from on-premises, VMware, and other cloud environments to AWS.

  • Configure and operate AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and other migration tools.

  • Perform source server assessments, agent installation, replication configuration, and migration readiness checks.

  • Execute test migrations, validate replicated workloads, and troubleshoot migration issues.

  • Participate in migration wave planning and technical cutover preparation.

  • Perform production cutovers, post-migration validation, and hypercare activities.

  • Troubleshoot operating system, networking, storage, DNS, Active Directory, and application connectivity issues.

  • Support migration runbook creation, technical documentation, and rollback procedures.

  • Collaborate with Technical Leads, Cloud Foundation Engineers, and customer application owners.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive migration activities and improve migration efficiency.

Mandatory Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience migrating Windows and/or Linux servers to AWS or another public cloud.

  • Practical experience with AWS EC2, EBS, VPC, security groups, and basic IAM.

  • Experience with AWS MGN, Azure Migrate, VMware HCX, RiverMeadow, or comparable server migration technologies.

  • Strong Windows Server and/or Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.

  • Knowledge of VMware vSphere or similar virtualization technologies.

  • Understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and basic network troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with server replication, testing, cutover, rollback, and post-migration validation.

  • Experience troubleshooting infrastructure and operating system issues.

  • Ability to follow migration runbooks and execute production changes safely.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Microsoft Azure VM migration experience and Azure Migrate.

  • AWS Transform, RiverMeadow, CloudHedge, or other migration accelerators.

  • PowerShell, Bash, Python, or automation scripting.

  • Terraform, Ansible, or basic Infrastructure as Code experience.

  • Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows infrastructure services.

  • SQL Server, Oracle, or other database migration exposure.

  • AWS networking, VPN, Direct Connect, or hybrid connectivity.

  • AWS IAM, cloud security, or operational monitoring.

  • Experience with application dependency mapping and migration discovery.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent certification.

Expected Outcomes

  • Independently execute assigned migration tasks and migration waves.

  • Deliver successful server migrations with minimal rework.

  • Identify and resolve replication, cutover, and post-migration issues.

  • Contribute to reusable migration procedures and automation.

  • Support predictable, repeatable, high-volume migration delivery.

Critical selection criterion: Candidates must demonstrate direct involvement in real server or workload migrations. General cloud operations, monitoring, or infrastructure support experience alone is insufficient.

title: Compliance Investigator
description:
Job Title

Compliance Investigator

Job Description

Your challenge

As an Investigator in the Group Legal Compliance – Investigations team, you will lead and contribute to compliance investigations across Asia, helping to build a world-class, innovative investigation function.

You will manage complex, sensitive, and high-impact matters, while supporting Legal Compliance’s transformation in response to the Company’s evolving risk profile. You will engage with senior management on sensitive issues and emerging trends, enabling informed and appropriate management action.


Your responsibilities

As part of the Group Legal Compliance – Investigations team, with offices in the Netherlands, Panama, and China, you will:

· Lead and manage multiple compliance investigations across Asia, from initial assessment through reporting and remediation.

· Conduct complex and sensitive investigations in a timely, objective, thorough, and independent manner.

· Develop investigation plans; gather, assess, and document relevant evidence; and conduct effective interviews.

· Prepare clear and concise investigation reports in English and communicate investigation outcomes to local and global senior management.

· Document findings, conclusions, and supporting evidence in accordance with prescribed investigation methodologies, procedures, tools, and systems.

· Take ownership of investigation documentation and reporting throughout the investigation lifecycle.

· Build trusted relationships and engage effectively with stakeholders across the region, while driving sensitive processes with appropriate discretion and independence.

· Identify risk trends and root causes, translate investigation insights into practical learnings and solutions, and support risk owners and business leaders in defining effective remediation plans.

· Share investigation insights and best practices across the function.

· Actively contribute to global compliance initiatives and the continuous development of the Investigations function.

Location: Shanghai, China.


You’re the right fit if you have

· A genuine passion for investigative and fact-finding work, combined with the persistence and judgement required to handle challenging matters.

· A bachelor’s degree or above in Law, Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

· At least five years of relevant experience in compliance investigations or a comparable role.

· Demonstrated ability to identify and pursue relevant sources of evidence, analyse complex information logically, and conduct effective investigative interviews.

· A sound understanding of business processes, financial reporting systems, compliance regulations, etc..

· Proven experience managing multiple complex matters to timely completion and engaging credibly with senior stakeholders, both locally and globally.

· Excellent English report-writing and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present sensitive findings clearly and objectively.

· Experience using forensic e-discovery or data-review tools.

· High integrity, sound judgement, attention to detail, self-motivation, resilience, and a collaborative mindset.

· The ability to thrive in a dynamic environment and handle sensitive matters with discretion and courage.

title: Clinical Solutions Consultant - General Imaging Ultrasound (IN)
description:
Job Title

Clinical Solutions Consultant - General Imaging Ultrasound (IN)

One day you may be delivering a custom-made educational/training program at a major teaching hospital, the next day you could be supporting the regional sales team by applying your clinical expertise to the pre-sales process for a major proposal.

  • Position yourself as a consultant to both internal and external customers, communicating regularly with local, zone, and management teams.
  • Generate leads, cover tradeshows as assigned, and effectively support installed base while maintaining excellent customer satisfaction.

  • You’ve acquired 3+ years of radiology experience as an ARDMS. Sales, teaching/in-service experience, RVT, OB/GYN, MSK, Breast, Pediatric and AB registries, preferred. AE highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience listed above and below.

Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
