title: Shift co-ordinator - Delivery Senior Specialist
description:
Req ID: 392168

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Shift co-ordinator - Delivery Senior Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).

Job Description – Shift Coordinator (G9)

Position Overview

Role: Shift Coordinator / Operations Lead
Grade: G9
Function: Network / Infrastructure Operations
Work Model: Shift-based, supporting regional operations

Role Summary

The Shift Coordinator will act as the operational lead during the assigned regional shift, ensuring effective coordination, ticket queue management, communication, escalation, reporting, and continuity of Network and Infrastructure operations.

This is a semi-technical operations leadership role. The individual is not expected to be the primary hands-on technical engineer for all technologies but must possess sufficient technical knowledge to understand incidents, technical discussions, business impact, troubleshooting progress, and recommendations from engineering teams.

The Shift Coordinator will serve as the primary coordination point during the shift and ensure that incidents, service requests, changes, escalations, operational activities, reporting, and shift handovers are effectively managed.

Key Responsibilities

Shift Leadership & Coordination

  • Act as the lead and primary coordination point for the assigned regional shift.
  • Coordinate activities across Network Operations engineers, SMEs, Service Desk, vendors, and other infrastructure teams.
  • Ensure appropriate resources are engaged based on incident severity and technical requirements.
  • Monitor operational workload and ensure critical activities receive appropriate priority.
  • Coordinate and actively participate in shift handover meetings/processes with incoming and outgoing shifts.
  • Ensure all open incidents, escalations, changes, pending actions, risks, and customer-impacting issues are clearly communicated during handover.
  • Maintain operational discipline and ensure agreed processes and procedures are followed throughout the shift.
  • Ticket Queue Management & Assignment
  • Monitor the Network Operations incident, service request, task, and operational ticket queues throughout the shift.
  • Review incoming tickets and ensure they are assigned to the appropriate engineer or technical team based on priority, technology, geography, and resource availability.
  • Balance ticket assignments across available resources to maintain an appropriate workload distribution.
  • Ensure critical and high-priority tickets receive immediate attention and appropriate technical ownership.
  • Monitor ticket aging, SLA timelines, pending status, and unresolved tickets.
  • Follow up with assigned engineers to ensure tickets are actively progressed and regularly updated.
  • Identify tickets at risk of SLA breach and initiate appropriate escalation.
  • Ensure tickets are correctly categorized, documented, updated, and progressed in accordance with established operational procedures.

Incident & Escalation Management

  • Coordinate P1/P2 and other business-critical incidents during the shift.
  • Ensure appropriate technical teams, SMEs, vendors, and stakeholders are engaged in a timely manner.
  • Track incident troubleshooting activities, action items, dependencies, and restoration progress.
  • Understand technical updates sufficiently to identify gaps, dependencies, or the need for additional technical expertise.
  • Ensure timely escalation when resolution is delayed or additional support is required.
  • Support Major Incident Management activities and bridge calls as required.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation and handover of unresolved incidents.

Daily & Weekly Operational Reporting

  • Prepare and distribute daily shift/operations reports covering key operational activities and service performance.
  • Provide visibility of open and closed incidents, P1/P2 incidents, critical escalations, ticket backlog, aging tickets, SLA risks/breaches, changes, and significant operational events.
  • Prepare or contribute to weekly operational reports and service review information.
  • Track operational trends and highlight recurring incidents, backlog concerns, capacity/resource issues, and areas requiring management attention.
  • Ensure reporting information is accurate, timely, and aligned with agreed customer and management reporting requirements.
  • Work with Operations leadership and SMEs to gather required inputs for weekly reporting and service reviews.

Operational Management

  • Monitor incident, request, change, and operational activities during the shift.
  • Ensure tickets are properly assigned, updated, progressed, and closed according to agreed processes and SLAs.
  • Identify aging or stalled tickets and drive the respective owners for resolution.
  • Coordinate planned maintenance and change activities occurring during the shift.
  • Ensure appropriate pre-checks, post-checks, validation, and escalation procedures are followed.
  • Track recurring operational issues and highlight them to Network Operations leadership for further analysis.

Shift Handover

  • Actively participate in and, where required, lead shift handover calls.
  • Review the status of all critical incidents, major escalations, pending changes, high-priority tickets, and operational risks before completing the shift.
  • Ensure clear ownership is transferred to the incoming shift for all outstanding activities.
  • Provide the incoming Shift Coordinator and engineering team with sufficient technical and operational context to continue activities without disruption.
  • Document pending actions, owners, expected timelines, and required follow-ups.
  • Ensure there are no gaps in operational ownership between regional shifts.

Technical Understanding

The Shift Coordinator should have a working understanding of enterprise infrastructure and networking concepts, including:

  • LAN/WAN networking
  • Routers and switches
  • Firewalls and network security
  • Wireless infrastructure
  • DNS, DHCP and IP Address Management (DDI)
  • Network monitoring and alerting
  • Basic routing, switching, TCP/IP and connectivity troubleshooting
  • ITSM tools and ticket management
  • Monitoring and event-management platforms

Deep hands-on expertise across all technologies is not mandatory; however, the candidate must be capable of understanding technical discussions and translating them into clear operational actions and stakeholder updates.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Provide clear and timely operational updates to internal teams, management, and customer stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical issues effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Coordinate with geographically distributed teams across different regions and time zones.
  • Maintain professional and structured communication during high-severity incidents and escalations.
  • Ensure accurate and concise shift reports, operational summaries, and handover information are provided.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience in Network Operations, Infrastructure Operations, NOC, Service Operations, or a similar environment.
  • Good understanding of enterprise network and infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience working in a 24x7 operational/support environment.
  • Experience with ticket queue management, ticket assignment, SLA tracking, and operational reporting.
  • Familiarity with Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Major Incident Management processes.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL-based service management practices.
  • Experience with ITSM/ticketing and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Strong coordination, follow-up, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to remain composed and structured during critical incidents and service outages.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineers, SMEs, vendors, management, and customer stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
  • ITIL Foundation certification preferred.
  • Networking certifications such as CCNA or equivalent would be advantageous.
  • Previous experience as a NOC Lead, Shift Lead, Operations Coordinator, Incident Coordinator, or Infrastructure Operations Lead is preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Shift leadership and ownership
  • Ticket queue management and assignment
  • Incident and escalation coordination
  • Daily and weekly operational reporting
  • Shift handover management

title: Senior Engineer Maintenance
description:
#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.


Dreaming about massive machines, precision processes, and the transformation of sand into groundbreaking tech?


As a Senior Engineer Maintenance in our Manufacturing and Operations team, find yourself in a high-tech world where silicon wafers evolve into cutting-edge products. In our advanced cleanroom environment, every detail count, and your expertise will help shape the future, one innovation at a time.


Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

1. Achieve the established KPI targets for DCVD equipment, including AMAT Producer SE, Ultima HDP, and Centura DXZ systems.

2. Drive continuous optimization of DCVD equipment performance in terms of uptime, throughput, cost efficiency, and quality.

3. Execute Preventive Maintenance (PM) activities according to the planned schedule and continuously improve PM effectiveness and success rates.

4. Perform equipment and parts failure analysis, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

5. Continuously reduce equipment downtime and failure rates while enhancing overall equipment efficiency and reliability.

6. Support new equipment installation, start-up activities, process qualification, and technology transfer initiatives.

7. Respond promptly to critical fab events, ensuring rapid containment and effective resolution to minimize production impact.

8. Generate technical reports, including 8D reports, to document root cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive measures.

9. Maintain a strong presence in the production area and demonstrate excellent attendance and responsiveness.

10. Uphold good 5S practices within the assigned work area and ensure full compliance with cleanroom procedures and safety protocols at all times.


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Mechatronic, Electronic, or Electrical Engineering.

• Minimum 3 years of working experience in the semiconductor industry or a related manufacturing environment.

• Good command of the English language, with the ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

• Strong analytical, diagnostic, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a cleanroom environment while adhering to all cleanroom protocols and safety requirements.

• Knowledge of FDC (Fault Detection and Classification) and data collection systems for advanced equipment troubleshooting and performance analysis.

• Proven capability in defect troubleshooting, particle tracing, and root cause analysis.

• Strong project management and execution skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Ability to provide timely support in the production area and maintain a good attendance record.

• Capable of working independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.

• Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to continuous improvement and operational excellence.


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

title: Welcome Coordinator
description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Title: Welcome Coordinator

Company: Oak Street Health

Role Description:

The purpose of the Welcome Coordinator at Oak Street Health is to create an inclusive environment for anyone who walks through our doors and to make a positive first and last impression on our patients. Welcome Coordinators are the face of our clinic and the glue that keeps our center operations efficient. Welcome Coordinators perform various administrative tasks that allow our broader teams to execute on creating an unmatched patient experience, deliver the best care anywhere and make Oak Street a great place to work. Welcome Coordinators juggle tasks such as scheduling patient appointments, managing inbound and outbound phone calls, as well as managing administrative tasks including fax and mail distribution. Welcome Coordinators are expected to be friendly and highly flexible.

Welcome Coordinators are a part of our Service Team and report to the Practice Manager. The main focus of the Service Team is creating a seamless experience for our patients and community members. Welcome Coordinators are responsible for delivering excellent, high-touch assistance to our patients and guests everyday.

title: Assistant Digital Platform & Martech Manager
description:
Job Title

Assistant Digital Platform & Martech Manager

Job Description

Role Purpose

This role supports the marketing team by managing a practical Martech set-up for effective and trackable digital campaigns. Focused on improving campaign and event performance, the role helps make data and tools easier to use in daily marketing work, and supports the team in improving targeting, content, and channel performance. This role sits within the marketing team and works closely with campaign, data, and IT teams to support day-to-day campaign execution.

Key Responsibilities

Martech Setup & Marketing Capability Enablement

  • Manage core marketing tools (e.g., sCRM, campaign tracking, automation platforms)
  • Ensure systems are stable, connected, and easy to use for marketing teams
  • Support campaign setup, tagging, and audience segmentation
  • Help build a reliable data foundation for campaign tracking and performance analysis

Campaign / Event Tracking, Reporting & Insights

  • Own campaign tracking setup to ensure accurate data capture across traffic, engagement, and leads
  • Monitor campaign performance and provide regular reports (weekly / monthly)
  • Work with MI&A to translate data into clear insights
  • Support improvements in targeting, content, and channel performance

3. Campaign Optimization & Conversion Improvement

  • Use campaign data to support ongoing optimization
  • Evaluate performance across targeting, channels, and content
  • Identify what is working and where improvements are needed
  • Help improve campaign quality, lead quality, and overall conversion

4. System Connectivity & Data Flow

  • Ensure smooth data flow between Martech tools, sales systems, and business platforms
  • Identify data gaps or tracking issues and improve step by step
  • Support building a clearer link from engagement to conversion

5. Workflow & Efficiency

  • Reduce manual work through better use of tools and simple automation
  • Support clear and repeatable campaign workflows
  • Improve execution speed and consistency across campaigns

6. Data Governance & Compliance Standardization

  • Ensure data tracking and tool usage meet company and regulatory requirements
  • Maintain clear standards for tagging, tracking, and data usage
  • Work with RA and IT teams to ensure compliant operations

Key Requirements

  • 5–8 years of experience in digital marketing, Martech, or marketing analytics
  • Solid understanding of end-to-end digital marketing campaign lifecycle
  • Hands-on experience with sCRM, campaign tracking, and analytics tools
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical solutions
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills across marketing, IT, and data teams
  • Detail-oriented, structured, and execution-focused
  • Experience in healthcare, MedTech, or other medical industries is a plus
  • Familiarity with using AI tools (e.g., for content generation, data analysis, or marketing automation) is a plus
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin

title: Associate Director of Strategic Initiatives: Cultivating Conversation and Dialogue
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

Reporting to the Chief of Staff and Assistant Vice President for Strategy and Operations in the Office of the Secretary and Vice President for University Life (OSVPUL), the Associate Director serves as the program development and implementation lead for the university-wide Cultivating Conversation initiative and related University Life programming. Working collaboratively with university partners, the Associate Director develops, facilitates, and implements programs that strengthen the Yale community's capacity to engage thoughtfully and constructively across differences in perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. The position advances the university's commitment to collaborative excellence by designing and delivering workshops, trainings, and other engagement opportunities that promote intellectual curiosity, open inquiry, constructive dialogue, civil discourse, and the skills needed to navigate complex conversations and situations.


Under the direction of the Chief of Staff and Assistant Vice President, the Associate Director contributes to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of workshops, trainings, resources, and engagement strategies that align with the initiative's and university’s goals and respond to emerging campus needs. The role translates strategic priorities into high-quality programming by adapting dialogue frameworks, developing facilitation materials and participant resources, recommending innovative approaches, and supporting the implementation of new programming. The Associate Director exercises creativity, sound judgment, and initiative while ensuring that programming aligns with university priorities and leadership direction.

The Associate Director builds collaborative relationships across the university to support the integration of constructive dialogue into the Yale community experience. The position consults with schools, departments, and campus organizations to tailor programs for a broad range of audiences; facilitates workshops, meetings, and group discussions; and serves as a trusted resource on dialogue, facilitation, and community engagement.


The Associate Director contributes to the successful planning and execution of initiative programming by partnering with operational staff on workshop and event logistics, staffing programs and events, supporting external speakers and guests, preparing materials, and providing on-site facilitation and operational support as needed. The position also develops participant resources, facilitator guides, communications, and online content that expand the reach and accessibility of Cultivating Conversation across the university.

In collaboration with university expertise, the Associate Director supports qualitative and quantitative program assessment by collecting and analyzing participant feedback, evaluating program outcomes, and recommending enhancements to strengthen programming and participant engagement. The position contributes to a collaborative, responsive, and service-oriented team environment and performs other duties as assigned.

The successful candidate is an engaging facilitator and collaborative partner with excellent communication, relationship management, and presentation skills. The individual demonstrates intellectual curiosity, creativity, sound judgment, and the ability to translate strategic priorities into thoughtful, high-quality programs while delivering exceptional service to a wide range of university constituents. The Associate Director may perform other duties as assigned.


Finalists will be expected to demonstrate their practical experience at some point during the interview process.


Required Skills and Abilities

1. Demonstrated experience facilitating workshops, trainings, and group conversations for a broad range of audiences. Ability to create engaging, inclusive environments that support thoughtful discussion, learning, and constructive engagement across differing perspectives.

2. Demonstrated ability to design, develop, and implement programs, workshops, and resources that advance organizational goals. Experience translating concepts and priorities into engaging content, activities, and participant experiences.

3. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly, develop audience-appropriate materials, facilitate discussions, and build effective relationships with faculty, staff, students, and campus partners.

4. Strong project management and collaboration skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate with stakeholders, contribute creative ideas, execute programming, and work effectively with colleagues in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

5. Demonstrated professionalism, sound judgment, discretion, and responsiveness when working with sensitive topics and diverse constituencies. Ability to exercise initiative, adapt to changing needs, and represent the university appropriately.


Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. Master’s Degree or equivalent, with experience in facilitation and program development.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Directs, monitors, and assesses needs and directs the application of resources of an administrative University office dealing with one or more major functional areas. 2. Directs and implements solutions to problems that are routine to complex in nature and that affect multiple functional areas of responsibility. 3. Plans and/or participates in planning University activities on a long-term basis to comply with University goals and objectives. 4. Establishes and implements consistent university-wide policies in multiple functional areas of responsibility. 5. Ensures that University office policies and procedures are in compliance with federal, state, and local laws and ordinances. 6. Develops and monitors goals and objectives for managerial and professional staff in compliance with University strategies. 7. Directs a staff of exempt and non-exempt employees. 8. May perform other duties as assigned. Tässä tehtävässä noudatetaan Kipan työehtosopimusta. Palkka on tessin mukaan vähintään 12,26 € / h.
Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!
---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

We are seeking a proactive and technically proficient Saudi Sales Engineer to join our team as an Indoor Sales Engineer. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex client technical requirements and global supply chains, You will be the internal driver for technical estimating, sourcing, and client fulfillment, leveraging your engineering background to evaluate supplier capabilities and secure the best technical and commercial solutions for our clients.

This position requires a deep understanding of local purchasing protocols alongside a proven capability to source directly from global vendors and international OEMs.

title: Instructor in Art History
description:
Department: Instruction

Compensation: $4,000

Job Status: Temporary

FLSA: Exempt

Reports to: Director of Academic Research Programs

Schedule: June 13 - June 26, 2027 in residence at Princeton University

Designation: Associate Faculty, non-benefit eligible

Housing: Room and board provided

Travel: Occasional

ART HISTORY SCHOLARS INSTRUCTOR

Located in the scenic Berkshire-Taconic landscape in the quiet northwest corner of Connecticut, The Hotchkiss School is a community in which faculty and staff members build careers and grow as professionals. We seek to identify, recruit, and develop faculty and staff members who bring a diversity of experiences, perspectives, talents, and backgrounds. Collectively, we are dedicated to supporting the intellectual, social, and emotional growth of nearly 600 students who come from around the country and the world.

In the 2026-2027 school year, our student body includes 33% of students receiving financial aid, 19% international students, and 41% U.S. students of color. Geographically diverse, our students represent 38 states and 34 countries, spanning 6 continents. The School is eager to accept applications from individuals who are excited to support an inclusive and warm learning community for students from a wide array of backgrounds and experiences.

Our Program:

The Art History Scholars Program begins with two weeks of research at the Princeton University Art Museum. The summer program is followed by a year-long course at the Hotchkiss School. Working closely with PUAM curators, students conduct research on materials of their choice in the museum’s extensive collections. In conjunction, students are provided with studio space in which to build their own art portfolio. In the evenings, students gather to discuss their findings, work on shared problems in the history of art, and receive individual mentorship on their research projects. Students in the summer program join a course in their Senior year at Hotchkiss with the goal of producing a substantial final thesis on their summer research as well as a fine arts portfolio.

Position Summary:

The Instructor reports to the Director of the Art History Scholars Program and the Director of Academic Research Programs. The bulk of the Instructor’s work involves assisting the Program Director in mentoring students as they undertake their research projects. This process includes one-on-one instruction for each student as their work evolves. This instruction could pertain to concepts and problems from art history and could involve guiding students through the learning of new skills, approaches, and theories. In addition, the instructor might need to mentor students in research and analytical methodologies, including but not limited to: choosing objects, working with curators, and close looking. In the evenings, the Instructor fosters a collaborative spirit in the course by overseeing group discussions, workshops, discrete art historical lessons, and other forms of joint inquiry. Finally, the Instructor will ideally be able to contribute to the fine arts curriculum and assist students during their time in the studio.

Qualifications:

Candidates must be prepared to mentor students on projects in topics in art history. For this reason, candidates must have an advanced degree or significant background knowledge and expertise in art and/or art history. Candidates should also ideally have experience with primary-source research and be prepared to mentor students through the execution of a sustained, deep, and coherent research project based upon museum and library materials.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

In addition to providing academic mentorship and instruction, the person in this role also manages and mentors a Resident Assistant with a background in art history. The Resident Assistant is expected to help with the program’s implementation under the Instructor’s direction. The Instructor can expect to be on duty—and available to help students with their work—every other night for the program’s duration. Finally, the Instructor is expected to accompany students on field trips, provide supervision for smaller outings, and assist as needed with the general administration of the summer program.

Application Information:

Through the online application process, located at Hotchkiss.org/careers, interested candidates should submit a cover letter that addresses interest in teaching at Hotchkiss with particular focus on the ability and interest in working in an intentionally diverse and inclusive residential community. Applicants should also submit their résumé/CV and contact information for three references. If you are matched to a position additional materials may be requested. The School is committed to building and supporting a diverse community where all feel safe, seen, and supported. Successful applicants will address their ability to contribute to a warm, inclusive, and exciting learning environment.

Additional Information

The essential functions and basic skills have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. This position description is subject to change at any time.

The Hotchkiss School is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to basing judgments concerning the employment of individuals upon their qualifications and abilities. The School is firmly committed to equal employment and advancement opportunities for all employees and applicants in all phases of the employment process (including recruitment, hiring, assignment, terms and conditions of employment, compensation, benefits, training, promotion, transfer, discipline and termination).

In accordance with applicable law, the School does not discriminate against any individual based on age, ancestry, color, genetic information, learning disability, marital status, past or present history of mental disability, national origin, physical disability, race, religious creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Forward Deployed Engineer (AI & Agentic Systems)

Overview

We are seeking a customer-focused Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to help enterprises identify, validate, design, and scale AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

As an FDE, you will operate at the intersection of AI consulting, solution architecture, rapid prototyping, and delivery advisory. You will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, and engineering squads to transform opportunities into scalable AI solutions while balancing business value, technical feasibility, governance, and production readiness.

The ideal candidate combines architectural depth, hands-on technical credibility, customer engagement skills, and a pragmatic delivery mindset. Candidate should be comfortable engaging with business leaders, challenging architectural decisions, building rapid prototypes, and guiding solutions from experimentation through last mile adoption.

While hands-on implementation experience is important, success in this role is defined by the ability to rapidly validate business value, shape scalable solutions, and help customers move confidently from proof-of-value to enterprise adoption.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Architecture

You will lead the design of enterprise grade AI solutions and guide customers through architecture decisions that align with their business and technology strategies.

Key areas of focus may include:

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Agentic AI solutions
  • Multi-agent systems
  • Enterprise knowledge platforms
  • Conversational AI
  • Intelligent automation
  • Enterprise integration patterns
  • AI reference architectures

Responsibilities may include:

  • Defining architecture blueprints and solution patterns.
  • Evaluating trade-offs across models, frameworks, and platforms.
  • Guiding enterprise architects and engineering teams through design decisions.
  • Establishing scalable and reusable implementation approaches.

Rapid Prototyping & Solution Validation

A core expectation of this role is the ability to validate business value quickly before significant delivery investment is made.

You will:

  • Conduct discovery workshops and use-case assessments.
  • Evaluate the customer's existing technology landscape and approved toolset.
  • Build prototypes using available enterprise platforms and AI capabilities.
  • Develop Proofs of Concept (POCs) and Proofs of Value (POVs).
  • Validate technical feasibility, business value, and adoption potential.
  • Define implementation roadmaps for successful prototypes.
  • Partner with engineering teams to industrialize and scale approved solutions.

AI Governance & Responsible AI

You will help ensure AI solutions are designed and deployed responsibly within enterprise environments.

Responsibilities include:

  • Defining AI governance approaches and guardrails.
  • Embedding Responsible AI principles into solution design.
  • Aligning solutions with:
    • Security requirements
    • Compliance obligations
    • Privacy standards
    • Data governance policies
    • AI risk management practices
  • Supporting architecture assurance and governance reviews.

Delivery & Production Readiness

While not a pure platform engineering role, the FDE must be capable of assessing whether solutions can successfully operate at enterprise scale.

Expected areas of knowledge include:

  • Production hardening
  • AIOps (MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps)
  • Evaluation frameworks
  • Observability and monitoring
  • Reliability engineering
  • Scalability planning
  • Cost optimization

You will:

description:
Enterprise Applications Administrator

Additional responsibilites include backup support for administering, supporting, and enhancing the Firm’s other enterprise applications.

Hybrid work schedule.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Administer, configure, support, and optimize the Firm’s enterprise application environment, with primary concentration on NetDocuments and related services.
  • Serve as a technical subject matter resource for document management administration, including repository structure, cabinets, profiles, metadata, templates, permissions, governance features, search, and user access.
  • Monitor DMS application health, service availability, usage trends, and platform performance; troubleshoot escalated issues involving access, authentication, synchronization, and integrations; and coordinate corrective action with internal teams and vendors.
  • Manage DMS user accounts, security groups, roles, permissions, and related administrative settings in accordance with Firm policy, ethical wall requirements, client obligations, and information security standards.
  • Support and maintain integrations between document management and other enterprise platforms using administrative tools, APIs, automation methods, and vendor-supported capabilities.
  • Participate in technical design, testing, deployment, and support of DMS system changes, upgrades, enhancements, new feature releases, proof-of-concepts, and phased implementations for emerging technologies, including documentation, training, and post-deployment support.
  • Assist in evaluating business requirements and identifying opportunities to improve document management, enhance the user-experience, streamline workflows, and translate needs into scalable technical solutions, configuration changes, automation opportunities, or process improvements, including the use of AI-enabled and cloud-based tools.
  • Partner with the Enablement team to assess, prioritize, communicate, and support adoption of new NetDocuments AI features and related enterprise capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Information Governance and Records teams to support retention, classification, lifecycle management, disposition, legal hold, auditability, and compliance requirements.
  • Provide support and collaborate with NetDocuments engineers to troubleshoot the Legal document management platform to facilitate diagnosis, isolation, and resolution of advanced DMS database issues, including performance, data integrity, and data/configuration-related problems.
  • Develop and maintain DMS technical documentation, administrative procedures, support knowledge articles, diagrams, and training materials.
  • Provide advanced support and guidance to Service Desk, who handle the first line NetDocuments support, and other IT teams for issue resolution, support readiness, and escalation management.
  • Coordinate with DMS software vendors regarding incidents, product defects, release changes, licensing, support cases, and enhancement requests.
  • Partner with Infrastructure and Security teams to support authentication, provisioning, and access management processes involving Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Single Sign-On (SSO), and related identity services.
  • Contribute to operational standards, change management practices, testing procedures, and support models for enterprise applications.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise application administration, systems support, or a related technical role.
  • Significant experience administering or supporting document management systems, with direct experience in NetDocuments strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in a law firm, legal services, or other professional services environment preferred.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS enterprise application administration, including configuration, user provisioning, permissions, troubleshooting, release support, and vendor coordination.
  • Experience with cloud technologies and modern identity and access management concepts, including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and Single Sign-On (SSO).
  • Experience with AI enablement concepts and tools, including familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar frameworks for connecting AI solutions to enterprise data, systems, or workflows
  • Experience supporting integrations, automation, or data exchange between enterprise systems using APIs, scripting, or vendor-supported integration methods.
  • Foundational knowledge of database structures (e.g., schemas, tables, relationships, and queries)Working knowledge of tools and technologies such as PowerShell, REST APIs, reporting tools, or similar administrative and automation capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of information governance, document security, metadata, and records-related concepts in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Sr. Director, Strategic Consulting (Team 3)
description:
Casey Family Programs, an Equal Opportunity Employer, is the nation’s largest operating foundation focused on safely reducing the need for foster care and building Communities of Hope for children and families across America. Founded in 1966, Casey Family Programs works in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, two territories, and tribal nations to influence long-lasting improvements to the safety and success of children, families and the communities where they live. Casey Family Programs values diversity, equity, inclusion, anti-racism, anti-discrimination, and respect for individuals in the workplace. We encourage candidates with diverse lived experience and perspectives to apply.

Job Summary:

The Sr. Director - Strategic Consulting working with the Managing Director – Strategic Consulting – Systems Improvement at Casey Family Programs proactively seeks ways to assess and support child welfare systems improvement and sets direction for the work in specific states and jurisdictions. The purpose of this position and the efforts it directs is to create system change and to build capacity for systems to strengthen families and communities in order to improve the safety, permanency and well being of children and to influence the safe reduction of the number of children in foster care and reinvestment of resources consistent with goals.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Works with Managing Director to coordinate efforts internally and with external collaborators (to included experts, vendors, groups or teams) to assist the child welfare systems - inclusive of the five sectors of government, philanthropy, non-profit, civic, and business sectors - to prevent child maltreatment and safely reduce the foster care population, while improving the lives for youth and families who are in or would have entered foster care.
  • Works with the Managing Director – Strategic Consulting in influencing child welfare practice, policies and laws on a local, state and national level to build strengths and achieve broad wide system impact.
  • Responsible for designing and operationalizing assigned projects, organizational sub objectives and outcomes in assigned jurisdictions, inclusive of risk management, stakeholder management, measurement of progress, and communication.
  • Acts proactively and in planning and tracking work efforts, agreements and projects. Works with other Casey units to appropriately manage contract and regulatory compliance, reporting, and appropriate financial stewardship. Provides effective updates to Senior Management and ensures progress toward goals according to deadlines.
  • Provides expertise internally and externally regarding child welfare systems change, and facilitates the implementation of data driven, outcome focused, and evidence informed strategies to support child welfare stakeholders across the five sectors in their efforts to improve child welfare outcomes.
  • Represents Casey in state, local and national workgroups, meetings and conferences.
  • Engages with state and local community partners to strengthen prevention efforts and leverage resources of the multi-systems affecting youth and families.
  • Develops and manages relationships resulting in regular invitations to work with specific and influential state, county child welfare agency, judicial and legislative leaders to help resolve issues of concern with the development of sound recommendations and implementation of plans in support of Casey's goals.
  • Develops and communicates effective methods which assist child welfare systems in reinvestment strategies which support and strengthen families.
  • Responsible for continuous quality improvement within Strategic Consulting – Systems Improvement. Knowledgeable of broad wide system impact strategies within child welfare systems.
  • Directly provides technical assistance leveraging own expertise in system reform, financing, practice, workforce management, policy and legislative affairs.
  • Facilitates peer shared learning opportunities among child welfare and other systems and community partners in order to facilitate and improve communication and coordination, as well as share best practices for youth in care.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in Human Services, Business, Public Administration or related field is required with a minimum of 8 years of recent progressive responsible management experience in a public child welfare system, or BA Degree in Human Services, Business, Public Administration, or related field with 10 years of recent progressive management experience or senior human services leadership including at least five years in a strategic capacity working at the executive senior level or system-wide level.

  • Deep, multi-year experience in personally consulting at cabinet-level public administration in child welfare with demonstrated high impact results may be substituted for some years of experience in recent public administration senior management position.

  • Demonstrated, experience in strategic planning, systems integration, systems change and an in-depth understanding of multi-state child welfare systems required. Knowledge and experience of current state and jurisdiction administration, needs, and influential contacts required.
  • A balance of initiative and diplomacy is critical, as well as the ability to build relationships, provide assistance and resources, learn fast, conduct assessments/evaluate systems and provide assistance and resources. Must bring relationships and experience that allow for entry into the assigned jurisdictions and be received positively by child welfare administrators.
  • Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills are required, along with excellent negotiating and listening skills. A commitment to building personal and organizational sensitivity towards diverse cultural, socio-economic and lifestyle backgrounds is essential.
  • Ability to build relationships, provide assistance, be a resource, make presentations, work independently, take initiative, provide assessments and system evaluation.
  • Excellent leadership skills including training, group facilitation, and project management are required.
  • Technical proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience with any specific software or technology as needed for the job.

description:
Job Summary

Supportability Engineer - Keystone

As a Supportability Engineer for Keystone Storage as a Service, you will provide advanced technical support to customers, customer support personnel, and field support staff. You will partner with KSM and CSD resources to provide customer experience never seen at NetApp. Your role involves monitoring, diagnosing and troubleshooting NetApp Keystone environments, including hardware, software, and multi-system/multi-vendor/multi-network interoperability issues. You will respond to situations where first-line product support has failed to isolate or fix problems, ensuring optimal results. This role requires a proactive professional with demonstrated technical problem-solving skills, subject matter expertise, and strong customer service orientation and experience. Fluency in English is required. This is a new role within NetApp and an exciting opportunity.

Essential Functions

Proactive Function: Manage Keystone-specific service functions, including hardware, OS, and software releases, critical functionality patches, advisories, vulnerabilities, technical risk mitigation, and firmware updates.
Planning and Execution: Conduct general planning for OS, software, hardware upgrades, patch installations, data migration, and design best practices. Develop and execute roll-back plans and best practices recommendations.
Data Management: Utilize data management tools to oversee Keystone capacity utilization on an estate-wide and per-customer basis, including performance levels, capacity committed and consumed, physical capacity consumed, data efficiency ratio, IOPS delivered, latency delivered, capacity thresholds, and performance thresholds.
Reporting and Maintenance: Collect and maintain data on hardware health, OS version status, firmware status, incident status, EOS status, on-site installed tool status, software licensing status, support contract, and entitlement status.
Push Communications and Interfacing: Disseminate risks, alerts and security bulletins and work closely with Keystone Success Managers, Support Account Managers, Deployment Team and CSD to ensure distillation of the important aspects to all relevant teams.
Advanced Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to Keystone products, customer environments, and associated cloud environments (Azure, Google Cloud Provider, AWS).
Customer Support: Respond to post-sales customer support issues via phone, email, web, or chat.
Research and Analysis: Collect and analyze multi-platform logs to identify issues and determine root causes.
Collaboration: Work closely with other Technical Support Engineers and escalation teams to facilitate quick solutions and identify defects.
Knowledge Sharing: Create new knowledge base articles and improve existing ones for reuse throughout the Technical Support Center.

Job Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant technical support experience.
    Technical Skills: Extensive hands-on experience with networking protocols and storage technologies (e.g., NFS, CIFS, SAN, iSCSI, TCP/IP, RAID). Proven experience with NetApp Storage Systems (ONTAP 9 AFF/ASA/FAS, E-Series) and associated management tools.
    Certifications: NCDA Certification within first 6 months of hire
    Cloud and Virtualization: Experience with virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix) and cloud solutions, emphasizing performance issue detection under load.
    Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, plus one or more of the following languages: Japanese, French, or German.
    Problem-Solving: Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues using advanced analytical and creative problem-solving skills. Capacity to proactively identify potential issues, raise concerns early, and propose innovative, preventative resolutions.
    Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills to effectively manage stressful or ambiguous situations and deliver superior customer service.
    Technical Expertise: Familiarity with ancillary technologies such as DNS, NIS, and Active Directory. Expertise in performance troubleshooting, including diagnosing issues in NetApp systems (throughput, latency, high-load bottlenecks).
    Collaboration: Established track record of collaborating with senior internal and external stakeholders and contributing to cross-team initiatives.
    Fluency in English

Education

IC - Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience.Mgr & Exec - Typically requires a minimum of 3 years of related experience.

description:

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are seeking an experienced SCCM/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex SCCM/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. Technical Leadership & Architecture

• Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
• Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
• Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.
Enterprise Patch Management
• Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.

• Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with SCCM/Intune patch deployment cycles.
• Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
• Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.
Advanced OS Deployment & Provisioning
• Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
• Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
• Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
• Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
• Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.
Automation & Integration
• Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for SCCM and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
• Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy enforcement, and reporting.
• Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
• Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.
Client Engagement & Delivery Governance
• Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
• Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
• Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
• Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
• Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.
REQUIRED SKILLS
• Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
• Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
• Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
• Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
• PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
• SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
• Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
• Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

description:
Job Title

Finance BP Taiwan

Job Description

The Finance Business Partner is responsible for leading financial planning for assigned market, including AOP, forecasting, and strategic planning to ensure alignment with corporate objectives. The role conducts complex financial analyses, such as profitability and ROI assessments, to inform high-impact decisions and improve financial performance. The role acts as a strategic advisor to business leaders, providing financial insights to shape business strategy, with limited supervision. The role also evaluates investment business cases, monitors financial health, ensures compliance with internal controls, and leads initiatives to improve financial processes and systems


Job Responsibilities:
• Leads the financial planning process for assigned business units, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-term strategic planning, ensuring that all financial plans are aligned with corporate objectives and provide a clear roadmap for achieving financial targets.
• Conducts complex financial analysis, such as profitability analysis, margin analysis, and ROI assessments, to support high-impact business decisions and drive continuous improvement in financial performance.
• Works with limited supervision and broad guidelines, regularly applying independent judgment on matters of significance to drive project success and compliance.
• Acts as a trusted advisor to business leaders by providing strategic financial insights and recommendations, helping to shape business strategies and ensure that financial considerations are fully integrated into decision-making processes.
• Collaborates with cross-functional teams to evaluate the financial impact of business initiatives, such as product launches, market expansions, and cost-reduction programs, ensuring that financial risks and opportunities are fully understood and with compliance to financial accounting principles.
• Contributes to the monthly business review process by coordinating the preparation of financial materials, leading discussions on financial performance, and identifying actions needed to achieve financial goals.
• Evaluates investment business cases, including capital expenditures, R&D projects, and strategic marketing initiatives, ensuring that all financial assumptions are rigorous and that potential returns are aligned with the company's strategic priorities.
• Monitors the financial health of assigned business units by tracking key performance indicators, identifying emerging risks and opportunities, and working with business leaders to develop and implement corrective actions.
• Ensures compliance with internal controls, corporate policies, and regulatory requirements by supporting financial processes, maintaining accurate records, and supporting internal and external audits as needed.
• Leads or participates in initiatives to improve financial processes and systems, identifying opportunities for increased efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness in financial planning, reporting, and analysis activities.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor degree or above, major in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
  • Approximately five to eight years of progressive finance experience, including demonstrable business partnering with commercial or sales teams
  • Strong command of financial planning, analysis, and management reporting in a commercial environment
  • Working knowledge of pricing and margin mechanics, and comfort supporting deal and tender decisions under time pressure
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin
  • Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, able to build bridges between people
  • Hands on, pro-active, solution driven, very accurate but with sense of big picture
  • Profound understanding of accounting principles including Finance compliance requirements

Preferred

  • CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or an MBA
  • Experience in healthcare, medical technology, or another regulated industry
  • Familiarity with Taiwan public tender processes and distributor or dealer commercial models
  • Experience with AI
  • Prior experience in a matrixed multinational, partnering across a regional and local reporting structure

Are you ready to engineer integrations that accelerate clinical development and bring medicines to patients faster? In this role, you will own and evolve our GxP-compliant A&R integration product—part of Clinical Development Platforms—used across late-stage science teams spanning all therapeutic areas. You will work at the intersection of science and technology, turning business needs into secure, scalable, API-led integrations that improve speed, quality, and confidence in study execution.

Joining a high-performing BizDevOps team, you will collaborate closely with Product Leads, DevOps Leads, and engineers to design, build, and run integrations on MuleSoft and SnapLogic. Do you see yourself simplifying complex landscapes and creating reusable patterns that others rely on? Your work will strengthen our clinical data flows, reduce incidents through automation, and ensure robust operations that stand up to regulatory scrutiny.

title: Senior Architect System and Development Engineering
description:
Job Title

Senior Architect System and Development Engineering

Job Description

In this role, you have the opportunity to

Join one of our key growth areas as Mother & Child Care Business, known with the brand Philips Avent. You’ll be working as System Architect in a new value space of BabyTech part of Smart Parenting category. You will be part of the R&D organization contributing to the innovation roadmap realization, including the IoT smart devices for our digital parenting platform. As architect, you will be driving and be responsible of the technical execution of a product proposition, from the start in defining the product requirements, up to the development phase before release and aftercare of the innovative products in collabration with the cross-functional project team.

You are responsible for

  • Managing the end to end all product requirements and verification/validation matters related to technical solution/execution of a product proposition/platform
  • Defining requirements of the overall design, realization and test of a system, subsystem and component; understands and communicates consequences of the design on the architecture. Ensure new functions fulfill applicable generic system requirements and define new system requirement of new functions developed. Finalizes design requirements in accordance with the functional specifications and then tests, analyses and verify their performance.
  • Translates project objective(s) from benefits and/or step improvements into corresponding functional requirements (targets), considering all valid use-cases, product reliability, design robustness, cost and manufacturability
  • Subject matter expert for Systems Engineering in medical and non-medical devices development processes. Ensure that the development team correctly interpret and implement of all product requirements during the different phases of the product development: eg. VPC/AD/PDLM/MLD, requirements are systematically defined and documented (e.g. via DOORS)
  • Technical leadership in product development, launch and maintenance stage process. Design, analysis and testing of systems and sub-systems, problem-solving in design and providing guidance to internal team and external vendors (OEM/ODM) ensuring robust end-to-end design (DFSS) to fulfil quality / reliability / safety and meet system requirements.
  • Drive excellence in CTQ definition; Design FMEA analysis and Design review and development with Cross-Innovation sites (internal) engineering teams, OEM/ODM manufacturers and in-house factories, including lifecycle product quality improvements.
  • Use of critical thinking to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems. Display a knack for complex problem solving by evaluating options and implementing solutions that address the root cause.

You are a part of

The Philips business group, Personal Health, delivers innovative lifestyle solutions for personal well-being. Our brand promise is to deliver innovation that matters to you, which means that our products are caring, innovative & impactful. The sector builds on a deep understanding of people's needs and aspirations to create innovations that help consumers achieve their lifestyle ambitions.

At Mother and Child Care (Philips - Avent) Business Unit, encompasses multiple sub-businesses category such as Smart Parenting. We focus on the development of medically and non-medically endorsed lifestyle products for parents, infants and children.

You will be working within a team of highly motivated people. Location: Shenzhen, China.

To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience

  • University education or higher in physics / mechanical-material engineering / bio-engineering / electronics engineering / product design
  • >5 years of relevant working experience in a regulated environment for product creation and development. Experience with Medical Devices is nice to have, but not mandatory.
  • Experience and competence in systems engineering, requirement management (via DOORS)
  • Proven experience in consumer electronics product development, integration of electrical components inside a mechanical embodiment (thermal management, EMC, wiring, PCB, software integration, display, etc.), from concept development to market launch with crucial involvement in the industrialization phase.
  • Skilled and experience in connected products, in particular in complex systems, digital, embedded software and connectivity, including up to date knowledge of wireless technologies like Bluetooth Low Energy, Wi-Fi.
  • Experienced in using tools and methodologies such as dFMEA; CTQ flow down and risk assessment. Proof of statistical engineering experience and design for reliability.
  • Working experience in a regulated environment (medical device is a preference) for product creation and development. Knowledge of quality standards eg. ISO13485/FDA/MDD/EU MDR practices and GMP or similar regulated industry standards. Including proven knowledge of Good Documentation Practice. Besides, knowledge on IEC 60601 and IEC 60355 is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills at all levels (fluent in English). A strong plus for individuals with solid experiences in working with projects teams spread across multiple locations.
  • Creative, and abstract thinker with a good balance to application, result-driven, accurate and quality minded. Ambition to create value for our customers.
  • Experience in working with Far-East OEM/ODM external vendors. You’re well experienced in communication with suppliers for manufacturing, cost estimation
  • Travel in South China region: ~20%

Furthermore, you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you work with International cross functional teams to make things happen. You are able to communicate from a small squad team level up to General Management level and have an open, flexible attitude that makes you approachable.

In return, we offer you

A path towards your most rewarding career. We welcome you to a challenging, innovative environment with great opportunities for you to explore. Philips is among one of the most innovative companies investing significantly in R&D. Developing and succeeding in this world-class innovation organization will open many doors for your long-term career. We also believe that we are at our best as a company when you are at yours as a person. Thus, we offer competitive health benefits, a flexible work schedule and access to local well-being focused activities.

Why should you join Philips?

Working at Philips is more than a job. It’s a calling to create a healthier society through meaningful work, focused on improving 2.5 billion lives a year by delivering innovative solutions across the health continuum. Our people experience a variety of unexpected moments when their lives and careers come together in meaningful ways. Learn more by watching this video.

To find out more about what it’s like working for Philips at a personal level, visit the Working at Philips page on our career website, where you can read stories from our employee blog. Once there,you can also learn about our recruitment process, or find answers to some of the frequently asked questions.

  • Manage Infrastructure: Liaison with Solution Health information systems teams to ensure reliable, high-performing day-to-day operations and business continuity.
  • Oversee Vendors: Manage third-party technology suppliers, managed service providers (MSPs), and enforce service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Secure Data: Design and implement administrative, physical, and technical safeguards; maintain a living risk register for electronic protected health information (ePHI).
  • Govern AI: Establish an inventory of corporate AI use cases, develop usage policies, and implement strict guardrails to prevent sensitive data exposure in unapproved AI tools.
  • Engage Stakeholders: Advise the Board and executive team on security posture, compliance, and major technology investments using clear metrics and dashboards.

Who You Are:

  • Educated & Experienced: Holder of a B.S. in Computer Science (or equivalent) with 8–10 years of progressive IT/security experience, including 3–5 years in a leadership role.

  • Strategic Communicator: Skilled at translating complex technical and AI concepts for executive, Board, and non-technical audiences to build cross-functional trust.

Why You’ll Love Us:

title: Director – Enterprise Data Engineering
description:
Job Title: Director – Enterprise Data Engineering

GCL: F


Introduction to role:


Are you ready to define the enterprise standard for data engineering and turn strategy into measurable outcomes that accelerate insights to patients? In this role, you will establish the main direction for data engineering across AstraZeneca. You will be responsible for building and scaling a distributed service that provides trusted, high-quality, secure, and cost-efficient data products at enterprise scale.


You will own the end-to-end build of our data engineering capability. This includes driving visibility and lineage, automated quality controls, FinOps governance, performance SLAs/SLOs, and regulatory compliance across crucial information domains. Working as part of a varied community of specialists, you will connect strategy to execution, partnering across business technology groups to standardize how data is acquired, transformed, orchestrated, and delivered for impact. Can you turn a long-term architecture into reusable accelerators that dozens of teams embrace and love?

Accountabilities:


  • Define and execute the enterprise data engineering strategy aligned to our 2030 Data Strategy; translate vision into a capability model, adoption roadmap, service tiers, and maturity milestones that build measurable business value.
  • Build and lead a focused, high-performing team of specialists; set direction on technology perfection across acquisition, storage, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, CI/CD, and containerization using Snowflake, Fivetran, Dbt, DataOps.live, and SnowPark Container Services. Govern the standardization of end-to-end data engineering solutions aligned with enterprise architecture; establish enterprise practice as a foundational pillar of data management.
  • Champion automation across the lifecycle—impact analysis, design, build, test, deploy—leveraging AI code generation (for example, Snowflake Cortex Code and GitHub Copilot) to increase velocity and quality while reducing defects and time-to-detect/time-to-resolve.
  • Embed governance-as-code and preventative controls; design pipelines and patterns that achieve close to zero cost leakage on cloud infrastructure, and uplift performance metrics including latency, reliability, and quality through clear SLAs/SLOs.
  • Operate and scale a federated service across business technology groups; enable alignment, capability uplift, and reuse via onboarding kits, templates, and self-service accelerators.
  • Partner with leaders across data, analytics, AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise/domain/solution architecture; liaise with procurement, finance, legal, quality, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor partners to ensure compliant, secure, and value-driven delivery.
  • Drive adoption through education, enablement, and community practices; measure success through standardization, automation readiness, turnaround time to business value, capability maturity, and adoption velocity.
  • Proactively raise, handle, and mitigate risks; ensure alignment to regulatory requirements (including privacy, GxP, SOx, and HIPAA as applicable) without slowing delivery.

Essential Skills/Experience:


  • Preferably 15+ years in data engineering leadership roles at an enterprise capacity.
  • Strong hands-on experience in data engineering capability involving data acquisition, data storage, data ingestion, data transformation, data orchestration, CI/CD, containerization.
  • Extensive practical experience engaging with Open table standards (for ex, Iceberg) and Open technical catalogs (for ex, Snowflake Horizon).
  • Extensive practical experience handling Structured, Semi-Structured and Unstructured data assets and engineering.
  • Mandatory (Must Have) Skills – Snowflake, Fivetran DBT, DataOps.live, SnowPark Container technology, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake Horizon, Snowflake Cortex software (CoCo), AWS S3.
  • Optional (Nice to Have) Skills – Databricks, Snaplogic, Apache Polaris, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, AWS Kiro, AWS Redshift, Docker, Kubernetes, MWAA, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Databricks Unity Catalog.
  • Expertise with modern data architectures, cloud data platforms and data engineering lifecycle implementation and practices.
  • Solid understanding of metadata, lineage, security classification, FinOps, and SLA/SLO frameworks.
  • Confirmed leadership in large-scale, federated, global technology environments.
  • Ability to influence, educate, and lead change across technical & business teams.
  • Background in regulated industries (Pharma, Healthcare) with Data Privacy, HIPAA, GxP & SOx.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Track record establishing new capabilities from scratch and scaling globally.
  • Experience defining enterprise service tiers, maturity models, and adoption programs.
  • Proven leadership developing talent and hard-working technical teams.
  • Strong collaborator management and collaboration across matrixed environments.
  • A forward-thinking approach combined with a commitment to taking initiative and delivering tangible outcomes.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our outstanding and ambitious world.

Why AstraZeneca:

Here you will build from scratch with a collective of inclusive self-starters who share ideas, challenge with grit, and make bold thinking real. We bring unexpected teams into the same room—engineers, scientists, analysts, and partners—using brand-new data and AI tools to turn complexity into practical insights that help patients sooner. You will work at the heart of our information transformation. u will have the autonomy to set direction and the community support to deliver it. You will balance ambition with care while scaling solutions across a worldwide information ecosystem.


Lead the enterprise backbone supporting data engineering and watch your strategy translate into faster, trusted insights for patients—step forward and build what comes next.
